normalizedText: Company OverviewFactori is a rapidly growing location and consumer intelligence company built for an AI-first world. Each day we ingest billions of privacy-compliant signals and maintain the world’s most comprehensive consumer, mobility and point-of-interest database. Our AI-driven insights help Fortune 500 brands, global media agencies and technology innovators decide where to invest, build and grow. Headquartered in New York City with hubs across APAC, EMEA and the Americas, we operate with the ownership mindset of a startup and the global footprint of an enterprise data leader.Role SummaryWe are looking for a Growth Marketing & AI-GTM Lead who can build and scale Factori.ai’s AI-native growth engine across enterprise and mid-market segments. The role will be responsible for creating qualified demand, improving funnel conversion, generating sales-ready opportunities, building autonomous GTM systems, and driving measurable pipeline growth for a data-led B2B business.The ideal candidate should be able to market a complex data, AI, or technology product by translating technical capabilities into clear commercial use cases. Beyond traditional growth marketing, the candidate should leverage AI, automation, and agentic workflows to improve speed, personalization, operational efficiency, and decision-making across the go-to-market function. The role requires hands-on ownership of campaigns, content-led demand, paid acquisition, account-based marketing, AI-powered growth systems, sales alignment, and growth analytics.Key ResponsibilitiesBuild and own Factori.ai’s AI-native growth marketing strategy across target industries, buyer personas, geographies, and high-value account segments.Define and refine the ideal customer profile by working closely with sales, product, and leadership teams to identify high-propensity accounts, buying signals, and commercial use cases.Create a predictable, AI-powered demand generation engine focused on qualified pipeline, opportunity creation, and revenue contribution rather than lead volume alone.Develop and execute multi-channel growth campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, email, SEO, retargeting, content, partner channels, and emerging AI-native distribution channels.Drive account-based marketing programs for strategic enterprise and mid-market accounts using AI-driven research, account enrichment, persona-led campaigns, and sales-aligned outreach.Translate Factori.ai’s data, location intelligence, mobility, places, and audience capabilities into clear growth use cases for industries such as retail, real estate, financial services, logistics, advertising, AI platforms, and enterprise data teams.Build campaign narratives around business outcomes such as customer intelligence, market expansion, store or branch planning, audience targeting, AI data enrichment, demand forecasting, and operational intelligence.Own the full marketing funnel from awareness and demand generation to lead capture, nurture, qualification, sales handoff, opportunity creation, and pipeline acceleration while identifying opportunities to automate repetitive GTM workflows.Improve website and landing-page conversion through AI-assisted experimentation, sharper messaging, personalization, A/B testing, SEO improvements, and continuous performance optimization.Create high-converting growth assets including landing pages, email journeys, product explainers, case studies, industry reports, use-case pages, executive content, and AI-assisted content systems that improve speed, consistency, and personalization.Run paid acquisition campaigns with clear tracking of cost per lead, cost per qualified opportunity, conversion rates, pipeline ROI, and channel-level performance.Build segmented nurture programs that move prospects from awareness to sales readiness through AI-powered email workflows, content sequencing, retargeting, and persona-specific messaging.Partner closely with SDR and sales teams to improve lead quality, qualification criteria, campaign feedback loops, handoff processes, and opportunity conversion.Design outbound support campaigns for named accounts, target personas, priority industries, and active sales opportunities using AI-driven research and personalized messaging.Use data and AI to continuously optimize campaign targeting, messaging, channel mix, creative performance, landing pages, distribution strategies, and funnel movement.Establish growth dashboards and AI-powered reporting systems to track campaign performance, funnel conversion, pipeline contribution, revenue influence, and automation effectiveness.Identify and test new growth channels including partnerships, ecosystem campaigns, marketplaces, AI-native channels, and strategic data partnerships.Build thought leadership-led demand through AI-assisted content creation, reports, LinkedIn campaigns, newsletters, executive content, webinars, industry insights, and category education.Support product-led and data-led growth initiatives by converting demo requests, API interest, dataset inquiries, and product engagement into qualified sales opportunities.Create a repeatable AI-first GTM operating rhythm through experimentation frameworks, autonomous workflows, real-time performance monitoring, and continuous optimization.AI & Agentic GTM SystemsDesign and build internal AI-powered GTM workflows using platforms such as n8n, Clay, APIs, LLMs, MCP servers, workflow automation platforms, and modern AI tooling.Build autonomous systems that automate prospect research, account intelligence, enrichment, lead qualification, outbound personalization, campaign execution, reporting, and growth operations.Develop reusable AI agents and workflows that improve execution speed, consistency, personalization, and operational efficiency across the marketing and sales organization.Build an autonomous distribution engine that intelligently repurposes and distributes product launches, customer stories, reports, case studies, thought leadership, and campaign assets across relevant owned, earned, and paid channels with minimal manual intervention.Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to automate and improve GTM execution across the organization.Required Experience5+ years of experience in B2B growth marketing, demand generation, performance marketing, revenue marketing, integrated marketing, or AI-enabled GTM.Experience marketing SaaS, data products, analytics platforms, AI platforms, APIs, martech, adtech, or other enterprise technology solutions.Proven experience in building demand generation programs that contribute directly to qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.Hands-on experience with paid media, LinkedIn campaigns, Google campaigns, email marketing, SEO, content-led demand, account-based marketing, and growth analytics.Experience working closely with sales teams on lead quality, qualification, funnel movement, campaign feedback, and opportunity conversion.Hands-on experience building workflow automation using platforms such as n8n, Clay, Make, Zapier, or similar automation technologies.Experience integrating AI tools, APIs, LLMs, or workflow automation into marketing, sales, or GTM processes.Comfort working with growth and marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, Apollo, Clay, OpenAI, Anthropic, enrichment platforms, and similar AI-native GTM tools.Skills & CapabilitiesStrong ability to simplify complex data and technology propositions into clear business value and buyer-specific messaging.Strong analytical ability across funnel metrics, campaign ROI, attribution, channel performance, cost per qualified opportunity, pipeline influence, and revenue contribution.Ability to create and execute integrated campaigns across awareness, acquisition, nurture, conversion, and pipeline acceleration.Strong understanding of AI-native marketing, workflow automation, agentic systems, and modern GTM architecture.Ability to identify repetitive GTM workflows and transform them into scalable autonomous systems.Strong content and campaign judgment with the ability to create industry narratives, executive content, reports, use-case pages, landing pages, and AI-assisted content workflows.High comfort with experimentation, rapid prototyping, A/B testing, growth sprints, campaign diagnostics, and continuous optimization.Ability to work in an early-stage or growth-stage environment where systems, automation, and processes are continuously evolving.Strong systems-thinking mindset with a bias toward automation, scalability, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes.Preferred BackgroundExperience in B2B SaaS, Data-as-a-Service, location intelligence, customer intelligence, martech, adtech, analytics, AI, business intelligence, enterprise APIs, or marketing measurement would be valuable.Experience marketing to CMOs, Heads of Growth, Data Leaders, Product Leaders, Strategy Teams, Retail Expansion Teams, Real Estate Teams, Enterprise AI Teams, and Revenue Operations leaders would also be relevant.Experience building AI-powered GTM workflows, agentic systems, autonomous distribution engines, or internal marketing automation platforms would be a strong advantage. normalizedText: Senior Manager, Marketing (FRWD) – MarTechRegion: New Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORKWe are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these do not happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. WHO YOU'LL WORK WITHFRWD is Bain & Company's marketing acceleration capability—a community of expert practitioners who partner with clients and their agencies to drive meaningful business results and transformation.Our team brings together specialists from leading in-house marketing organizations, agencies and technology platforms who combine deep practical expertise with a passion for measurable results. We don't just help clients determine what to do—we work alongside them to define how to make it happen.FRWD partners with Bain clients across a range of strategic marketing challenges, including:Marketing diagnostics to identify performance improvement opportunitiesMarketing transformation and capability buildingE-commerce acceleration across retail, marketplace and direct-to-consumer channelsMarketing operating model, MarTech and data strategy designCommercial due diligence and value creation planning for private equity investments WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAMWe're looking for a Senior Manager, MarTech to join FRWD in APAC.You'll bring broad marketing expertise together with deep MarTech experience, helping clients integrate technology, customer data and digital capabilities into larger marketing, commercial and growth transformations.As a senior practitioner and workstream leader, you'll shape MarTech strategies, operating models and implementation roadmaps while partnering closely with Bain consulting teams, FRWD practitioners and senior client stakeholders across marketing, sales, technology, analytics and digital functions.You'll also play an important role in growing Bain's MarTech capability across the APAC region through thought leadership, coaching and business development. WHAT YOU'LL DOLead MarTech strategy and client deliveryLead MarTech diagnostics, assessments and client workstreams across marketing technology, CRM, CDP, marketing automation, personalization, customer journey orchestration, analytics, attribution, privacy and AI-enabled marketing capabilities.Develop data-driven recommendations, investment cases, implementation of roadmaps and capability-building plans that connect technology decisions with measurable business outcomes.Assess existing MarTech ecosystems, vendor landscapes, organizational models and operating processes to identify opportunities for simplification, optimization and growth.Design customer data and activation strategies across leading platforms including Adobe Experience Cloud, Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze, Segment/Twilio, Amplitude, Google Analytics 4, AppsFlyer and related technologies.Develop measurement frameworks, experimentation strategies and attribution approaches that improve customer acquisition, retention, lifecycle engagement and marketing ROI.Collaborate closely with client implementation teams, agencies, platform partners and Bain technical specialists, translating complex technical concepts into actionable business recommendations.Build trusted client relationshipsDevelop strong relationships with senior client stakeholders across marketing, growth, digital, technology, sales and executive leadership.Facilitate executive workshops and stakeholder interviews to align priorities and define practical transformation roadmaps.Deliver clear, compelling presentations that connect MarTech investments to commercial performance, customer experience and operating model improvements.Ensure all analyses, recommendations and client deliverables meet Bain's high standards for quality, accuracy and impact.Lead teams and grow the FRWD capabilityLead and coach integrated Bain and FRWD teams throughout client engagements.Share MarTech expertise across the broader Bain ecosystem through tools, methodologies, training and case examples.Support capability building, recruiting, intellectual property development and business development across the APAC FRWD practice.Foster a collaborative, feedback-rich culture while modeling Bain's values and leadership expectations. ABOUT YOUYou are an experienced MarTech leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on experience delivering marketing transformation.Required Qualifications5–8 years of experience across marketing, digital, growth, marketing operations or MarTech, with demonstrated leadership progression.5+ years of experience in MarTech strategy, technology stack assessments, CRM, CDP, marketing automation, customer journey orchestration, measurement, attribution or marketing technology investments.Experience in consulting, agencies, in-house marketing, customer data or marketing technology environments; client services experience is strongly preferred.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to connect technology, data and process decisions to commercial outcomes.Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams across marketing, technology, analytics and business stakeholders.Practical experience with leading MarTech platforms such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Marketo, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Segment/Twilio, Amplitude, Google Analytics 4, AppsFlyer and related customer data and marketing automation technologies.Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage both executive business leaders and technical stakeholders.Experience working across APAC markets or the ability to navigate diverse regulatory environments, partner ecosystems and client cultures.Bachelor's degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.Willingness to travel as required.MarTech capabilities we're seekingWhile candidates are not expected to have expertise across every platform, we value experience in several of the following areas:MarTech strategy, technology stack assessments and roadmap developmentCustomer data platforms (CDP), CRM, identity resolution, segmentation and customer activationMarketing automation, lifecycle marketing, personalization and journey orchestrationMarketing measurement, attribution, experimentation and performance analyticsPrivacy, consent management, AI-enabled marketing, workflow automation, e-commerce, retail media and AdTech integrationCertifications or practitioner experience across platforms such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Marketo, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Google Marketing Platform, Meta, Amazon Ads, The Trade Desk, Segment/Twilio, Amplitude or comparable technologies ABOUT BAIN & COMPANYBain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world's most ambitious change makers define the future.We work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Our vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators complements our integrated consulting expertise to deliver better, faster and more enduring outcomes.Since 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients and continue to lead the industry in client advocacy. From determining positioning, naming, competitive analysis, feature prioritization and external communications, you help shape the product and help it grow a consumer base. This means you work with a cross-functional team across Sales, corporate communications, legal, webmasters, product development, engineering and more. In this role, you'll be involved with product marketing strategy from beginning to end.As the Senior Scaled Growth & Content (SGC) Lead, you will define the content agenda and guide a team of writers and AI specialists to produce high-quality B2B content, owning the editorial lifecycle from conception to global scale. As a player-coach, you will orchestrate the content development process, accelerating production while leveraging the latest advancements in AI to experiment with cutting-edge formats and topics.Crucially, you will lead audience acquisition and growth tactics to scale subscribers within our target audience. story At Alight, we believe a company’s success starts with its people. Grow with purpose – Be inspired by our higher calling of improving lives. Be Alight – act with integrity, be real and empower others. It’s why we’re so driven to connect passion with purpose. Our team’s expertise in human insights and cloud technology gives companies and employees around the world the ability to power confident decisions, for life. With a comprehensive total rewards package, continuing education and training, and tremendous potential with a growing global organization, Alight is the perfect place to put your passion to work. Join our team if you Champion People, want to Grow with Purpose through acting with integrity and if you embody the meaning of Be Alight. Learn more at careers.alight.com. Responsibilities: Strategic Leadership § Direct and oversee the quality function for claims operations § Work with the Operations Leader in establishing standardized policies and procedures for the administration of insurance claims related to leave absence § Ensure compliance with industry standards, regulations, and best practices. Quality Assurance § Develop and implement quality assurance processes to enhance claims handling efficiency and accuracy. § Monitor claims processing, review outcomes, and identify areas for improvement. § Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address quality gaps. Performance Metrics § Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to claims quality, turnaround time, and customer satisfaction. § Analyze data to drive continuous improvement initiatives. Staff Development: § Provide expert guidance and consultation to staff on complex claims scenarios. § Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth. Stakeholder Communication § Collaborate with senior management, underwriters, and other departments to align quality goals. § Communicate quality-related updates and initiatives to internal and external stakeholders. Risk Management: § Mitigate risks associated with claims processing errors, fraud, and non-compliance. § Implement preventive measures and corrective actions. Budgeting and Resource Allocation: § Develop and manage budgets for quality assurance programs. § Allocate resources effectively to achieve quality objectives. Process Optimization: § Identify bottlenecks and streamline claims workflows. § Implement technology solutions to enhance efficiency through automation. Continuous Improvement: § Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes. § Drive innovation and adapt best practices to improve claims operations. Qualifications: **Education**: Masters/Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business Administration, Insurance, Quality Management). Master Black Belt certification is a Must Have. **Experience**: Minimum 15 years of managerial experience in claims operations or quality management. Deep understanding of claims processes, insurance policies, and risk assessment. Skills: Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication and leadership abilities. Proficiency in using claims management software and data analytics tools. MBB Certification in quality management (e.g., Six Sigma, Lean) is a must have. Benefits We offer programs and plans for a healthy mind, body, wallet and life because it’s important our benefits care for the whole person. Options include a variety of health coverage options, wellbeing and support programs, retirement, vacation and sick leave, maternity, paternity & adoption leave, continuing education and training as well as a number of voluntary benefit options. By applying for a position with Alight, you understand that, should you be made an offer, it will be contingent on your undergoing and successfully completing a background check consistent with Alight’s employment policies. Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: SSN/SIN validation, education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position. Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion Alight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. normalizedText: About Cventwww.cvent.comCvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500+ employees and ~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4.6B in 2023.Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection.AI at Cvent: Leading the FutureAre you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.In This Role, You WillCvent is seeking an exceptional senior executive to serve as its Senior Vice President / Vice President, Marketing - India. This role is the senior-most marketing leader in India.This individual will be a critical force multiplier: ensuring that India’s 200+ marketing professionals are high performing, deeply aligned with global priorities, and operating at the frontier of marketinginnovation. Beyond operational stewardship, this executive will serve as a recognized champion of the Event Technology and Martech landscape — representing Cvent’s perspective externally in India & APAC/IMEA region.The role operates within a global matrix structure: functional direction flows from discipline leaders based across the US, EMEA, and APAC, while this executive holds full ownership of people leadership, operational excellence, talent strategy, and site culture for India. People Leadership, Coaching & Talent Management Serve as the primary people leader for 200+ India-based marketing professionals across multiple disciplines, coaching and developing talent in close partnership with global functional leaders. Drive a comprehensive India marketing talent strategy: workforce planning, strategic hiring, structured onboarding, career pathing, and retention — with depth in demand generation, Martech, digital, analytics, events, and creative. Identify and accelerate high-potential leaders; build robust succession pipelines and a strong internal bench across all marketing functions. Foster a high-performance, inclusive culture aligned with Cvent’s values and spirit of intrapreneurship — where every marketer is empowered to think like an owner and act with urgency. Champion of Event Technology & the Marketing StackAct as a credible “internal customer”: represent the marketer’s perspective when evaluating Cvent’s own product portfolio and translate those insights into actionable feedback for Product, GTM, and Customer Success teams.Champion Event-Led Growth (ELG) thinking across the India organization, ensuring teams deeply understand how Cvent’s platform drives pipeline, revenue, and engagement for enterprise B2B marketers globally.Represent India marketing in global forums and industry events as a confident, opinionated voice on modern B2B marketing and Event Technology. AI Transformation Champion Lead Cvent India’s AI transformation within marketing — actively monitoring best-in-class AI tool developments, enterprise adoption trends, and emerging agentic workflows across the global marketing industry. Experiment with and evaluate frontier AI platforms — generative content tools, AI-driven video automation (including Goldcast’ s capabilities), intelligent personalization, and analytics automation — bringing informed, hands-on recommendations to the organization. Partner with Global Marketing Operations to identify, pilot, and scale high-impact AI and automation use cases in India-based workstreams: content production, QA, campaign operations, and workflow automation. Build a culture of AI-first thinking: upskill teams, reduce manual effort, and enable India marketing to operate with the agility and leverage that modern AI tooling provides. Translate AI adoption into measurable outcomes — velocity, quality, cost efficiency — and report on impact in global leadership reviews with clarity and precision. Operational Excellence & Follow-the-Sun Execution Own the day-to-day operational rhythm of India-based marketing teams, ensuring reliable delivery against SLAs and commitments to global discipline leaders and regional stakeholders. Design and continuously improve follow-the-sun workflows across US-EMEA-APAC time zones for campaigns, events, marketing operations, and creative services — optimizing for speed, quality, and continuity of execution. Partner with Global Marketing Operations on capacity planning, prioritization, and skills-to-work alignment, ensuring India bandwidth maps to the highest-impact global initiatives. Drive continuous improvement in processes, tooling, and collaboration models — positioning India as a recognized center of operational excellence within global marketing. Stakeholder Management & Matrix LeadershipAct as the primary India marketing point of contact for global discipline leaders, regional sales leadership (APAC/IMEA), and executive stakeholders across the business.Ensure clear, disciplined alignment of goals, expectations, and performance feedback between India teams and global functional counterparts.Partner with HR, Finance, Facilities, and corporate functions in India to champion site culture, employee engagement, and a world-class workplace experience for marketing professionals. MBA or postgraduate qualification in Marketing or Business Management preferred.

jdEvidence.value: Drive business development, growth, and product innovation for merchant payments in the SaaS/Fintech sector.
Responsible for growing relationships, revenue, product usage, and adoption, and negotiating commercials with customers.

normalizedText: LocationDelhi Full job description About the Company Easebuzz is India’s one of the first and foremost end-to-end SAAS enabled payments platform. We are a SaaS-unifying payment aggregation platform interconnecting banks, networks, acquirers and processors for merchant payments. We create value by enabling seamless workflows which help merchant to have a better collection efficiency. Our vision is to verticalize payments with industry specific solutions that can increase the online GDP of India. We’ve been building on business value for our merchants since 2014 and are trusted by more than 1.5 lacs merchant base . We are unique in terms of our offering to our merchants and our excitement lies in building together where we all can thrive for future. About the Role At Easebuzz, business development managers build deep relationships with our customers and drive forward our growth engine. We are so obsessed about our customers we like to think of business managers more as customer-facing product managers who can co-create new product innovations for them. You are a consultant to a problem where you have access to the management of the company to build on solutions which can help us have better vertical solutions for the market. You are adept of doing product related conversations with various stakeholders on the customer’s side. You are able to communicate and establish value propositions that solves a problem and where you can also take new feedback to convert them into product opportunities. You are analytical and derive actionable insights from customer conversations. You are then able to convert these insights into product and business ideas and drive our relationship deeper into our merchant-ecosystem. What you’ll do Own a category of merchant customers. You are responsible for growing relationships, revenue, product usage, and adoption. Develop different tactics to build merchant base within varied categories of business. You have to work on pitch decks, product related documentation, RFP responses, technical and commercial proposals. You to drive excellence in customer relationship. Work with your managers and other stakeholders in different teams and create a winning formula for your customers. Derive opportunities to ideate and co-create with internal products and engineering teams to drive Easebuzz product strategy and plans. Work with legal to structure contracts that are win-win for the customer and Easebuzz. Drive product related use-cases which are not payments but payment related product which solves for a problem and you should be technically sound to understand. What we’re looking for 7+ years of experience in SaaS/Fintech companies, in sales management or customer-facing product management. Understanding of regulatory framework, compliances and understanding of payments as well as SAAS ecosystems. Ability to understand and simplify complex technical and product requirements. Ability to participate in the co-creation process. Ability to negotiate with customers on delivery milestones and commercials. Great problem-solving, communication, and verbal skills. Experience with developing business plans and helping set up business strategy for a category. Great presentation skills and the ability to think on your feet. We believe product deck creation is an art and a product genre by itself! Empathy towards external and internal stakeholders. Persuasion skills without being forceful. You use both data and intuition to do that. Ability to go into unknown territories and navigate comfortably

normalizedText: LocationChennai, Tamil Nadu Full job description Role: Performance Marketing Executive Experience: 2- 8 years Location: Chennai Key Responsibilities: Campaign Execution & Optimization: Manage and optimize digital marketing campaigns across platforms like Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram, and LinkedIn to achieve business goals (e.g., customer acquisition, lead generation). Performance Analysis: Track and analyze campaign performance metrics such as ROAS, CPA, CPL, CTR, and conversion rates using tools like Google Analytics and Facebook Ads Manager. A/B Testing & Experimentation: Conduct A/B tests on ads, creatives, landing pages, and audience segments to continuously improve performance and drive better results. Budget Management: Oversee and optimize marketing budgets across channels, ensuring effective allocation and maximum ROI for all paid campaigns. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the creative, content, and product teams to align on campaign messaging, design, and strategy. Reporting & Insights: Provide regular performance reports to stakeholders, including actionable insights and recommendations to enhance campaign outcomes. Customer Acquisition & Conversion: Drive customer acquisition strategies through paid media while focusing on optimizing conversion rates across funnels. Market Trend Awareness: Stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends, tools, and platform updates to leverage new strategies for campaign growth. Digital Marketing & PerformanceManage paid media campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, and local Indian channels.Oversee SEO, website performance, and digital content strategy.Monitor campaign KPIs, including leads, conversions, CPL, and ROI.Work with external agencies to optimise performance and audience targeting. Media & Public RelationsDevelop relationships with media outlets, journalists, and education publications.Coordinate media opportunities, interviews, press releases, and announcements.Manage local PR agency relationships.Identify opportunities to position Western Sydney University as a leading international education provider in India. Brand ManagementEstablish and maintain Western Sydney University's brand presence in India.Ensure consistent application of brand guidelines across all channels.Monitor competitor activity and market trends. Essential Experience6+ years of experience in marketing, communications, or student recruitment marketing.Proven experience developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns.Strong experience in digital marketing and paid media campaign management.Experience managing external agencies and third-party vendors.Demonstrated experience managing marketing budgets, campaign performance, and reporting. KnowledgeStrong understanding of the Indian higher education sector.Knowledge of student recruitment marketing and the prospective student journey.Sound understanding of media relations and public relations practices in India. SkillsExcellent stakeholder management, interpersonal, and communication skills.Strong project management and organisational capabilities.Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, start-up environment.Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills. DesirableExperience working within a university, international education provider, pathway provider, or education agency.Experience supporting the launch of a new brand, campus, or education venture.Established network of digital media, creative, PR, and production partners within India. Who we are The NS Raghavan Centre for Entrepreneurial Learning (NSRCEL) is IIM Bangalore’s startup hub and incubation centre. The centre is structured as a section-8 not-for-profit entity. NSRCEL’s mission is to support ventures in the start-up ecosystem that demonstrate potential to create significant economic and societal impact. This financial year alone NSRCEL has engaged with 662 ventures through 13 unique program tracks across 82 townsin the country.NSRCEL is supported by the Department of Science and Technology (DST) and Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and foundations like Pernod Ricard India Foundation and SBI Foundation. NSRCEL has partnered with corporates like Alstom,Capgemini, Unilever, Kotak Mahindra Bank and Maruti Suzuki among others.Background to the role:NSRCEL has been focussed until now on early-revenue stage incubation, helping founders navigate from MVP to PMF. job description About the role: We’re looking for a Director of Strategy & Operations - a startup operator who can bring clarity and execution discipline to fast-growing teams, drive cross-functional alignment, and scale systems that actually work. You’ll sit at the intersection of strategy, ops, and product, leading key initiatives that move the business forward - from improving sales-to-onboarding flows to optimizing our care and claims operations. This is a builder’s role. You’ll be hands-on in diagnosing bottlenecks, designing scalable processes, and driving measurable impact on growth, efficiency, and profitability. What you will do: 1. Build and Scale Core Systems Redesign workflows across Sales, Ops, and Care to remove friction and increase throughput. Drive automation and tool adoption across teams to improve accuracy and turnaround times. Create repeatable playbooks for key business processes as we scale from thousands to millions of covered lives. 2. Lead Cross-Functional Initiatives Run company-wide programs that cut across business lines — from new product launches to cost optimization and customer experience initiatives. Be the go-to person for execution clarity — aligning teams, setting clear metrics, and ensuring momentum. Partner closely with Product and Tech to translate business needs into scalable tools. 3. Operational Excellence Define and track key performance metrics (TATs, retention, margin, NPS, etc.) across verticals. Build the operating cadence — reviews, dashboards, reporting rhythms — to keep teams accountable. Identify and eliminate waste in processes using Lean / continuous improvement methods. 4. Strategic Projects Lead short-term, high-impact projects directly sponsored by the CEO or COO. Analyse performance drivers, run experiments, and recommend where to double down. Support fundraising, board discussions, and strategic planning through data-backed insights. What we are looking for: 10+ years of experience in strategy, ops, product, or business leadership roles at high-growth startups (fintech, health tech, or ops-heavy businesses preferred). Have scaled or rebuilt a core business function before — whether it’s supply ops, CX, or go-to-market. Think in systems, not silos — you enjoy connecting dots across functions and making things flow. Are analytical and execution-focused — equally comfortable in spreadsheets and on the floor with teams. Have an engineering background and you love to solve hard problems. jdEvidence.value: Shape and execute OpenAI’s partner strategy in India, with a major focus on building a high-impact AWS-centered go-to-market motion.
Generate partner-sourced opportunities and deliver customer wins.

normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationRemote Full job descriptionAbout the Team The APAC Partnerships team builds and grows a high-impact partner ecosystem that helps customers adopt OpenAI solutions successfully, advances OpenAI’s mission, and supports the company’s growth. About the Role We are hiring a Partner Director to shape and execute OpenAI’s partner strategy in India, with a major focus on building a high-impact AWS-centered go-to-market motion. You will work closely with AWS and a prioritised ecosystem of services partners to generate partner-sourced opportunities, deliver customer wins, and develop repeatable solutions. You will translate the broader APAC AWS strategy into a practical India operating plan, aligning AWS field teams, services partners, and OpenAI teams around the most valuable opportunities. This is a hands-on role with responsibility across the full services-partner lifecycle: identifying and prioritising prospective partners, leading contracting, activating newly signed partners, growing strategic relationships, and managing performance. You will work with a mix of India-headquartered and global services partners, selecting the right portfolio based on market needs. You will build senior executive relationships while also driving the operating rhythms required to turn partnerships into measurable results. This role reports to the APAC Partnerships Lead in Singapore and is based in India. In this role you will: Contribute to and partially own the India partner strategy and annual operating plan, with a primary focus on AWS. Translate the APAC AWS partnership strategy into local priorities, target accounts, partner activation plans, and measurable outcomes for India. Build strong relationships with AWS India leadership and its partner, sales, and technical teams. Mobilise a prioritised portfolio of services partners around the OpenAI and AWS opportunity in India. Identify, evaluate, recruit, and contract with services partners based on market needs and strategic priorities. Own the contracting process end to end, coordinating with legal, finance, and leadership teams through approval and signature. Drive joint account planning and field engagement with AWS and priority services partners to grow partner-sourced opportunities and deliver customer wins. Manage strategic relationships with both India-headquartered partners and the India or regional leadership teams of global partners. Drive partner onboarding across sales training, technical enablement, security and provisioning, and support operations. Collaborate with AWS, services partners, and internal teams to develop repeatable solutions, customer propositions, demo assets, delivery playbooks, and localised technical documentation. Establish governance for priority partnerships, including operating reviews, executive business reviews, milestone tracking, and escalation processes. Build scalable operating processes for the India partner ecosystem, including reporting, playbooks, activation plans, and performance management. Monitor partner performance, identify risks early, and drive remediation or acceleration plans. Coordinate across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Enablement, Operations, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure internal alignment and partner success. Coordinate with Marketing on AWS-related launches, campaigns, enablement activities, and market-facing events. Represent OpenAI with senior partner executives and at relevant external events. Travel regularly across India, with occasional travel across APAC and to the United States. You might thrive in this role if you have: 10+ years of experience in partnerships, alliances, partner success, or enterprise sales within enterprise software, consulting, or systems-integration environments. Demonstrated experience building partner-led go-to-market motions with AWS, ideally within the Indian enterprise market. A strong understanding of the AWS ecosystem, including how hyperscaler field teams, partner organisations, and services partners work together to generate and convert customer opportunities. Experience building and growing a portfolio of services partners, from initial identification and contracting through activation and scaled execution. Strong knowledge of the Indian enterprise ecosystem and experience working with both local and global partner organisations. A track record of influencing partner-sourced growth, supporting customer wins, and developing repeatable solutions. The ability to translate a regional partnership strategy into local account priorities, partner plans, and operating cadences. Experience managing senior executive relationships while remaining comfortable working through operational details. Strong commercial judgement and the ability to prioritise investments across a diverse partner landscape. Excellent program-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and hold cross-functional stakeholders accountable. Experience operating in an early-stage or high-growth environment where processes are still being built. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence without authority and drive urgency with empathy. Professional fluency in English. Preferred Experience working with AI products, AI-enabled solutions, or an emerging technology ecosystem. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

normalizedText: Job highlights-Innovate and implement solutions to enhance the customer experience with digital productsJob match scoreEarly ApplicantKeyskillsLocationWork ExperienceJob description Key Responsibilities: Regional Leadership: -Develop and implement regional strategies to drive digital adoption in alignment with national goals. -Set performance targets for the region and ensure alignment with the bankdigital business objectives. -Lead, mentor, and support Area Heads and their teams to achieve organizational goals. Program Management: -Oversee the planning and execution of digital adoption programs and campaigns across the region. -Ensure effective resource deployment to maximize customer onboarding and digital product usage. -Monitor and evaluate program effectiveness, making necessary adjustments for improvement. Team Management: -Manage a regional team, including Area Heads and their respective teams of Digital Banking Champions and Team Leaders. -Foster a collaborative and high-performance culture within the regional team. -Provide training, support, and development opportunities to enhance team capabilities. Stakeholder Engagement: -Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless implementation of digital adoption strategies. -Maintain strong relationships with bank branches, area offices, and corporate headquarters. -Represent the region in meetings and conferences, providing updates and insights on regional performance. Performance Monitoring: -Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to digital adoption within the region. -Analyze data to identify trends, areas for improvement, and success stories. -Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. Customer Focus: -Champion a customer centric approach in all regional digital adoption activities. -Address customer feedback and issues promptly to improve service quality. -Innovate and implement solutions to enhance the customer experience with digital products. Innovation and Continuous Improvement: -Identify and implement new technologies and processes to enhance digital adoption in the region. -Stay abreast of industry trends and best practices to ensure the region remains competitive. -Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize efficiency and effectiveness. Financial Management: -Prepare and manage the budget for Digital Banking Adoption Services within the region. -Monitor expenditures to ensure they align with financial goals and constraints. -Identify cost saving opportunities without compromising service quality. normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationPune, Maharashtra Full job descriptionAbout the Role Alan Scott LearniX is building India's next-generation AI-powered education ecosystem, delivering innovative learning solutions for schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutes, and enterprises. We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Marketing Head to lead our national marketing strategy, strengthen the LearniX brand, generate institutional business opportunities, and drive market expansion across India. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the national marketing strategy for LearniX products and services. Build the LearniX brand across schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutes, corporates, and government organizations. Generate high-quality institutional leads and convert them into long-term business opportunities. Lead B2B marketing campaigns across digital, offline, and event platforms. Build strategic partnerships with educational institutions, industry associations, NGOs, CSR organizations, and government bodies. Plan and execute seminars, workshops, exhibitions, education expos, and product launches. Coordinate closely with the Sales, Product, and Leadership teams to accelerate business growth. Develop innovative marketing campaigns using AI-driven tools and digital marketing platforms. Manage social media branding, PR activities, corporate communications, and promotional campaigns. Represent LearniX during client meetings, conferences, and national education events. Track marketing performance, ROI, lead generation metrics, and prepare management reports. Required Skills Excellent communication and presentation skills. Strong leadership and team management abilities. Proven experience in B2B marketing and institutional sales. Knowledge of digital marketing, branding, CRM, and marketing automation tools. Ability to create strategic marketing plans and execute them independently. Strong networking and relationship-building skills. Willingness to travel extensively across India. Experience Required Minimum 5–10 years in Marketing, Business Development, Education Technology, B2B Sales, or Brand Management. Preferred Experience Candidates having experience in any of the following industries will be preferred: Education Technology (EdTech), AI Products & SaaS, School ERP/LMS, Educational Publishing, Digital Learning Solutions, Corporate Training, Technology Products, Enterprise Sales Work Location: In person

LocationPune, Maharashtra Full job description About Ugaoo Ugaoo is India’s leading gardening and home-grown lifestyle brand, building a deeper connection between people and plants. What started as a horticulture-first business has evolved into a full-stack D2C ecosystem, with our website serving as a key growth engine where customers across the country discover plants, gardening essentials, and plant care solutions. Alongside our D2C platform, Ugaoo also reaches customers through select offline (Retail, Corporate Gifting, Services & Maintenance) and marketplace channels. As we continue to scale, our focus remains on building a category-defining brand that makes gardening accessible, enjoyable, and aspirational for modern consumers. About the Role We are looking for a D2C Growth Lead who will own and scale revenue from the company’s website by optimizing the entire digital customer journey — from traffic acquisition to conversion and repeat purchases. This role will be responsible for driving website growth through performance marketing alignment, conversion optimization, product storytelling, and data-led experimentation. The ideal candidate combines analytical thinking with strong customer intuition and has a deep understanding of how D2C brands convert traffic into revenue. Responsibilities 1. Website Revenue & Growth Ownership Own and drive revenue growth from the website through continuous optimization of the digital sales funnel. Define and track key metrics including conversion rate, AOV, CAC, ROAS, and repeat purchase rate. Build monthly and quarterly growth plans aligned with business revenue targets. 2. Customer Journey & Conversion Optimization Own the end-to-end customer journey on the website, ensuring a seamless and high-conversion experience. Identify friction points across product discovery, add-to-cart, checkout, and payment flows. Lead A/B testing and experimentation across landing pages, PDPs, messaging, and checkout experience to improve conversion rates. 3. Performance Marketing Alignment Work closely with the performance marketing team and external agencies to ensure high-quality traffic acquisition. Align marketing campaigns with product priorities, seasonal launches, and growth objectives. Monitor funnel metrics and continuously improve traffic quality and conversion efficiency. 4. Creative Strategy for Ads & Campaigns Collaborate with internal design teams and agencies to develop high-performing ad creatives and campaign content. Provide clear creative briefs, campaign messaging, and performance feedback to improve ad performance. Ensure marketing communication clearly highlights product value propositions and customer benefits. 5. Product Storytelling & PDP Optimization Lead the optimization of Product Detail Pages (PDPs) to maximize conversion. Develop compelling product storytelling, benefit-driven content, FAQs, images, and videos that help customers make purchase decisions. Ensure product pages effectively communicate usage guidance, differentiation, and key selling points. 6. Product Merchandising & Website Campaigns Manage website merchandising including category pages, product prioritization, bundles, and seasonal collections. Collaborate with product and supply chain teams to align campaigns with inventory availability and demand trends. Build high-converting landing pages and promotional campaigns for launches and seasonal events. 7. Data Analytics & Growth Insights Track and analyze website performance metrics and user behavior using analytics tools. Build dashboards and reports to track growth performance, campaign effectiveness, and conversion insights. Translate data into actionable growth experiments and optimization initiatives. 8. Experimentation & Continuous Growth Drive a culture of rapid experimentation across marketing campaigns, landing pages, pricing, and product positioning. Run structured growth experiments to unlock new acquisition and conversion opportunities. Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition efficiency and lifetime value. Key Skills & Experience 6–8 years of experience in D2C growth, or performance marketing roles. Strong understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and digital funnel analytics. Experience working with performance marketing platforms (Meta, Google, etc.). Hands-on experience with analytics tools such as GA4, marketing dashboards, and customer behavior insights. Ability to combine data-driven decision-making with creative experimentation. Experience working in fast-paced startup or high-growth environments. What We’re Looking For A growth-first mindset with strong ownership of revenue outcomes. Someone who understands how traffic converts into revenue on a D2C website. Ability to connect marketing, product, and customer insights to drive growth. A builder who enjoys experimenting, optimizing, and scaling digital growth engines. Join us, and help shape the future of gardening and grow with us, because Plants Grow People.

normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.PayUp to ₹5,00,000 a yearJob typeFull-time LocationMohali, Punjab Full job descriptionJob Title: Digital Marketing Manager – Brand Visibility & Organic Growth Location: Mohali – Phase 8 B, Sector 74 (On-site, full-time) Experience Required: 4–8 years in B2B digital marketing (SaaS / technology products preferred) Reporting: Directly to Founder & CEO Employment Type: Full-time | Monthly salary + performance-linked incentives About Confiex Data Room Confiex Data Room Private Limited is India’s longest-serving and most trusted Virtual Data Room (VDR) provider with 18+ years of experience in secure document sharing. We specialize in supporting high-stakes processes such as M&A due diligence, NCLT/IBC insolvency resolutions (90+ cases), banking, real estate, compliance, e-tenders, and IPOs (100+). Our platforms emphasize enterprise-grade security, compliance (ISO 9001/27001, DPDPA, Startup India), and AI-powered features like redaction, summarization, and real-time collaboration. Trusted by major banks, corporates, and resolution professionals, we deliver affordable, India-first secure data room solutions with full data sovereignty. To learn more about us, visit www.confiexdataroom.com. About the Role We are looking for an experienced B2B Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale the organic brand visibility, content authority, and qualified lead pipeline for our Virtual Data Room platforms. This is a hands-on, results-driven role focused on long-term organic growth — SEO, content, review platforms, LinkedIn & X presence, backlinks, website authority, and systematic lead generation & qualification. You will work closely with Sales and Support teams, own clear monthly and quarterly targets, and use data to continuously improve performance. Key Responsibilities Brand Visibility & Organic Growth Own end-to-end organic strategy for our VDR platforms across SEO, content, listings, and social channels. Develop and execute keyword strategy, technical SEO, on-page optimisation, Google Sitemaps, Search Console monitoring, and site architecture improvements. Build high-quality backlinks through outreach, guest posts, digital PR, and industry partnerships. Continuously enhance website content, structure, and conversion paths to improve organic traffic, engagement, and lead conversion. Review & Listing Platforms Manage and grow presence on Capterra, G2, and other relevant B2B software review platforms. Drive genuine reviews, optimise profiles, respond to feedback, and improve ranking/visibility. Monitor competitor listings and positioning on these platforms. Content & Thought Leadership Plan and produce high-quality, SEO-optimised content: blogs, case studies, comparison pages, guides, LinkedIn carousels/posts, and X content. Maintain consistent publishing calendar and ensure content supports both brand authority and lead generation. Position the company as a trusted Indian VDR expert (especially in M&A, insolvency/NCLT, banking, and real estate due diligence). Social & Community Engagement Own LinkedIn (primary B2B channel) and X strategy — organic posting, engagement, community building, and thought leadership. Grow meaningful engagement and follower quality rather than vanity metrics. Lead Generation, Qualification & Handover Design and run organic lead generation systems (content upgrades, gated assets, website CTAs, LinkedIn lead forms, etc.). Qualify inbound leads using clear criteria and pass high-quality opportunities to the Sales team with proper context and tracking. Maintain clean lead tracking, feedback loops with Sales, and conversion reporting. Cross-functional Collaboration & Feedback Loops Regularly coordinate with Sales and Support teams to gather market feedback, objection insights, win/loss learnings, and content ideas. Translate sales/support inputs into better content, messaging, and targeting. Competitive Intelligence Continuously track competitor digital strategies (SEO rankings, content, review scores, messaging, campaigns, and positioning). Provide actionable insights and recommendations. Measurement, Reporting & Reviews Define and track clear KPIs (organic traffic, keyword rankings, backlinks, review scores, content performance, MQLs/SQLs generated, lead-to-opportunity conversion, engagement metrics, etc.). Use tools such as Google Analytics 4, Search Console, Ahrefs/SEMrush, LinkedIn Analytics, CRM, and review platform dashboards. Present structured monthly progress reports and quarterly business reviews with clear wins, gaps, and next-quarter plans. Maintain transparent dashboards for leadership visibility. Required Experience & Skills 4–8 years of hands-on B2B digital marketing experience, preferably in SaaS, enterprise software, or technology products. Proven track record of growing organic traffic, rankings, and qualified leads for B2B products. Strong practical experience in SEO (technical + content + off-page), content marketing, and LinkedIn/X organic growth. Direct experience managing Capterra, G2, or similar B2B review platforms. Comfortable owning lead generation systems and working closely with Sales on qualification and handover. Excellent written English and ability to create clear, professional B2B content. Data-driven mindset with experience using marketing analytics and reporting tools. Ability to work independently, prioritise, and deliver against monthly/quarterly targets in a lean, founder-led environment. Prior experience coordinating with Sales and Support/Customer Success teams. Preferred Experience in the Virtual Data Room, secure collaboration, legal-tech, fintech, or compliance software space. Familiarity with Indian B2B buying cycles (banking, corporate, insolvency professionals, real estate). Basic understanding of HubSpot or similar CRM + marketing automation. Experience building backlink profiles and digital PR for B2B brands. What Success Looks Like Measurable improvement in organic visibility (rankings, traffic, domain authority). Stronger presence and higher rankings/reviews on Capterra & G2. Consistent flow of qualified leads passed to Sales with clear tracking and feedback. High-quality content engine that supports both brand and pipeline. Transparent monthly and quarterly reporting with clear progress against agreed KPIs. Questions? jdEvidence.value: Product Owner for a new data product focused on delivering Data & Analytics for Learning@BCG, supporting HR functions and enabling reporting, analytics, and personalization.

normalizedText: Who We AreBoston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.What You'll DoThe People Digital Product Portfolio is the largest & most dynamic product portfolio within BCG’s Digital Products Organization. We enable the global technology for BCG’s entire HR & People Function including Recruiting; Talent Management (Staffing, Mobility, & Career Development); L&D and Teaming; and Core HR (including Workday & Compensation). Over the past two years, the HR Product Portfolio has more than doubled in size, and there is more growth to come.With this growth comes amazing new leadership opportunities, including the Product Owner for a new squad focused on delivering Data & Analytics for Learning@BCG. This product owner role will be responsible for a new data product, consolidating Learning completions and other HR data about Learners to support both reporting, analytics and agentic personalization.Initially, this role will be part of a larger Learning Transformation project. Long-term this role will be part of a growing suite of data products and analytics, focused on enabling our HR functions.As the Product Owner, you will represent the voice of the customer, manage stakeholder alignment, and oversee the squad's backlog to deliver impactful results. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and high data quality.Your Responsibilities IncludeDeliver business results and customer value Drive incremental delivery of features for the Learning Data Product, ensuring timely customer value creation. Monitor product performance metrics and adjust strategies based on insights. Support Learning reporting, analytics in the long-term. Prioritize impactful work to meet measurable Key Results for the squad. Manage the squad’s budget and collaborate with leadership on funding needs. Serve as the voice of the customer or end-user Gather and translate user needs into actionable user stories for Data & Analytics. Engage stakeholders to align expectations and enhance trust. Conduct ongoing discovery activities to identify pain points and opportunities. Balance customer value, cost, and execution speed in decision-making. Set an overall vision to direct and inform the squad’s work Bring a strong sense of ownership to the product squad and engage deeply in understanding the current and future needs of the function. Align squad activities with broader product and organizational goals. Translate objectives into a roadmap with clear goals. Foster collaboration with other Product Owners to ensure organizational alignment. Oversee what is delivered by the squad and when Apply design-thinking to understand system user engagement and solve problems effectively. Maintain a prioritized backlog of user stories with clear delivery timelines. Define acceptance criteria ensuring output meets business needs. Support and enable the squad to get its work done Collaborate with the squad to remove impediments and clarify requirements. Partner with Chapter Leads for resourcing and technical expertise. Provide performance feedback to squad members and cross-functional team members. What You'll Bring13+ years of overall professional experience, with 7+ years in a Product Owner or equivalent HR technology/product delivery roleExperience in managing data-driven products and analytics solutions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly with HR leadership. Agile product management expertise, with proven experience in leading Agile teams. Working knowledge of Snowflake and SQL sufficient to engage with technical teams and interpret data workflows.A data-driven mindset, leveraging insights for strategic decision-making. Knowledge of integrations, including API and data ingestion workflows is a plus. Experience in consulting, learning products or HR is a plus. Who You'll Work WithSquad members, as their Product Owner and guide. Internal customers, to understand and translate their needs into user stories. Product Team and Portfolio Leaders, for vision, roadmap, and budget alignment. Technical Area Leaders, for architectural alignment. Scrum Leads, to address operational challenges and maintain Agile workflows. Other Product Owners, for best practice sharing and cross-team alignment. Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Job Summary The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is responsible for leading the overall financial strategy, governance, and performance . The CFO will oversee financial planning, accounting, taxation, treasury,banking, budgeting, compliance, audits, risk management, project finance, investor relations, and business strategy. The role requires a commercially driven leader who can support business growth, optimize profitability, and ensure strong financial control across all business verticals. Key Responsibilities Financial Leadership . Develop and execute the Group's financial strategy aligned with business objectives. . Provide strategic financial advice to the Managing Director and Board. . Drive long-term financial planning and sustainable business growth. . Support mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and expansion initiatives. . Lead financial transformation and digitalization initiatives. Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) . Lead annual budgeting and business planning. . Develop rolling forecasts and long-term financial models. . Monitor business performance against budgets. . Conduct profitability, cost, and variance analysis. . Present financial insights and recommendations to senior management. Accounting & Financial Reporting . Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements. . Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting. . Ensure compliance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and applicable regulations. . Maintain robust accounting policies and internal controls. . Ensure timely financial closing. Treasury & Banking . Manage the Group& treasury operations. . Optimize working capital and cash flow. . Develop banking relationships. . Negotiate and manage: . Working Capital Limits . Term Loans . Bank Guarantees . Letters of Credit (LC) . Foreign Currency Facilities . Oversee fund utilization and liquidity planning. Taxation & Regulatory Compliance Ensure compliance with: . GST . Income Tax . TDS . Customs Regulations . FEMA . Companies Act . RBI Guidelines . MCA Filings . Transfer Pricing (if applicable) . Other statutory and regulatory requirements. Coordinate with tax consultants and authorities during assessments and audits. Audit & Internal Controls  Lead statutory, internal, tax, and cost audits.  Strengthen internal financial controls.  Develop and implement financial policies and SOPs.  Monitor compliance across all business units.  Ensure effective risk mitigation processes. Project Finance & Capital Investment  Evaluate capital expenditure (CAPEX) proposals.  Conduct investment appraisals, ROI, IRR, and NPV analysis.  Support financing for manufacturing expansion and EPC projects.  Monitor project profitability and financial performance.  Oversee project funding and lender compliance. Commercial & Business Finance  Evaluate commercial contracts and pricing strategies.  Support procurement and sales teams with financial insights.  Improve business margins through cost optimization.  Review customer credit limits and payment terms.  Drive profitability improvement initiatives. Risk Management  Identify financial, operational, legal, and market risks.  Develop enterprise risk management frameworks.  Monitor foreign exchange exposure and commodity price risks.  Ensure adequate insurance coverage.  Establish business continuity and financial contingency plans. Team Leadership  Lead Finance, Accounts, Taxation, Treasury, and Commercial Finance teams.  Build a high-performance finance function.  Mentor and develop finance professionals.  Define KPIs and performance objectives.  Foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Stakeholder Management Collaborate with:  Managing Director  Board of Directors  Investors  Banks & Financial Institutions  Auditors  Legal Advisors  Government Authorities  Customers  Vendors  Department Heads to support strategic and operational decision-making. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)  EBITDA and Net Profit Growth  Budget Accuracy  Cash Flow Management  Working Capital Efficiency  Return on Capital Employed (ROCE)  Return on Investment (ROI)  Debt-Equity Management  Timely Financial Reporting  Audit Compliance  Tax Compliance  Cost Reduction Initiatives  Project Profitability  Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)  Inventory Turnover  Internal Control Effectiveness Required Qualifications  Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory.  MBA (Finance) preferred.  Additional qualifications such as CFA or CMA will be an advantage. Experience  15 years of progressive experience in finance and accounts.  Minimum 5 years in a senior finance leadership role (CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, or Head of Finance).  Experience in manufacturing, renewable energy, EPC, infrastructure, or industrial sectors is highly preferred.  Proven experience in strategic finance, banking, treasury, taxation, and corporate governance. Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹166,000.00 per month Work Location: In person
