Chat Operations Manager is responsible for leading and optimizing the performance of customer service team focused on chat interactions. This role drives the achievement of key digital customer service indicators (KPIs), ensures efficient handling of chat volumes, and maintains a consistently high-quality customer experience across all chat channels. The manager will lead, develop, and mentor their agents, implement strategic initiatives for chat operations, and foster a culture of digital excellence and continuous improvement.Key Responsibilities:Operational Leadership: Oversee the daily operations of customer service team, ensuring optimal staffing, efficient chat queue management, and adherence to digital communication policies and procedures.Performance Management: Establish, monitor, and achieve critical chat-specific customer service KPIs, including Average Response Time (ART), Concurrent Chat Handling, Chat Abandonment Rate, Quality Assurance (QA) scores for written interactions, and First Contact Resolution (FCR) in digital channels. Develop and implement strategies to enhance these metrics.Team Development & Coaching: Lead, coach, and mentor team members focusing on effective written communication, tone, multi-tasking skills in a chat environment, and efficient use of chat tools and resources. Conduct regular performance reviews and identify development opportunities.Strategy & Planning: Contribute to the strategic development and execution of digital customer service initiatives, including integrating new chat technologies, optimizing chat flows, and exploring AI/chatbot synergies to improve efficiency and customer experience.Process Improvement: Identify areas for improvement within chat operations, implement best practices for digital engagement, streamline chat processes (e.g., template usage, knowledge base integration), and reduce resolution times. Drive continuous improvement based on data analysis and customer feedback.Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Technology, Bot team and Quality Assurance to ensure seamless integration of chat channels and alignment with overall business goals.Reporting & Analysis: Analyze chat interaction data, generate comprehensive reports on team performance, chat trends, and bot performance. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management for strategic decision-making.Issue Resolution: Serve as an escalation point for complex or sensitive customer issues encountered via chat, ensuring timely and effective resolution while upholding service standards.Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure all chat operations comply with internal policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements pertaining to digital communication and data privacy. Identify and mitigate potential operational risksProjects & Initiatives: Lead and participate in various projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing the chat platform, introducing new features, improving agent tools, or integrating with other digital channels to elevate the overall digital customer experience.Qualifications:Education: Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree preferred.Experience: Minimum of 10+ years of progressive experience in customer service operations, with at least 6+ years in a leadership role managing customer service team (people manager)Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment and manage multiple digital priorities effectively.Leadership Skills: Strong leadership, motivational, and coaching abilities, with a track record of developing high-performing teams in a digital context.Analytical Skills: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret digital interaction data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.Communication: Exceptional written communication skills, with a keen understanding of digital communication etiquette, brand voice, and clarity. Strong verbal communication for internal leadership.Technical Proficiency: Proficient in chat management systems, knowledge base systems, and familiarity with AI/chatbot technologies. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.Desired Attributes:Strategic thinker with an ability to anticipate future trends in digital customer service.Proactive and results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership over digital channels.Ability to inspire and influence others towards achieving digital excellence.High level of integrity and professionalism.------------------------------------------------------Job Family Group: Operations - Core------------------------------------------------------Job Family:Operations Support------------------------------------------------------Time Type:------------------------------------------------------Most Relevant SkillsPlease see the requirements listed above.------------------------------------------------------Other Relevant SkillsFor complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.------------------------------------------------------Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review Accessibility at Citi.View Citi’s EEO Policy Statement and the Know Your Rights poster. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. partnerships as part of overall brand strategy.Interpret insights, learnings, data/tool outputs and drive brand strategic recommendationsInteract with diverse specialist teams, engaging them to work investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. normalizedText: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 3,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.Sprint With SprintersAt Sprinto, your work has purpose — and your life has space. We are a workplace where you’re empowered to execute on your most ambitious ideas and deliver your best output in a fast-paced, innovative, and supportive environment.Joining Sprinto means you will never run alone; you will always have the freedom to take your shot and the support to go farther than you imagined.What The Role Involves:At Sprinto, partnerships are the backbone of our revenue strategy. As the Director of Strategic Alliances & Channel Partnerships, you will play a critical role in developing, managing, and scaling strategic relationships with key identified partners . Your primary objective? Fuel Sprinto’s growth by owning and driving 25% of the company's revenue. You’ll have the opportunity to build a high-performing ecosystem of partners and help Sprinto achieve success on a global scale.What Your Impact Will Look Like:Partnership Strategy: Lead the development and execution of Sprinto’s strategic alliances and channel partnership strategies, focusing on creating new revenue channels and shall be responsible for designing, optimising & scaling the partner programsPartner Acquisition: Identify, recruit, and onboard new partners, including but not limited to : - MSPs, MSSPs, GSIs, and Consulting Partners, with a focus on driving significant revenue growthRelationship Building: Cultivate deep relationships with partner C-suite executives and decision-makers, driving collaborative efforts and mutual successJoint Sales & GTM Programs: Design and implement joint sales and go-to-market (GTM) strategies with partners, increasing Sprinto’s market penetrationNegotiation & Contracts: Lead contract negotiations, growth plans, and deal structuring with partners, ensuring terms are mutually beneficialRevenue Growth: Own partnership-driven revenue targets, managing the end-to-end partner lifecycle from prospecting to revenue generationPerformance Optimisation: Evaluate partner performance through regular business reviews, recommending improvements to enhance mutual valueCross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, product marketing, and solutions teams to ensure partner programs are fully supported with the right tools and resourcesMentor & Enable: Act as a mentor to internal teams and partners, offering coaching and enablement to drive resultsBuilding team: Ability to build the partnership team ground up, is actively involved in forecasting the resources requirements and collaborates with the Talent Acquisition team to hire best for the teamDashboard & Reporting: Track and report on the success of partnerships using CRM and other sales intelligence systemsWhat You’ll Bring To The Team:Experience: normalizedText: Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup building a real-time transportation visibility platform for global supply chains. We help shippers, manufacturers, and logistics service providers turn data into decisions and decisions into measurable business impact.Our platform goes beyond visibility. Portcast enables action at scale by surfacing the right risks early, helping teams prevent detention and demurrage, accelerate exception management, and close invoices faster with built-in evidence. We turn visibility into outcomes: reduced costs, improved operational control, and more predictable supply chains.Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of marketers, software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to make supply chains not just visible, but decisively actionable, end to end.About The RolePortcast is already trusted by global freight forwarders, manufacturers, and cargo airlines. Marketing is how we tell that story to the rest of the industry, fill the pipeline, and make our product impossible to ignore. We want a Marketing Director who can do both: set the strategy and roll up their sleeves to ship it.Reporting directly to the CEO, you will own the marketing function end to end and lead a lean team consisting of a Growth Marketing Manager and a Content Marketing Manager. This is not a role where you inherit a large organization or simply review campaigns.Product Marketing will be your primary area of ownership. You'll partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions to launch new capabilities, refine our positioning, build compelling messaging, and equip our commercial teams with the assets they need to win. You'll also own our events strategy, deciding where Portcast shows up and ensuring every event creates measurable business impact.This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building. You are comfortable switching between strategic planning and hands-on execution, thrive in fast moving startup environments, and naturally take ownership without waiting for direction. You're curious about our domain, excited by AI, and enjoy learning the nuances of logistics and supply chains to tell better product stories.What You’ll OwnMarketing strategy and direction: Take company goals and what the CEO, Sales, and Product need, turn it into a clear, prioritized marketing plan and translate business priorities into clear quarterly marketing plans with measurable goals, ensuring every initiative contributes to pipeline growth, customer expansion, or brand awareness. Product marketing: Own Portcast's product marketing strategy from positioning through launch execution. Work closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Solutions, and customers to deeply understand new capabilities, identify differentiated messaging, and bring new products and features to market. Build sales enablement materials, competitive positioning, customer stories, and launch plans that help our Commercial team succeed. Build positioning, messaging, launch plans, sales enablement, customer communications, and supporting campaigns that help customers understand the value of what we're building. We don't want marketing to simply receive launch requests. We want someone who actively drives the launch process, challenges whether we're telling the right story, and ensures great product work never goes unnoticed. Event marketing: Decide which events are worth attending or sponsoring each quarter, own organizer outreach and logistics, and make sure we show up where our buyers are. Cross Functional Leadership: Partner closely with the CEO, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions to align marketing with business priorities. Proactively identify opportunities for launches, campaigns, and market education instead of waiting for requests. You'll be expected to navigate pressure from multiple stakeholders, prioritize effectively, communicate trade offs clearly, and ensure marketing consistently delivers the highest business impact. Team leadership: Lead and mentor a lean team of two marketers. Set clear priorities, coach team members, provide regular feedback, raise the quality bar across marketing, and create an environment where people continue to grow while maintaining high execution standards. Data-driven decisions: Own the inbound pipeline and every lever in it. Measure what matters, find the right insights, and reallocate spend and effort to what's working. Your reporting should make trade-offs obvious. What We’re Looking ForBachelor's or Master's in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent. Enterprise B2B SaaS Marketing: You have significant experience leading marketing within an enterprise B2B SaaS environment. You understand complex buying committees, long sales cycles, and how marketing contributes to revenue growth beyond lead generation. Product Marketing Expertise: You have a strong product marketing foundation with experience owning positioning, messaging, go to market strategy, product launches, customer storytelling, and sales enablement. You know how to turn technical products into compelling business narratives. Ownership and Initiative: You naturally spot opportunities before others do. You don't wait for someone to ask you to market a new feature, write a customer story, or launch a campaign. You proactively identify what matters, build momentum across teams, and drive initiatives through to completion with minimal direction. Curiosity for Logistics Domain: You enjoy learning technical domains and quickly becoming fluent in new industries. Experience in logistics, supply chain, transportation, or freight technology is highly valued, but equally important is a genuine curiosity to understand our customers, products, competitive landscape and market in depth. Marketing leadership: Proven senior marketing experience in B2B SaaS selling into the enterprise. You have led marketing and can point to pipeline and revenue impact, not just activity. You are fluent in marketing metrics such as CAC, CPL, LTV, MQL-to-SQL Growth and demand generation: You have a good working understanding of performance marketing and the key metrics behind it (CAC, CPL, LTV, MQL-to-SQL). The Growth Marketing Manager will own execution, day-to-day delivery, and experiment design. Your role is to stay close to performance, provide input where needed, and ensure work is aligned to broader business priorities. Content quality and standards: Execution and production of content will sit with the Content Marketing Manager, while your role is to guide direction, review output, and set them to a higher standard. AI Forward Mindset: You consistently apply AI across advanced marketing workflows and actively experiment with new tools as they emerge. Startup Builder Mentality: You thrive in lean, fast moving environments where ownership is high and resources are limited. You're comfortable balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution and enjoy building processes, programs, and marketing assets yourself when needed. Cross Functional Influence: You work effectively across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, navigating competing priorities, and driving alignment across teams. People leader and mentor: You develop the people around you. You give honest feedback and care about your team's growth as much as their output. Strong communicator: You communicate clearly across a diverse, distributed, cross-cultural team. You can be opinionated, but you engage with other views and compromise when it's right. You can simplify complex ideas, influence stakeholders, and build trust across diverse groups. What’s In It For YouBuild in an industry that's still defining modern B2B marketing: Logistics & supply chain technology is at an exciting stage of digital transformation, with significant opportunities to rethink how enterprise software is marketed. We believe curiosity, strong product marketing fundamentals, and the ability to learn quickly matter more than prior logistics experience. You'll have the opportunity to bring fresh ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and help shape what great marketing looks like in this industry. Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: Work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Our diversity of perspectives fuels how we market and keeps us curious. Visibility & Impact: With a lean structure, your work is effective from day one, owning one of the company's most strategic functions, you'll see your decisions move pipeline and revenue directly and shape how Portcast goes to market. You'll own marketing end to end, influence company strategy, and work alongside Product, Sales, and Customer Success to drive business growth. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll shape strategy while staying close to execution. From product launches and messaging to event strategy and GTM initiatives, you'll have the autonomy to move ideas from concept to impact without layers of approval. OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DOCuriosity: We dig into why a campaign worked or didn't, why a buyer behaves the way they do, not just what to ship next. We seek to understand customers, products, markets, and results at a deeper level. Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait to be told what to market, and we stay on a problem until it actually moves the number. Raising the bar: We don't settle for content or campaigns that are merely fine. We hold a high standard for quality, craft, and the experience our brand creates. Effectiveness: We focus on marketing that creates real pipeline and revenue impact. We prioritize the right problems, make practical trade-offs, and ship work that drives outcomes, not just output. Join us at Portcast and help shape the future of the logistics and shipping industry through marketing that is as sharp as the product behind it.We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. normalizedText: LocationHyderabad, Telangana Full job description Zuddl is the unified events platform that gives B2B marketing teams complete ownership of their brand, their data, and their pipeline impact — across conferences, field events, webinars, and trade shows. Instead of duct-taping point solutions together or waiting on agencies and web dev queues, teams at Figma, CrowdStrike. Iterable, and Grafana Labs use Zuddl to design pixel-perfect event experiences, launch programs in minutes, and prove revenue impact back to the business — all from one platform they actually control. What YOU WILL DO You own end-to-end demand creation across our multi-product platform, with one clear objective: 2–3× YoY revenue growth. Multi-Product Demand Engine - Design and execute demand strategies across Zuddl's modular platform (webinars, field events, conferences, third-party events). You'll build systems that drive both new customer acquisition and expansion across product lines. Team Leadership- Build and lead a high-caliber demand team with clear channel ownership and minimal handoffs. You'll hire for judgment and autonomy, using AI and automation to eliminate low-judgment work. Channel Portfolio Management - Own paid search, paid social, SEO, content, events/community, and emerging channels. You'll make explicit trade-offs based on marginal pipeline contribution, not historical momentum. BDR Function - Own the BDR outcome end-to-end in partnership with sales, including ICP definition, sequencing, AI-assisted outbound, and conversion mechanics. ABM & Orchestration - Design account-centric plays that coordinate events, digital channels, outreach, and content to collapse buyer indecision across the buying committee. Market Gravity Creation - Ideate and direct the creation of free tools, benchmarks, and interactive growth assets that generate authentic demand at scale. What We're Looking For Experience: 5–8+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation, with demonstrated success building scalable demand engines Track record of managing both channels and teams in high-growth environments Experience with multi-product or platform marketing (not single-SKU SaaS) Proven ability to forecast and deliver pipeline commitments How You Think: Systems thinker who designs for compounding returns, not just campaign outcomes First principles approach to strategy; willing to challenge "best practices" Comfortable making trade-offs between competing priorities Data-informed but not paralyzed by analysis How You Operate: High agency: You translate business objectives into execution plans without needing detailed direction Bias to action: You ship and iterate rather than wait for perfect information Early problem surfacing: You flag risks and blockers before they become critical Comfortable with accountability: You're on the hook for numbers and own both wins and misses What Success Looks Like Predictable pipeline across segments that sales commits to and converts Channels managed by returns, with data-driven optimization and portfolio rebalancing Marketing is trusted to commit and deliver on pipeline and revenue forecasts Why You Want To Work Here Competitive compensation Employee Friendly ESOPs Remote working with an option to rent coworking spaces Flexible Leave Program Home Workstation Setup A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity Ground floor opportunity at a fast-growing series A startup

normalizedText: Role PurposeThe role of the Project Manager is to assist with and, where required, to co-ordinate planning & execution of transformation projects according to strict deadlines and within budget. This includes coordinating the efforts of team members and third-party contractors or consultants in order to deliver projects according to plan. The Project Manager will be able to work independently or with the Program Managers through the project initiation process, help to oversee quality control throughout the project’s life cycle and formal closure and review for each project.Key responsibilities include:Engage with stakeholders companywide to understand and advise on their objectives and problems. Support the delivery of benefits from transformational programs or projects, taking ownership from start to finish. Build and maintain effective communications with key stakeholders, cross functional leaders and project team members. Lead or support project activities, plans, and schedules associated with deliverables and milestones. Manage the project execution to deliver tangible deliverables within businesses and support functions. Support knowledge management efforts with clients and within the team. Work with the relevant business area in helping to identify other areas of transformation opportunity within the same project or business area. Utilize project management disciplines and where necessary provide input to improve the processes and documents within project management systems. Preferably have previous experience in one or more relevant areas [e.g., Operating Model Design, Process Design & Optimization, Change Management & Communications]. The CandidateThe successful candidate will combine the ability to lead multiple teams/workstreams with project management skills and prior experience delivering the benefits of transformational change.The candidate needs a demonstrable and highly commercial mind-set, strong financial acumen in addition to excellent listening and communication skills. A logical, structured approach to problem solving and common sense are key.ExperienceProfessional experience, ideally with a top-tier strategy consulting firm and/or with a firm with a well-established transformation agenda. Direct experience of major international business transformation projects. Excellent analytical and program management skills are essential. Commercially and financially astute, comfortable with company P&L and, ideally, also balance sheet. Diverse industry and functional backgrounds gained through consulting or elsewhere. Understanding of or exposure to global real estate markets preferred but not essential. Ability to effectively design, gain alignment and successfully execute significant transformation change initiatives from project start to finish. Change/Leadership SkillsLeadership Skills: exceptional communication skills coupled with excellent active listening skills. Ability to clearly articulate messages to a variety of audiences. Establish and maintain strong relationships on all levels of organisation. Influencing and teamwork: Ability to influence others and move toward a common vision or goal. Able to work effectively at all levels in an organization. Must be a team player and able to work collaboratively with and through others. Project Management Skills: Knows how to effectively structure, staff and manage projects and teams to insure there is clarity of expectation, timely execution, corrective action when needed and successful outcomes. Analytical Skills: Has a structured approach to problem solving with a natural inclination for planning strategy and tactics. Drives to fix the ultimate root causes to drive sustainable change. Character with high perseverance and resourcefulness required to keep driving and finding ways to get the required steps done. Flexible and adaptable; able to work in ambiguous situations. Resilient and tenacious with a propensity to persevere. Forward looking with a holistic approach. job descriptionLeading at Cognizant This is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level: Drive our business strategy and inspire teams around our future. Live the leadership behaviors , leading themselves, others and the business. Uphold our Values , role modeling them in every action and decision. Nurture our people and culture , creating a workplace where all can thrive. At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture. About the role As a Delivery Director (Head of GCC) , you will make an impact by leading large-scale BOTT, managed services, and transformation programs, enabling successful and expedited BOT/GCC setup and driving delivery excellence across complex enterprise engagements. You will be a valued member of the delivery leadership team and work collaboratively with business leaders, delivery teams, technology teams, functional stakeholders, and clients. In this role, you will: Lead large BOTT, managed services, and transformation programs, ensuring parallel execution across HR, infrastructure, security, real estate, risk and compliance, audits, hiring, transition, and transformation workstreams. Own delivery governance, PMO discipline, operating models, and transition frameworks to drive predictable outcomes across global, multi-shore delivery environments. Oversee application development, maintenance, IT operations, business operations, and business process transformation, including follow-the-sun delivery models. Drive automation, AI-enabled productivity transformation, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance delivery quality, efficiency, and business value. Lead and mentor Delivery Managers, Program Managers, Engineering leaders, and Operations leaders while building accountable, high-performing teams with a strong ownership culture. Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead, which means operating with Personal Leadership (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), Organizational Leadership (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and Business Leadership (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen) What you need to have to be considered 25+ years of overall IT, digital delivery, or enterprise technology delivery experience. 8–10+ years of experience leading large, multi-million-dollar enterprise engagements with P&L ownership and strong financial acumen. Strong experience in BOTT, managed services, GCC/BOT setup, large transformation programs, delivery governance, PMO, and operating models. Proven experience in banking or other regulated industries, with the ability to manage risk, compliance, audit, security, and client governance requirements. Experience managing global, multi-shore delivery models across application development, maintenance, IT operations, and business operations. Executive stakeholder management experience, including structured, data-driven communication, crisis and escalation management, and influence without authority. Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent qualification preferred. Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead : Leading Self, Leading Others, & Leading the Business The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The right Thing, & Own It These will help you succeed Experience driving automation, AI, and productivity transformation across delivery and operations environments. Strong transition and knowledge management experience across complex enterprise transformation programs. Ability to drive talent development, succession planning, attrition management, and a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement. Work model We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring presence in a Cognizant office in Bangalore . Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Our partner is looking for a Director, Solution and Product Marketing based in India.This role offers the opportunity to shape market strategy and define the narrative for innovative enterprise technology solutions at a global scale.You will sit at the intersection of product strategy, solution positioning, and go-to-market execution, helping organizations understand the value of complex platforms.Working closely with Product, Sales, Engineering, and Marketing teams, you will transform technical capabilities into compelling business outcomes.The position combines strategic storytelling, market influence, team leadership, and operational execution.You will play a key role in building category leadership, enabling sales teams, and driving adoption among enterprise customers.This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced product marketing leader who thrives in high-growth environments and enjoys creating meaningful business impact through technology.AccountabilitiesAs a Director, Solution and Product Marketing, you will lead the development of market positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies for key product and solution areas. You will act as a strategic partner across the organization, ensuring complex technologies are translated into clear value propositions that resonate with enterprise audiences.Own product and solution narratives by creating differentiated positioning, messaging frameworks, and value propositions for enterprise audiences.Lead solution and product marketing strategies across defined areas, including use cases, competitive intelligence, and market differentiation.Develop and execute go-to-market plans for product launches and strategic initiatives in collaboration with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Engineering teams.Create impactful sales enablement materials, including pitch decks, battle cards, solution briefs, technical content, and customer-facing resources.Support market influence initiatives by contributing to analyst relations and ensuring key industry influencers understand the organization’s positioning and vision.Translate complex technical concepts into compelling stories that address business challenges and customer outcomes.Partner with field teams, sales engineering, customer success, and ecosystem partners to improve market adoption and commercial effectiveness.Manage, mentor, and develop team members while maintaining high standards for strategic thinking, execution quality, and collaboration.Build alignment across global teams by adapting messaging and enablement approaches to different markets and customer contexts.Leverage customer insights, market trends, and performance data to continuously improve marketing strategies.RequirementsThe ideal candidate is a senior B2B technology marketing professional with deep experience in enterprise software, product marketing, and go-to-market strategy. You combine strategic vision, technical understanding, and strong leadership skills to influence customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.10+ years of experience in B2B enterprise software marketing, with at least 5 years in senior individual contributor or leadership roles across product marketing, solution marketing, or related functions.Proven experience creating and marketing solutions that address complex business challenges rather than focusing only on product features.Strong storytelling skills with the ability to simplify technical concepts while maintaining accuracy and credibility.Experience working in technical domains such as automation, AI/ML, developer tools, integration platforms, middleware, or related technologies.Demonstrated ability to lead go-to-market strategies and execute successful product launches in fast-paced environments.Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and executive leadership.Excellent executive communication and presentation abilities, including experience engaging with C-level audiences, analysts, and industry stakeholders.Experience managing, mentoring, or developing marketing professionals through direct leadership or project-based influence.Ability and willingness to use technology products directly and work effectively with AI-powered tools.Understanding of global enterprise ecosystems, including system integrators, regional integrators, cloud providers, and technology partners.Experience marketing to both technical audiences and senior business decision-makers is highly desirable.Experience in process automation, orchestration, BPM, or related enterprise technology categories is a strong advantage.Experience with analyst relations, including Gartner, Forrester, or similar organizations, is preferred.Experience working in high-growth, remote-first organizations is a plus.BenefitsCompetitive compensation package with location-based salary structures.Equity participation opportunities through a virtual stock option plan where applicable.Fully remote and flexible working environment with support for home office setup and coworking options.Flexible time off policies designed to support work-life balance.Opportunities to connect with global teams through company gatherings, team offsites, and community events.Health and wellbeing support, including healthcare benefits and global mental wellness resources.Flexible lifestyle benefits supporting personal wellbeing, family needs, professional interests, and financial wellness.Retirement and pension plans with company contributions where applicable.Life and disability insurance coverage where relevant.Annual professional development budget for normalizedText: Sutherland is a digital transformation company focused on delivering exceptional experiences for both customers and employees. For over 39 years, we have been entrusted with caring for our clients’ customers - a responsibility we believe we should earn every day. We are dedicated to making those experiences as delightful as possible - instantaneous, relevant, predictive and frictionless. As an early pioneer in robotic automation, we added to our core through steady investment and acquiring key capabilities. Our design capabilities marry human insight, design[1] thinking, and process engineering. To make these designs come to life as envisioned by our designers, we employ the latest in robotic automation, conversational AI techniques with a range of AI-ML enhanced products and cloud-based platforms. We believe that the best relationships come from trust and value. In addition to delivering exceptionally engineered experiences, we help our clients improve their productivity, reduce costs, enhance customer loyalty, build additional revenues, reduce time-to-market and efficiently enter new markets. We also stand by our results.We work with clients across industries, including Banking, Financial Services and Insurance, Healthcare, Retail, Telecommunications, Media & Entertainment, and Technology, as well as Travel, Hospitality and Logistics. normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationGurugram, Haryana Full job description Overview: 170+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact. At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence. Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our team of industry subject matter experts. The Operations Director – Pinkerton India leads end-to-end service delivery across Pinkerton’s EPIC portfolio (Embed, Protect, Investigate, Consult) to ensure outstanding client outcomes, rigorous accountability, and optimal cost-to-value. This role orchestrates multi-service operations, vendor/partner networks, and internal teams to deliver on-time, in-scope, and within-budget results. The Director drives a culture of ownership, safety, integrity, vigilance, and excellence while scaling processes, enhancing quality, and meeting or exceeding contractual SLAs and KPIs. Responsibilities: Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence. Serve as the senior operations point of contact for client accounts in India, aligning scope, priorities, and SLAs with Pinkerton’s EPIC model. Coordinate services and operational/administrative support needs; oversee dispatch, scheduling, and reporting across assignments and programs. Answer and triage escalations from clients, Directors, and Operations Coordinators, ensure swift, transparent communication and resolution. Communicate assignment/project expectations, timelines, risks, and success criteria to all parties; maintain impeccable documentation. Design, standardize, and enforce SOPs, operational playbooks for consistent delivery across regions and service lines. Manage workflows end-to-end; assign agents and specialist resources to specific assignments based on capability, compliance, and cost. Track program milestones and deadlines; monitor the status of assigned projects and initiate course-corrections proactively. Utilize scorecards to measure activities and outcomes (e.g., Deployable Assets programs), driving continuous improvement. Track results and issue reports on completed work, non-conformities, corrective and improvement plans; own CAPA closure. Ensure deadlines are met for scheduling, dispatching, audits, and post checks; verify outcomes (vendor hour approvals, virtual/onsite post checking). Send and manage external partner self-assessments and security questionnaires using approved web-based tools; drive timely completion and remediation. Lead root-cause analyses, implement preventive actions, and institutionalize lessons learned across teams and vendors. Build and govern a high-performing vendor ecosystem (including Global Alliance Members where applicable) with clear rate cards, SLAs, and compliance obligations. Negotiate, onboard, and performance-manage vendors; conduct QBRs, enforce service credits, and manage escalations to protect client outcomes and margin. Optimize vendor utilization, travel/logistics, and deployment patterns to balance speed, quality, risk, and cost. Own operational budgeting, forecasting, and margin protection; drive cost-per-outcome efficiency without compromising quality or safety. Implement demand planning, capacity models, and pricing/quoting discipline; monitor variance and initiate corrective actions. Improve invoice accuracy, WIP hygiene, and cycle times; partner with Finance on revenue recognition and profitability. Ensure compliance with PSARA, Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, Shops & Establishments, PoSH, client codes of conduct, and data privacy/information security requirements. Maintain audit readiness; coordinate internal/external audits and remediation plans. Champion agent safety through virtual and on-site post checks, journey management, and incident reporting protocols. Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing operations team; set clear goals and hold teams and vendors accountable. Foster a culture of integrity, vigilance, excellence, transparency, and client-obsession; recognize strong performance and address underperformance promptly. Drive change management and cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Finance, Legal, HR, and Regional Ops. All other duties, as assigned. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred. 12–15 years of progressive experience in corporate security/operations or adjacent services, including multi-vendor orchestration and client service delivery. Experience with escalation/crisis management, incident response coordination, and audit/quality systems. Certifications preferred: CPP, PSP, PMP, Lean Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt) or equivalent. Accountability and ownership mindset; data-driven decisioning; strong financial acumen. Vendor negotiation, rate-card governance, and performance management. Program/Project management, capacity planning, and resource optimization. Risk assessment, SOP design, and continuous improvement (Kaizen/CAPA/RCA). High integrity, vigilance, and excellence aligned to Pinkerton values. Fluency in English and Hindi; additional Indian languages an advantage. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence at executive level. Proven leadership of national programs with measurable SLA/KPI achievement and cost optimization. Strong knowledge of India regulatory environment (PSARA, CLRA, Shops & Establishments, PoSH) and client compliance expectations. Proficiency with scheduling/dispatch platforms, CRM/ITSM tools (e.g., Salesforce/ServiceNow), and collaboration suites. Advanced Excel; reporting/BI (Power BI/Tableau) for scorecards and operational insights. Web-based tools for self-assessments/security questionnaires; audit and document control systems. Working Conditions: With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions; Regular computer usage. Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment. Frequent sitting, standing, and/or walking. Travel, as required. Pinkerton is an equal opportunity employer to all applicants and positions without regard to race/ethnicity, color, national origin, ancestry, sex/gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital/prenatal status, pregnancy/childbirth or related conditions, religion, creed, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any protected status by local, state, federal or country-specific law.

normalizedText: Leading at CognizantThis is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level: Drive our business strategy and inspire teams around our future. Live the leadership behaviors, leading themselves, others and the business. Uphold our Values, role modeling them in every action and decision. Nurture our people and culture, creating a workplace where all can thrive.At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.The RoleCognizant helps companies modernize technology, reimagine processes and transform experiences so they stay ahead in a fast-changing world.Our Cognizant consulting group is looking for a Head of India Tech Consulting & Strategic Deals to join our journey. With a focus on delivering exceptional client solutions, the candidate will leverage their extensive experience to enhance business operations and foster innovation. This role requires a deep understanding of IT consulting, ensuring seamless integration of technology solutions to meet client needs and organizational goals.Every choice we make aligns to our vision: to become the pre-eminent technology services partner to the world’s top companies.At Cognizant, we are a high-performing team with heart. Our solutions are in demand and we’re passionate about making a difference. solutions ensuring they meet client specifications and enhance business operations.Provide expert guidance on IT consulting best practices fostering innovation and efficiency within client organizations.Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver comprehensive consulting services that drive business success.Analyze client needs and develop tailored IT solutions that address specific challenges and opportunities.Manage client relationships ensuring satisfaction and long-term partnership through effective communication and service delivery.Drive continuous improvement in consulting processes leveraging industry trends and insights to enhance service offerings.Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations maintaining the highest level of professionalism and integrity.Facilitate workshops and training sessions to empower client teams with the knowledge and skills needed for successful technology adoption.Monitor project progress and performance providing regular updates to stakeholders and adjusting strategies as needed.Utilize data analytics to assess the impact of consulting initiatives and identify areas for further optimization.Support business development efforts by identifying new opportunities and contributing to proposal development.Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing consulting team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead, which means operating with Personal Leadership (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), Organizational Leadership (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and Business Leadership (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen).What You Need To Have To Be Considered20+ years of experience effective technology solutions.Demonstrate excellent communication and interpersonal skills essential for managing client interactions and team collaboration.Hold a relevant degree in IT business or a related field showcasing a solid educational foundation.Show proficiency in data analytics tools and methodologies enhancing decision-making and strategy development.Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to role: Director – Head of CIB Consulting & Transformation (CIBC&T) India
normalizedText: Job Title: Director – Head of CIB Consulting & Transformation (CIBC&T) IndiaDepartment: CIB Consulting & Transformation (CIBC&T) IndiaAbout Business Line/FunctionCreated in 2009, BNP Paribas CIB Consulting & Transformation (CIBC&T) is an in-house management consultancy with a strong presence in EMEA (~100 consultants in Paris, Lisbon, and London) and a global reach thanks to an integrated network in APAC & Americas (~100 consultants).The team works on strategic initiatives defined by CIB Senior Management. It has a strong track record with 600+ projects accomplished to date. CIBC&T is a competitive alternative to leading, external consulting firms, covering the full consulting value chain: from framing, diagnosis, and delivery of actionable recommendations, to designing effective implementation and enabling change.BNP Paribas CIB Consulting & Transformation (CIBC&T) India is a newly created team, globally part of CIB Consulting & Transformation based in Paris and locally linked to the business management scope of BNP Paribas’ center of expertise India Solutions Private Limited (ISPL). Its goal is to advise BNP Paribas’ Management, participating in the framing, design and implementation of high-impact projects and operating models transformations aimed at supporting global Functions & CIB Business lines and notably the development of the local territory and (global) center of expertise (India Solutions Private Limited – ISPL).Position PurposeAs a senior member of the CIBC&T Extended Leadership Team, the Head of CIBC&T India will manage the India based CIBC&T team and bring top-notch consulting with a dual mandate: by leading complex consulting missions locally for the Indian territory and center of expertise India Solutions Private Limited (ISPL) and by contributing, when appropriate, to missions for BNP Paribas CIB for APAC regions or more globally with CIBC&T EMEA.Heading a newly created team, the Head of CIBC&T India will play a key role in the build-up of the team and progressively establishing the local CIBC&T franchise.Functionally reporting to the Head of CIBC&T EMEA, the Head of CIBC&T India will work closely with the CIBC&T EMEA Extended Leadership Team to build up the team in India and establish the franchise locally with clients and partners and globally amongst CIB stakeholders. He/She will also work in close collaboration with CIB Consulting APAC and CIB Transformation APAC. Some travel might be required on an ad-hoc basis.ResponsibilitiesCIB Consulting & Transformation (CIBC&T) India team management: Build up CIBC&T India team, supporting the hire and integration of talents into the team. Inspire, manage, train on-the-job and act as a Manager Coach for CIBC&T India team members. Build the infrastructure and ensure alignment with CIBC&T EMEA processes & governance (recruiting, trainings, appraisal process, project feedback, etc.). Manage India budget in coordination with CIBC&T EMEA COO and ensure alignment of cost allocation with the project activities of the team leveraging on appropriate processes (e.g., billing / invoicing as relevant). Rely on CIBC&T India team members to appropriately deputise on his/her behalf and generally support his/her accountabilities. Engage in collaboration with and promote adequate visibility on the team’s activities to the Head of CIBC&T EMEA and ISPL Chief of staff.Share Expertise On Consulting Skills & Methodologies Be recognized as a reference point for consulting skills and methodologies, and act as a structuring pillar of the team. Share consulting expertise with team members and provide feedback & coaching on a regular basis. Encourage a culture of excellence and best practice sharing among the team.Deliver Impactful Content Lead or supervise several complex consulting missions in parallel, bringing value and adapting the approach and recommendations- leveraging on his/her knowledge of consulting and the business. Ensure the high quality, timely and smooth execution of work. Connecting the dots with other projects locally and across the CIB C&T network and previous experiences, proposing solutions to clients and teams, and securing high quality deliverables with actionable recommendations to Senior Management. Frame new requests", leveraging deep consulting & transformation skills, CIB knowledge and new market trends and practices. Manage the team’s pipeline of projects, actively sourcing local projects, ensuring alignment of priorities with CIB senior management (with CIBC&T EMEA and local management) and ensure as applicable the success of co-staffing missions with partner teams. Engage the team as applicable on AI and data management project topics in collaboration and coordination with specialist teams (e.g., CIB Analytics Consulting, CIB AI or Data Office). Set up delivery standards ensuring alignment with CIBC&T EMEA while adapting for local mandates to the Indian context.Build Long-term Relationships With Clients & Partners Initiate relationships, establish connectivity with clients and partners and build up the CIBC&T brand and franchise in the Indian territory and center of expertise. Provide meaningful support and advice locally to the Indian territory and globally to CIB Management to achieve their ambitions. Secure trustworthiness (legitimacy and credibility) to become a trusted advisor with clients at all levels. Anticipate the needs of internal clients and partners, provide relevant responses and solutions to meet them. Use positive influence to constructively challenge clients on transformation initiatives, at senior management levels, in alignment with the overarching CIB strategy. Go beyond existing frameworks and test innovative project operating modes & communicate on knowledge of innovative / disruptive market best practices. Jointly with CIBC&T teams, contribute to reinforcing the C&T network through best practices sharing (content, methodologies, projects, etc.) Establish relationships and foster coordination and collaboration with regional APAC Consulting and Transformation teams.Work with the Extended Leadership team to enrich the CIBC&T EMEA strategy, aligned with CIB overall strategic plan and more specifically taking into account local views.Technical & Behavioral CompetenciesBehavioral Skills Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to negotiate, collaborate and influence at senior management level. High adaptability in changing environments, a capacity to bring value and propose meaningful solutions. Ability to initiate and establish sustainable client relationships and build up and activate networks. Expert organisational skills. Excellent problem-solving skills.Business Skills Significant experience working in a top-tier Consulting firm or internal Consulting team. Strong working knowledge of strategic consulting and transformation in a Financial Institution, with the ability to lead complex strategic consulting projects across business & functions. Strong knowledge of Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) business activity and products is recommended. Strong knowledge of operations, information technology and finance functions is a plus.Transversal Skills Strong management skills with the ability to build up a team and inspire, train and upskill team members. Ability to think strategically and operationally. Comfortable operating in full autonomy, self-driven.Language SkillsEnglish (fluent), French (recommended)Specific QualificationsSkills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)Technical SkillsAbility to manage a projectAbility to understand, explain and support changeAbility to anticipate business / strategic evolutionAbility to develop others & improve their skillsAbility to inspire others & generate people's commitmentBehavioral SkillsAbility to collaborate / TeamworkAbility to deliver / Results drivenDecision MakingClient focusedEducation Level: A master’s degree from a top-tier institutionExperience Level: At least 20 yearsLocation: MumbaiAbout BNP Paribas GroupBNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.About BNP Paribas India SolutionsEstablished in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.Commitment to Diversity and InclusionAt BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. Job Description – Head – Customer ExperienceLocation: Andheri West, MumbaiExperience: 15+ YearsIndustry Preference: Real Estate preferred---Role PurposeThe Head – Customer Experience will be responsible for driving the overall customer experience strategy across the customer lifecycle, with a strong focus on Net Promoter Score (NPS), Voice of Customer (VOC), customer journey enhancement, service excellence, and service recovery. The role will lead the design and implementation of customer feedback mechanisms, monitor customer sentiment across touchpoints, drive closure of escalations, and partner with cross-functional teams to improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, and brand advocacy.The incumbent will play a strategic role in building a customer-first culture across the organization by leveraging insights, strengthening governance, improving processes, and ensuring a seamless experience from booking to possession and post-possession.---Key Responsibilities1. Customer Experience Strategy- Lead the overall customer experience agenda for the organization across the real estate customer lifecycle.- Define and drive the customer experience roadmap aligned with business objectives and brand promise.- Build and strengthen a customer-centric culture by embedding customer experience principles across functions and projects.- Establish service standards, customer engagement practices, and experience benchmarks across all customer touchpoints.- Identify opportunities to enhance customer delight, loyalty, retention, and advocacy.2. NPS & Voice of Customer (VOC) Management- Own and drive the NPS framework across key customer touchpoints such as booking, agreement, collections, construction updates, possession, handover, and post-possession.- Design and institutionalize customer listening mechanisms including NPS surveys, feedback programs, VOC interventions, and satisfaction studies.- Monitor customer sentiment, identify promoters, passives, and detractors, and ensure structured action planning and closure.- Analyze customer feedback trends, service gaps, recurring pain points, and root causes to derive actionable business insights.- Build project-wise and function-wise customer feedback reporting and ensure regular review with leadership.3. Customer Journey Mapping & Experience Improvement- Map the end-to-end customer journey and identify gaps across communication, documentation, collections, project updates, possession, and post-sales interactions.- Design and drive customer journey improvement initiatives to ensure a seamless and differentiated customer experience.- Improve consistency, responsiveness, transparency, and ease of interaction across all customer-facing processes.- Partner with internal teams to simplify and strengthen customer touchpoints and service delivery standards.- Lead initiatives to improve customer communication quality, turnaround times, and service responsiveness.4. Detractor Management & Service Recovery- Ensure timely closure of detractor cases, customer escalations, and service-related concerns emerging through NPS and other feedback channels.- Lead structured service recovery for dissatisfied customers and track effectiveness of resolution actions.- Review critical complaints and escalations and ensure closure through collaboration with CRM, Sales, Projects, Legal, Accounts, Collections, and Site teams.- Drive root-cause analysis of customer complaints and implement preventive and corrective actions to reduce recurrence.- Ensure closure communication is timely, professional, and aligned with customer expectations.5. Governance, Reporting & Analytics- Establish governance mechanisms for regular review of NPS, VOC, customer complaints, service gaps, and improvement initiatives.- Publish monthly / quarterly dashboards covering NPS scores, detractor trends, VOC insights, complaint categories, closure timelines, and service improvement actions.- Present customer experience insights, risk areas, and recommendations to senior leadership and management forums.- Use customer data and feedback analytics to influence process changes, policy improvements, and service interventions.- Monitor key service metrics and ensure performance against defined customer experience KPIs.6. Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management- Work closely with Sales, CRM, Projects, Legal, Accounts, Collections, Marketing, Facility Management, and Site teams to improve customer experience across the lifecycle.- Act as a central point of leadership for customer experience transformation initiatives across departments.- Influence internal stakeholders to adopt customer-first practices and improve service delivery standards.- Ensure customer concerns are addressed proactively and escalations are resolved with accountability and ownership.- Support leadership in driving customer-centric decision-making across business functions.7. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement- Identify recurring pain points and service bottlenecks and drive process improvements to enhance customer satisfaction.- Review customer-facing SOPs, communication practices, escalation matrices, and service protocols to ensure effectiveness and consistency.- Drive standardization of customer experience practices across projects and teams.- Recommend automation, digital interventions, and process enhancements to improve customer engagement and experience monitoring.- Build a robust feedback-to-action framework to ensure VOC insights translate into measurable improvements.8. Team Leadership- Lead and mentor the Customer Experience / NPS / VOC team and build capability within the function.- Define team KRAs, monitor performance, and ensure strong execution of feedback, analytics, and service recovery processes.- Create a culture of ownership, responsiveness, and customer empathy within the team.- Guide team members on handling escalations, customer interactions, reporting, and stakeholder coordination.---Key Deliverables / KRAs- Improvement in overall NPS score and customer satisfaction across projects and touchpoints- Strong VOC coverage with actionable insights and closure mechanisms- Effective closure of detractor cases and escalations within defined timelines- Reduction in repeat complaints and recurring customer pain points- Implementation of customer journey and process improvement initiatives- Strengthening of service governance, customer communication, and experience standards- Enhanced customer retention, loyalty, and brand advocacy- Development of a customer-first service culture across the organization---Desired Candidate Profile- 15+ years of experience in Customer Experience / NPS / VOC / CRM / Customer Satisfaction / Service Excellence- Prior experience in Real Estate is strongly preferred- Proven track record of building and driving customer experience strategy, NPS frameworks, and VOC programs at an organizational level- Strong understanding of customer journey mapping, service recovery, complaint management, and customer lifecycle management- Experience in handling senior-level customer escalations and driving cross-functional service improvements- Strong analytical orientation with the ability to convert feedback into business insights and process interventions- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and leadership skills- Strong customer-first mindset with the ability to influence teams and drive organizational change- Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, CRM systems, dashboards, and reporting tools---Educational Qualification- Graduate in any discipline- MBA / Postgraduate preferred---Key Competencies- Customer Centricity- Strategic Thinking- Service Excellence Orientation- Stakeholder Management- Problem Solving & Decision Making- Analytical Thinking- Process Improvement- Team Leadership- Communication & Influencing Skills- Escalation & Service Recovery Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Women Empowerment & Education Location: Mulund, MumbaiTravel: Pan-India travel requiredSector Preference: Development / NGO sector experience preferred About the Role We are seeking an experienced, visionary, and mission-driven Chief Operating Officer (COO) to lead the operational strategy and execution of our Women Empowerment & Education vertical. The COO will be responsible for driving organizational growth, ensuring effective program implementation, managing financial performance, and building sustainable systems that create measurable social impact. This role requires a dynamic leader who can balance program excellence with financial discipline, including managing Profit & Loss (P&L), while scaling women empowerment and education initiatives across India. Key ResponsibilitiesStrategic Leadership Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with the organization's mission of empowering women through education, skill development, livelihood generation, and social inclusion. Collaborate with the leadership team to expand programs, partnerships, and nationwide impact. Identify opportunities for innovation, growth, and operational excellence. Operational Management Oversee the day-to-day operations of the Women Empowerment & Education vertical. Ensure seamless execution of education, vocational training, entrepreneurship, community development, and capacity-building programs. Design and implement SOPs, operational frameworks, and scalable systems to improve efficiency and impact. Financial Management Manage the Profit & Loss (P&L) of the vertical, ensuring financial sustainability and effective resource utilization. Lead budgeting, financial planning, forecasting, and performance monitoring. Strengthen revenue streams through grants, CSR partnerships, institutional funding, and strategic collaborations. Team Leadership Lead, mentor, and manage cross-functional teams across multiple locations. Foster a high-performance, inclusive, and mission-driven work culture. Develop leadership capabilities and strengthen team engagement. Partnerships & Stakeholder Management Build and maintain strategic partnerships with government agencies, educational institutions, NGOs, CSR partners, donors, foundations, and corporate stakeholders. Represent the organization at national forums, conferences, and key stakeholder meetings. Drive collaborations that enhance program reach and sustainability. Compliance & Governance Ensure compliance with statutory regulations, NGO governance standards, and funding requirements. Establish transparent reporting mechanisms and impact measurement frameworks to track program effectiveness and organizational performance. Candidate Profile Experience: 10–20 years in leadership roles, preferably within NGOs, development organizations, social enterprises, educational institutions, or mission-driven organizations. Proven experience in managing Profit & Loss (P&L) for a business unit, program, or vertical. Strong expertise in operations management, financial planning, strategic execution, and organizational development. Demonstrated experience in scaling programs across multiple locations. Prior experience in women empowerment, education, skill development, livelihood initiatives, or community development will be a strong advantage. Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and strategic thinking abilities. Education Master's degree in Management, Public Policy, Social Work, Development Studies, Education, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. Job Type: Full-time Pay: Up to ₹4,000,000.00 per year Application Question(s): Total Years of Experience CCTC ECTC Notice Period Comfortable for Pan-India Travelling? Work Location: In person

About The CompanyNivaan Care is on a mission to end unnecessary pain surgeries in India. We are the country's most advanced interventional pain management clinic, offering evidence-based, non-surgical treatments that address the root cause of chronic pain, not just the symptoms. Nurture our people and culture, creating a workplace where all can thrive.At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. verbal communication skills, with strong storytelling capability for C-suite audiences, employees, clients, analysts, and internal stakeholders.Strong executive presence and stakeholder influence, normalizedText: JOB DESCRIPTION Position: Head - Sales & Marketing Company: The House of Shubhashish | JK Jajoo Ventures Pvt. Ltd.Department: Sales & MarketingLocation: Jaipur, Rajasthan (pan-India project exposure) Reports To: MD/CEOManages: Sales Teams, Channel Partner Team, Marketing Team, CRM, Presales & Customer ExperienceEmployment: Full-Time/PermanentExperience: 15–20 Years (minimum 8 years in a Sales Leadership role in Real Estate) Education: MBA in Marketing/Sales/Business Administration from a recognised institutionABOUT THE HOUSE OF SHUBHASHISHJK Jajoo Ventures Pvt. Ltd., through its flagship brand The House of Shubhashish, is one of Rajasthan's most respected and trusted real estate organisations consistently recognised for quality-driven residential and commercial developments, transparency with customers, and a premium brand positioning in the Jaipur market. The organisation is a Great Place to Work® certified employer with a deep commitment to customer delight, ethical business practices, and sustainable growth. As Shubhashish Homes enters its next phase of expansion across Jaipur and new markets, Sales & Marketing leadership becomes the most consequential hire in the organisation.ROLE PURPOSEThe Head - Sales & Marketing will own end-to-end revenue generation, brand building, and customer acquisition for The House of Shubhashish. This is a P&L-accountable leadership role - responsible for driving sales targets across all residential and commercial projects, building Shubhashish's premium brand position in the market, and leading a multi-functional team spanning direct sales, channel partners, digital marketing, CRM, and presales.The incumbent will be a key member of the senior leadership team, advising the MD and CEO on pricing strategy, product-market fit, launch sequencing, and competitive positioning. Equal parts sales general and brand custodian - the person who makes Shubhashish the most recognised and trusted name in Rajasthan real estate.KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1. Sales Strategy & Revenue LeadershipOwn and deliver the annual revenue target across all residential and commercial projects - pre-launch, launch, and inventory sell-down phases.Develop the annual sales strategy, channel mix, and go-to-market plan in alignment with project launches and the business plan.Set project-wise sales targets, velocity benchmarks, and conversion rate KPIs; review performance weekly and course-correct proactively.Lead high-value customer negotiations and closures particularly for large-ticket units, commercial properties, and NRI / HNI buyers.Drive pricing strategy in collaboration with the Finance and Projects team; recommend launch prices, payment plan structures, and offer designs.Identify and activate new revenue streams - bulk deals, corporate alliances, institutional sales, and co-living/managed asset models.Ensure collections discipline; coordinate with Finance and CRM for milestone-linked collections and payment plan adherence.2.
