normalizedText: LocationRemote Full job description About us HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.Our people With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.Our impact Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts Why This Role Exists The Sr. Director, Product Management (Platform & Core Products) will lead the foundational layer of HighLevel's product stack, spanning infrastructure platforms, automation capabilities, CRM primitives, and shared systems like identity, permissions, notifications, and audit logging. This is a critical org-wide leadership role, owning HighLevel’s platform extensibility, data model reliability, cross-surface consistency, and internal product development velocity. You will manage a team of 25–30 PMs via 3 Group Product Managers and drive strategy, execution, and org design for a portfolio that underpins everything from marketing automation and conversation management to AI-driven workflows and CRM object modeling. You’ll be expected to scale a high-performance product org, influence product direction across pods, and partner closely with engineering to deliver a scalable, secure, and elegant platform for millions of users. Strategic Priorities Build an Extensible Platform: Architect reusable primitives (identity, roles, objects, notifications, reporting) that enable faster development across HighLevel. Modernize Core CRM: Scale performance and usability across contacts, companies, tasks, opportunities, and conversations — the backbone of daily SMB workflows. Unlock Scalable Automation: Advance our workflows engine and Workflow AI to power increasingly complex use cases with speed and simplicity. Drive UX Consistency Across Surfaces: Ensure UI, interaction patterns, and product language are coherent across contact, sub-account, and agency layers. Support Data-Driven Product Maturity: Enforce strong instrumentation, analytics readiness, and reporting across all core products. Operationalize Product Management Excellence: Raise the bar for product planning, prioritization, execution, and accountability across 30+ PMs and APMs. Key Responsibilities Define and drive the long term product vision, roadmap, and success metrics for platform and core product areas. Manage and coach a team ofGroup PMs and PMs,.cultivating a strong leadership bench and ensuring high performance. Serve as the bridge between platform engineering, infra, and product — enabling other teams to move faster through well-designed interfaces and reusable systems. Set quality standards for API design, system performance, scalability, and reliability. Lead cross-functional coordination with design, engineering, QA, support, data, and legal to deliver on-time, high-quality launches. Represent the needs of agencies, sub-accounts, and end contacts in platform and CRM decisions — ensuring we build with deep user empathy. Collaborate with the Product leadership to influence org-wide product strategy, culture, and planning cadences. Lead strategic quarterly and annual planning for the org — bringing clarity to priorities across technical debt, product innovation, and user experience. Act as a thought partner to engineering leadership in shaping architecture and development investment decisions. What Success Looks Like HighLevel’s platform teams are recognised as enablers, not blockers — other pods build faster using your team's APIs, patterns, and systems. CRM primitives and workflows become more reliable, performant, and deeply adopted by our users — visible in activation and retention metrics. The organization experiences clean product ownership, predictable roadmaps, and fast decision-making under your leadership. Workflow AI and Workflow Core support a growing number of use cases without sacrificing speed, reliability, or clarity. The data model becomes flexible and extensible, enabling custom objects, relationships, and analytics without friction. You are viewed as a strategic thought partners and executional anchor for platform and core products at HighLevel Ideal Candidate Profile 12–15+ years in product management, with at least 5+ years managing managers (GPMs,Directors or equivalents). Experience scaling platform and core product orgs in fast-growth B2B SaaS companies, (ideally between $500M-$1B ARR). Deep fluency in CRM, automation platforms, or workflow engines — understands data models, APIs, and system-level product thinking. Prior experience building internal platforms or developer tools that support multiple product teams. Ability to scale orgs, implement processes, and hire/coach high-performing PMs. Technical fluency — capable of earning trust with engineering leads and making calls on infra trade-offs, architecture, and scalability. Familiar with two-tier SaaS, multi-tenant environments, and role-based access control models. Strong written and asynchronous communication skills — capable of driving clarity across functions and time zones. Bonus Points For Experience working on workflow builders, CRM platforms, or marketing automation tools. Background in B2B2SMB or agency-led SaaS models. Exposure to design systems, shared component libraries, or analytics platforms. Hands-on familiarity with platform performance metrics (e.g., P95 latency, Sentry, Grafana). Experience integrating with third-party platforms like Stripe, Meta, Google, or TikTok (even if not leading monetization). Equal Employment Opportunity Information The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. Vice President, Global Growth and Marketing The Opportunity This is an executive business leadership role. We are looking for a Vice President, Global Growth and Marketing to architect one of Manifest Global's core operating systems — the commercial growth engine that connects strategy, product, brand, sales, customer success, partnerships, AI, and marketing into one integrated capability that accelerates the performance of the entire organisation. Working closely with the CEO, COO, and Business Leaders, you will help determine where we grow, how we compete, where we invest, how our portfolio evolves, and how Growth and Marketing create measurable enterprise value. You will inherit strong brands, talented people, and significant market opportunity, but you will not inherit a finished global organisation. Your first year will be about building from zero to one. You will design the operating system, establish common standards, build shared capabilities, create commercial discipline, embed AI into everyday execution, and earn organisational trust by demonstrating measurable business impact. We are looking for a builder who enjoys creating clarity where none exists, designing systems before optimising them, and laying foundations that will scale globally over the coming decade. Your Executive Mandate As a member of the executive leadership team, your responsibility extends far beyond leading the marketing function. You will help shape company strategy, portfolio strategy, commercial priorities, market expansion, product direction, investment decisions, annual planning, organisational design, AI transformation, strategic partnerships, and the integration of future acquisitions where appropriate. Growth and Marketing will not simply support these conversations — they will actively shape them. Your mandate is to build a single global Growth and Marketing operating system that creates leverage across every company within the Manifest portfolio while preserving the strengths and identities of each individual business. You will create alignment in strategy, planning, execution, governance, measurement, operating rhythms, and resource allocation so that every team benefits from shared capabilities while remaining deeply connected to its customers and markets. You will build one commercial growth engine where brand, product marketing, demand generation, content, events, partnerships, customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, marketing operations, and sales enablement function as one integrated system. Growth and Marketing should influence every stage of the customer journey, from shaping market perception and generating demand to increasing customer lifetime value and strengthening long-term customer relationships. You will continuously evolve how the various brands at Manifest Global work together as an ecosystem. You will identify opportunities for shared positioning, ecosystem storytelling, cross-selling, portfolio leverage, and common capabilities that enable every business to become stronger because it belongs to Manifest. You will establish one global brand architecture while simultaneously building sophisticated commercial intelligence capabilities that allow Growth and Marketing to understand business performance with the same rigour that Finance understands financial performance. Attribution, forecasting, experimentation, customer insight, investment analysis, and performance measurement should become strategic capabilities that influence executive decision-making across the company. You will also lead the transformation of our organisation into one of the world's most AI-enabled commercial functions, embedding AI across research, customer intelligence, creative development, content production, campaign execution, localisation, analytics, reporting, workflow automation, and operational excellence. Technology should multiply the capability of exceptional people, allowing the organisation to operate with greater speed, quality, and strategic focus. Above all, you will build a world-class organisation. You will develop exceptional leaders, create clarity and accountability, raise standards relentlessly, simplify complexity, and establish an environment where ambitious marketers and growth leaders come to do the best work of their careers. Commercial Accountability Growth and Marketing exist to create enterprise value. Success will not be measured by campaigns, impressions, or activity alone, but by meaningful contribution to profitable revenue growth, customer acquisition, customer expansion, retention, market leadership, brand equity, commercial efficiency, marketing return on investment, EBITDA, and long-term enterprise value. Every investment should have a clear commercial rationale, every initiative should strengthen our competitive position, and every member of the organisation should understand how their work contributes directly to the success of the business. What Success Looks Like In the first 12 months Within your first year, you will have built the foundations of a truly global Growth and Marketing organisation from the ground up. You will have designed and implemented a common operating system across the Manifest portfolio, established shared ways of working, introduced commercial measurement frameworks, embedded AI into everyday execution, and built trusted partnerships with every Business Leader. You will have transformed a collection of capable marketing teams into one aligned global leadership organisation with shared goals, shared standards, and shared accountability. Sales, Product, Customer Success, and every Business Leader will recognise Growth and Marketing as a strategic commercial partner rather than a support function, and executive decisions will increasingly be informed by customer insight, commercial intelligence, and marketing performance. Most importantly, you will have demonstrated that Growth and Marketing directly influence revenue, profitability, and enterprise value — earning credibility not through presentations or strategy documents but through execution and measurable business outcomes. Over time Growth and Marketing become one of Manifest Global's defining competitive advantages. The organisation consistently drives profitable growth across every business. Our brands become recognised globally as the most trusted ecosystem in international education. Our shared capabilities create meaningful leverage across the portfolio. Our commercial decisions become increasingly informed by customer insight, market intelligence, and sophisticated performance measurement. Growth and Marketing earn their place alongside Product, Finance, and Operations as one of the company's primary strategic functions — attracting exceptional talent and becoming a benchmark for excellence within the global education sector. Who You Are You are a business leader first and a growth builder second. You understand that Growth and Marketing exist to create enterprise value, not simply campaigns. You naturally think in systems rather than functions, enjoy solving business problems as much as marketing challenges, and combine creativity with commercial discipline. You are equally comfortable thinking like an executive and operating like a builder. You can define long-term strategy in the morning, review a campaign, challenge a positioning statement, redesign an operating cadence, or coach a team in the afternoon, and finish the day discussing commercial performance with the executive team. You are not precious about hierarchy or titles because you understand that exceptional organisations are built by leaders who are willing to fly high when strategic thinking is required and fly low when execution demands it. You thrive in ambiguity, enjoy building from zero to one, raise standards without creating bureaucracy, earn trust through execution, and build organisations that continue creating value long after individual initiatives are complete. Your Experience We are interested in the scale of the problems you have solved. You have likely built and led global marketing or growth organisations within high-growth technology, SaaS, platform, marketplace, or multi-brand businesses, partnered closely with COOs, Boards, and executive leadership teams on company strategy, and built commercial growth engines that have materially influenced revenue, profitability, and enterprise value. You have successfully led functions spanning brand, product marketing, communications, demand generation, content, marketing operations, and commercial enablement while developing exceptional leaders capable of scaling alongside the business. Most importantly, you have built organisations before. You know what it takes to move from zero to one, and you enjoy building as much as operating. Manifest is one of the few organisations that serves both institutions and individuals at scale. Success in this role requires an equal appreciation for enterprise sales cycles and consumer behaviour. You should be as comfortable building trust with a university Vice Chancellor as you are understanding what inspires a student to choose a destination, what reassures a parent making a life-changing investment, and how consumer brands earn attention, trust, and advocacy over time. You have built at least one global brand. You have led both B2B and B2C marketing. You know enterprise sales and consumer psychology. You have built functions from zero to one and transformed organisations along the way. You have managed multi-country teams, have marketplace or ecosystem experience, understand AI deeply, and are commercially obsessive. You can partner with a COO. You love execution. Why Join Manifest Global Manifest Global stands at an inflection point. The brands are established. The products are proven. The markets are global. The opportunity is no longer to build another successful marketing department — it is to build one of the defining commercial growth organisations in global education. If you are excited by creating something that does not yet exist, if you enjoy building as much as leading, if you are equally energised by shaping strategy and executing the details, and if you want your work to influence the trajectory of an entire global education ecosystem, we would love to meet you. Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50+ countries with $80M raised from Tiger Global, SIG, and Square Peg.

normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationBengaluru, Karnataka Full job description About the Role FinAgra is an agri-fintech company transforming commercial farming in India through its Rural Entrepreneur Partner (REP) model using strategic capital deployment, technical expertise, and operational excellence to maximise productivity, profitability, and environmental sustainability. We aim at building resilient, scalable agricultural enterprises that deliver attractive returns while creating long-term value across the agricultural value chain. The Growth & Partnerships Lead is responsible for owning revenue growth, market positioning, and sustainable buyer partnerships across local, regional, and export markets. The role integrates commercial growth strategy, REP Expansion strategy, core partnership development, downstream coordination, and performance oversight to ensure predictable demand, optimized supply alignment, and long-term market competitiveness. Reports to Global Head of Supply Chain (functional) and to Country Manager (operational) Core Responsibilities Strategic growth & market development Growth strategy: design and execute growth strategies across priority crop value chains, anchored on the REP production model and prioritize and penetrate the highest-value buyers. Market intelligence: track pricing and buyer demand to inform commercial decisions and the crop decision gate. New market access: open new channels such as trade platforms, regional distribution hubs, strategic partnerships to diversify the pipeline and cut concentration risk. Buyer acquisition, offtake & negotiation Buyer acquisition: target and engage processors, feed manufacturers, aggregators, cooperatives, and exporters. Contract negotiation & management: lead negotiations for off-take agreements, ensuring favorable terms on pricing, quality standards, delivery schedules, payment conditions and risk allocation. Maintain the documented contracts and ensure compliance with agreed commercial terms. Relationship management: run a structured cadence with key buyers with regular check-ins, quarterly reviews, joint planning where possible. Enabling partnerships & stakeholder alliances Enabling partnerships: originate and manage key partnerships that support the delivery of all offtake commitments at scale. Stakeholder alliances: build alliances with industry associations, regulators, service providers, and government agencies to enhance credibility, unlock opportunities and strengthen FinAgra’s standing. Partner network: support identification and due diligence of REP partners, onboarding, network expansion, and manage overall partner relationships. Brand representation: represent FinAgra at trade fairs, exhibitions, and industry forums to strengthen brand visibility and commercial positioning. Demand–supply alignment & downstream execution Forecast alignment: work with Agronomy, Procurement, and Operations to match demand forecasts to production capacity and forward-contracts against forecast harvests. Downstream execution: convert signed offtakes into orders, delivery, and quality compliance, through to invoicing, reconciliation, and settlement. Quality compliance: confirm that all shipments meet buyer specifications and regulatory standards prior to dispatch. Risk mitigation: develop contingency strategies to manage supply chain disruptions, market volatility, and logistical constraints. Performance, systems & insight Growth KPIs: buyer acquisition and retention, contracted volume and revenue. Operational KPIs: delivery performance, efficiency, and partner-network growth. Reporting: deliver quarterly performance and market-intelligence reports to leadership. Continuous improvement: recommend commercial and operational improvements from performance data and market feedback. Key Deliverables Signed offtake and strategic partnership agreements across priority crops and markets. Buyer-engagement tracker and offtake pipeline. Quarterly growth and market-intelligence reports. Success Measures Signed offtake agreements across priority crops, with contracted volume coverage tracked against forecast harvest. Growth in contracted revenue and a more diversified buyer base. Enabling partnerships in place to deliver contracted volumes at scale. Downstream execution discipline — on-time, on-spec delivery with clean invoicing and settlement. What We Offer Leadership ownership of FinAgra’s commercial growth and partnerships in India. Direct reporting line to the Country Director and Global Supply Chain Lead — real authority, central to growth and market strategy. Opportunity to shape and execute market entry, buyer engagement, and partnership development in a critically important sector. Competitive compensation and benefits.

refive is building the engagement layer for physical retail: digital receipts, QR/NFC touchpoints, and post-purchase journeys that help brands and retailers turn anonymous shoppers into known customers. We work with retailers like Puma, EuroShop, and Orlen and are scaling fast across Europe and beyond. We are a close-knit team, distributed across three continents, with a base in Berlin. We're building an AI powered startup, flat heirarchy and a tight, efficient team.This is a Head of Marketing operating model inside a lean-team structure. You own the entire marketing function: strategy, content, SEO, events, partner co-marketing, and brand, and you run most of it through AI-powered workflows and agentic automation rather than headcount.The bar is high: you need to zoom from annual content strategy to line-level copy review to prompting a new automation pipeline - and know which mode each situation calls for. We move in sprints, ship fast, and never let perfect be the enemy of good.TasksContent quality and brand voice: Own the editorial standard across everything that goes out — LinkedIn posts, blog content, SEO copy, case studies, newsletter. You are the last human filter before anything is published. You can tell the difference between content that performs and content that just sounds like AI generated it, and you fix the latter.AI content engine: Direct and maintain agentic pipelines that produce content at scale. You set direction, write the prompts, evaluate the output, and intervene when the machine gets it wrong. This is already partially built; you evolve and own it.Account-based marketing support: Align the content calendar with live pipeline priorities. Brief assets for key accounts. Make sure sales has what it needs, when it needs it — not generic collateral.SEO and inbound: Own organic growth. Blog strategy, keyword targeting, distribution playbook, conversion path optimisation.Brand and thought leadership: Evolve the Retail Spotlight podcast into a content ecosystem. Ghostwrite and direct founder voice content across two distinct voices. Build refive's presence as the authoritative voice on in-store customer engagement in Europe.Events and field: Project-manage event participation remotely — NRF, EuroShop, RTS London and similar. Own the full loop: logistics, pre-event content, on-site coordination with vendors and booth teams, lead capture workflows, post-event follow-up content. You run this independently; founders show up and present.Partner co-marketing: Develop joint campaigns and launch materials with white-label and integration partners as the pipeline scales.Metrics and reporting: Own the automated weekly marketing dashboard (GA4, HubSpot, LinkedIn). Know your numbers. Flag what is not working before anyone asks.Requirements6-8 years of B2B SaaS or tech marketing experience, with real ownership - not just execution support.You have run campaigns end to end and have results to show.Fluent, flawless native spokend and written englishAgentic automation fluency. You have built or designed workflows using tools like Claude Code, n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar. You are comfortable prompting LLMs for structured outputs and wiring them into repeatable pipelines. This is not a nice-to-have it is how this role operates day to day.Strategic range with execution instinct. You can write a marketing plan in the morning and review a CTA in the afternoon. You know when to go deep and when to move on.Content quality instinct. You can tell the difference between AI-generated content that performs and content that just sounds like it was AI-generated. You write well yourself - sharp, no fluff, B2B-appropriate.Modern mindset, not stuck in old-school playbooks. Curious about what new tools can do, comfortable with ambiguity, willing to try things that have no case study yet - but experienced enough to know what good looks like and push back when a shortcut will cost you later.HubSpot and GA4 proficiency. You track what matters and use data to change direction, not validate decisions already made.Retail or martech experience is a genuine plus — if you understand how brick-and-mortar retailers think about footfall, loyalty, and first-party data, you will ramp faster and produce better work.One or more European language skills are a significant bonus given our primary market. But not a must have.BenefitsEnd-to-end ownership of a marketing function with real enterprise customers and a clear growth pathThe chance to build and document an AI-first lean marketing playbook - a genuinely novel problemAttractive compensation package and options after year 1Training budget and access to the latest AI toolingDirect access to the founding team and meaningful strategic input from day oneWork from home or Goa or the mountains, wherever you want as long as you have a perfect internet connectionWe use heavy agentic automation across content, research, and reporting. This role is not about doing more with less, it is about designing systems that handle the repeatable work so human judgment goes where it actually matters. If that excites you, you will fit here. If you prefer full manual control over every deliverable, this is probably not the right environment.To apply, send your CV plus responses to both tasks below. Please use the "Cover Letter" field for that. Applications without both tasks completed will not be reviewed.Task 1: Editorial eye. Here is a LinkedIn post a retail tech founder drafted but never published: "Excited to share that we've just launched our new in-store customer engagement solution that helps retailers leverage data-driven insights to optimize their omnichannel strategy and drive meaningful ROI across touchpoints. This is a game-changer for the industry. #retail #innovation #customerexperience." Rewrite it. Then tell us in two sentences what was wrong with the original.Task 2: Systems thinking. We publish a new blog post every two weeks. Sketch the automation workflow you would build to turn each post into a week of LinkedIn content across two founder accounts. Cover: triggers, tools, prompts, and, critically, what a human reviews and when. A rough diagram or a numbered list of steps both work. We are not looking for a perfect answer. We are looking at how you think. About WPP MediaWPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.For more information, visit wppmedia.com.About WPP Media WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.comAt WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. Role Summary And ImpactAs part of our Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will partner with teams across the U.S., Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact, integrated media planning solutions across multiple markets and channels.We are looking for a Senior Director – Media Planning who will:Strategic Client Leadership & Planning: Act as the senior planning lead and strategic partner for global and multi‑market clients, ensuring media planning excellence aligned with client business objectives.Maintain a relentless focus on driving client outcome growth, applying performance‑led planning principles, data‑informed audience insights, optimisation thinking and advanced analytical perspectives to planning decision‑making.Serve as a subject‑matter expert across multiple channels and planning practices, with a strong understanding of how channels work together to deliver short‑ and long‑term client outcomes.Provide strategic guidance and recommendations on the optimal use of media products, services and solutions, ensuring alignment with client needs, business strategy and return on investment expectations.Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, nurturing long‑term relationships and supporting clients in navigating complex business challenges, organisational change and evolving market dynamics.Demonstrate deep understanding of client businesses, including successes, challenges and strategic priorities, and apply experience‑based judgement to identify opportunities, risks and trade‑offs from a business perspective.Lead senior‑level planning discussions across multiple stakeholders, effectively synthesising and reconciling diverse or conflicting inputs to drive alignment and shared understanding.Embed performance‑led and outcome‑oriented thinking into the planning process by ensuring that insights, intelligence and forecasts from activation and specialist teams are reflected in strategic recommendations.Define and oversee planning‑level KPIs, governance frameworks and planning processes that enable optimisation, benchmarking and continuous improvement across client portfolios.Champion a data‑driven planning culture, partnering with analytics and data science teams to prioritise initiatives and ensure insights are effectively translated into planning outputs.Develop high‑level growth and commercial planning perspectives for assigned clients or portfolios, including directional forecasts, profitability considerations and identification of priority growth areas.Maintain a strong understanding of WPP Media agency deliverables and committed campaign KPIs, ensuring planning outputs are aligned with agreed client expectations.Represent the planning discipline with credibility in senior client meetings, contributing technical and strategic expertise when required.Own the senior client engagement cadence from a planning perspective, including strategic sessions, status forums and cross‑functional meetings, ensuring consistent and high‑quality representation of the planning function.Take ownership of key planning workstreams on complex or multi‑market initiatives, ensuring clarity of scope, appropriate governance and high‑quality outputs.Capability Development: Identify capability gaps within media planning teams supporting client portfolios and define actions to address them through development, upskilling or targeted hiring. Partner with global planning practices, investment, product and solutions teams to help develop and drive adoption of new proprietary solutions on behalf of the OpCo.Represent the planning perspective in shaping capability priorities for the Polish GOC, ensuring alignment with broader WPP Media standards, expectations and strategic direction.Own the development and long‑term evolution of the Media Planning discipline within the Polish GOC, including definition of role profiles, competency frameworks and quality standards.Provide leadership and oversight for planning talent, establishing consistent development approaches, evaluation principles and coaching practices that support high performance and career progression.Build and maintain planning governance, including methodologies, templates and quality assurance standards, to ensure consistency, scalability and excellence of planning outputs.Foster a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the planning community, supporting best‑practice exchange across teams and markets.Collaboration & Leadership: Operate effectively within a complex, matrixed organizational environment, providing leadership through influence and partnership across client, planning and activation teams.Collaborate closely with client leadership, activation leads and regional stakeholders to ensure alignment between strategic intent, planning outputs and execution delivery.Represent the planning discipline with credibility across cross‑functional forums, ensuring consistent understanding of objectives, priorities and expectations.Enable effective communication and knowledge sharing between planning and activation teams, fostering clarity, collaboration and continuous improvement.Outline, monitor and support adherence to agreed client and WPP Media standards, ensuring planning excellence is consistently reflected across engagements.Partner with senior stakeholders to identify gaps, risks or misalignments, and contribute to the development of action plans and improvement frameworks.Act as a senior counterpart to Activation Directors and Leads, promoting shared accountability for client outcomes and strong collaboration across disciplines.Lead by example in building a collaborative, inclusive and high‑performance culture, encouraging teamwork, ownership and professional growth across teams.Data-Driven Insights: Utilize advanced data analytics to understand media performance deeply, and guide optimization strategies ensuring maximum ROI. Provides expert insights on the application of data science and how to effectively use client and all biddable data signals. Future-Forward Thinking: Stay ahead of media and technology trends, providing guidance on emerging opportunities and threats. Proactively develops blueprints and action plans to help propel achieving client business objectives by bringing together practitioners across practices, proprietary solutions and extended WPP Media capabilities, at a regional level.Skills And Experience15+ years of experience in across paid media, strategy, retail, or consulting, including senior roles requiring leadership and accountability for teams and stakeholders.Expertise in digital media, adtech, martech and data platforms Proven track record of managing complex, multi-market accounts where you’ve delivered measurable business outcomes.Deep knowledge of multi-practice area/industry usage and trends, and how it impacts customer businesses.Ability to communicate in a way that is highly persuasive, engaging and comprehensive (written and verbal).Fluent in different types of media strategy – and understands that the road to strong brand is paved with performance marketing principles at the core.Sophisticated understanding of the media investment, ad tech and agency ecosystemExperience overseeing technology and/or operations transformation programs.Ability to tell complex narratives in a simple and compelling way.Passion for digital and data, well versed on the latest global advancements & dynamics.Ability to lead through influence, demonstrating strong interpersonal skills, empathy and credibility across seniority levels.Demonstrated experience owning and leading senior client planning relationships across large, complex, and matrixed client teams.Proven capability leadership: building a planning team, hiring for defined profiles, and developing a discipline at scale, including people development, performance management and succession planning.Life At WPP Media & BenefitsOur passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide. job description Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. What You'll Do The Senior Technical Manager is a hands-on senior engineer and technical leader responsible for designing, building, and owning enterprise-grade applications. This is a Chapter Lead role — meaning the individual both leads the technical chapter (standards, practices, engineering culture) and remains deeply hands-on in architecture and implementation. This role is part of a cross-functional Agile squad in the Enterprise Services portfolio — including the Meetings & Events, Security & Travel squads — working closely with Product Owners, Architects, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, production-ready solutions. The individual will lead the technical design and implementation of applications leveraging Python, .NET Core and React. The role demands a strong ownership mindset, deep technical expertise across tech stack, and the ability to guide and grow other engineers while remaining fully hands-on. Your Responsibilities Chapter Leadership Setting technical standards, driving code/design reviews, mentoring engineers, and building a high-performing chapter culture. Act as the technical lead for application development, owning solutions, design decisions, and implementation while remaining fully hands-on. Align stakeholders on technical trade-offs and represent engineering perspective in cross-functional planning. Partner with Agile teams to ensure timely delivery, continuous improvement, and alignment with non-functional requirements (scalability, performance, reliability, cost optimization). Application Development Develop and maintain enterprise-grade APIs and microservices using .NET Core for high-throughput, integration-heavy enterprise service scenarios. Setting integrations with SaaS applications DBT experience is good to have Apply security, privacy, and compliance best practices including data protection, access control. Identify technical risks early, propose mitigation strategies, and contribute to the broader ES roadmap. Identify technical risks early, propose mitigation strategies, and contribute to the broader GenAI roadmap. Create and maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, runbooks, and operational guides. What You'll Bring Experience & Background 12+ years of professional software engineering experience building enterprise-grade applications. 7+ years of hands-on experience in Python, .Net Core, React Proven experience leading engineering chapters or technical teams while remaining hands-on. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with cross-functional teams. Excellent communication skills with ability to explain complex concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a pragmatic, delivery-focused mindset. Self-starter who can operate independently while leading others in a collaborative team environment Comfortable owning ambiguous problem spaces and driving solutions end-to-end. Passion for continuous learning, and applying emerging technologies responsibly. Strong leadership qualities with the ability to mentor, guide, and elevate team performance. Core Technical Skills — .NET Core & Python Strong hands-on expertise in both .NET Core and Python for application development. Ability to architect and build services, APIs, and data pipelines in either stack depending on use-case requirements. Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, Identity management and cloud-native integration patterns across both ecosystems. normalizedText: LocationBengaluru, Karnataka Full job description Who are we ? Kapture CX is a leading SaaS platform that helps enterprises automate and elevate customer experience through intelligent, AI-powered solutions. We partner with enterprises across industries to bring scalable automation and insight-driven efficiencies to their CX operations. Over a thousand clients across 18 countries have used Kapture’s products to enhance their customer experience, including Unilever, Reliance, Coca-Cola, Bigbasket, Meesho, Airtel Payments Bank and Cathay Pacific. Kapture delivers industry-specific solutions powered by AI, tailored workflows, and seamless automation. Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore and we have offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR in India, in addition to offices in the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines and Indonesia. What is this role all about? As a Associate Director- Growth , you will work closely with enterprise customers to identify growth opportunities through AI, automation and digital transformation initiatives. You will act as a trusted strategic advisor, helping clients unlock business value while driving platform adoption, expansion, and long-term partnerships. Sounds interesting? Here’s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role: You will build and manage relationships with enterprise stakeholders, ranging from operational teams to CXO-level decision-makers, becoming a trusted advisor for customer growth and transformation initiatives. You will identify AI-led business opportunities, uncover new use cases, and drive upsell and cross-sell opportunities across your account portfolio. You will lead strategic business reviews, workshops, and executive presentations that demonstrate measurable business impact and ROI. You will partner with Product, Solutions, Delivery, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful adoption and execution of customer growth initiatives. You will analyze customer business challenges, operational metrics, and market trends to recommend scalable automation and customer experience improvements. This is a Bengaluru -based role. We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in-person interactions fuel innovation and agility. What does success look like in this role? You consistently help customers realize measurable business outcomes through AI and automation while driving strong adoption, executive engagement, revenue expansion, and long-term customer retention. What would make you a good fit for this role? Here are the basic requirements: You have 4-8 years of experience in Consulting, GTM Strategy, Growth Strategy, Founder’s Office or Strategic Account Management roles. You have experience working directly with enterprise customers and influencing senior business stakeholders. You have successfully driven business growth, strategic initiatives, customer expansion, or transformation programs. You possess strong analytical thinking and can translate business challenges into actionable solutions. You can converse in Tamil ( Added Advantage - As you would need to handle a few clients from Chennai. ) What are the most critical skills for this role? You can confidently engage and communicate with stakeholders across all levels, including CXOs and business leaders. You can identify growth opportunities and build compelling business cases that drive customer investment decisions. You can combine strategic thinking with commercial acumen to influence outcomes and drive revenue expansion. You can simplify complex concepts and present data-driven recommendations with clarity and impact. You will have an advantage if you: You have prior experience in SaaS, AI, Automation, Customer Experience, CRM, or Enterprise Technology platforms. You have worked in consulting, founder’s office, business transformation, or growth-focused roles within high-growth technology companies. You have experience managing global or multi-market enterprise accounts. You have demonstrated success in driving strategic customer initiatives, digital transformation projects, or executive-level engagements. Why should you be interested? Here’s what you will gain from this role: Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI-powered customer experience transformation. Exposure to enterprise customers across industries and international markets. High ownership and visibility with direct impact on revenue growth and customer success. Opportunity to influence strategic business decisions and work closely with senior leadership. A fast-paced environment that accelerates learning, career growth, and leadership development. The chance to shape how leading enterprises adopt AI and automation to transform customer experiences.

About OleriaOleria provides adaptive and autonomous identity security solutions to protect and enable today's dynamic enterprise. Our platform delivers unparalleled fine-grained access visibility, including usage insights at the individual resource level, so CISOs can confidently answer: Who has access to what? How did they get it? What are they doing with it?With our recent launch of Adaptive Identity Governance, we have a massive opportunity to disrupt the legacy IGA market. We're replacing multi-year, multi-million dollar deployments with a data-first, AI-native platform that gets organizations governed in under an hour. It's a wide-open market, and we're just getting started.Founded by cybersecurity veterans Jim Alkove and Jagadeesh Kunda, who built and secured platforms used by billions globally, we've raised $60M+ from Evolution Equity Partners, Salesforce Ventures, Tapestry VC, Zscaler, and other technology luminaries. Our Fortune 500 and public sector clients trust us to protect millions of users worldwide.We're proud to be recognized as a LinkedIn Best Startup and a Best Startup to Work For by Built In. Join a well-funded team with real traction, a game-changing new product, and a mission to deliver identity security that sets your business free.Learn more: www.oleria.comThe MissionYou are the operational engine of Oleria’s marketing function. You own the growth number, run the weekly operating cadence across Bay Area and Bangalore teams, and ensure every external interaction—from analyst briefings to conference keynotes—reinforces Oleria’s position as the leader in AI-native identity security. This is a hands-on senior IC role. You build campaigns, review pipeline data, prep founders for market-facing moments, and ship work product every week. With AI leverage, you do what used to require a team.What You ShipAI-powered campaign workflows: automated lead nurturing, signal-based outbound triggers, and personalized ABM sequences built with AI — not manually assembled in spreadsheets Content velocity: 3-5 campaign assets per week (landing pages, email sequences, social, ads) using AI drafting and the Bangalore web/design engineer for production Pipeline model management: own the marketing-sourced path of Oleria's two-path pipeline model, tracking from lead to closed-won with full attribution Campaign strategy and execution across paid, organic, and event channels Marketing budget allocation and pipeline contribution reporting Founder prep and messaging frameworks for conferences, analyst briefings, and media Partnership activation from the marketing side (AWS Marketplace, channel partners) Cross-functional operating rhythm: continuous pipeline reviews with sales, campaign retrospectives, planning aligned to the business target Marketing attribution and full-funnel transparency What We Look For8-20 years in B2B SaaS growth marketing, demand generation, or marketing operations — ideally at a Series A-C cybersecurity or enterprise software company where you were the first or second marketing hire, not inheriting an existing machine You’ve personally built and run campaigns, not just managed vendors who did. You know Pardot (or HubSpot/Marketo), Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and SEMrush at an operator level Experience preparing executives or founders for high-stakes moments: keynotes, analyst briefings, board presentations, media interviews Comfort with data: you pull your own pipeline reports, build your own dashboards, and make budget decisions based on what the numbers say You are AI-native. Claude, GPT, and AI research tools are your daily multipliers — not experiments. You draft campaigns in hours, pull competitive intel in minutes, and generate 10 messaging variants before most marketers finish one. Show us your AI workflow in the interview. You've rebuilt or stood up a marketing function from scratch. You know what it means to have no playbook, no existing campaigns, and no team to inherit — and that energizes you. You’ve worked across time zones and can set clear weekly objectives for a remote team while giving them autonomy to deliver Strong opinions on what works in enterprise security marketing, loosely held when the data says otherwise Nice to HaveExperience working directly with product/engineering teams on PLG or product-led sales motions Familiarity with the Rule of 60 or similar GTM efficiency frameworks for capital-efficient growth Experience in identity security, IAM, IGA, or adjacent cybersecurity markets Familiarity with Clay, Dreamdata, or similar modern GTM tooling Experience with product-led growth motions alongside enterprise sales Background at an AI-first or AI-native company What Makes This Role RewardingWe believe in taking care of the people who power our mission. Here's how we invest in you:Compensation that reflects your value - We strive to offer compensation that matches leading companies in our industry, because exceptional talent deserves exceptional recognition. Health coverage you can count on - Your wellbeing matters. A culture that brings out your best - Join a team where everyone takes initiative and accountability for our shared success. You'll be surrounded by colleagues who ask bold questions, challenge assumptions, and never stop learning. Here, individual brilliance amplifies through collective impact as we collaborate to achieve what none of us could alone. This is where your growth and our mission become one. Role OverviewWe are hiring a Managing Director to lead the strategy, delivery, and enterprise‑scale adoption of agent‑based automation across global financial services operations. This role sits within the Global Delivery Simplification organization and is accountable for transforming how complex, control‑intensive operational processes are executed using agentic AI in a highly regulated environment.The Managing Director will own the end‑to‑end product portfolio for agent‑driven solutions across Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody, with full accountability for value realization, risk posture, and sustained operational performance at scale.This role combines senior product leadership, people management, and executive‑level stakeholder accountability, requiring strong judgment, organizational influence, and ownership of outcomes well beyond initial delivery.ROLE PURPOSEThe Managing Director leads multiple cross‑functional PODs responsible for conceiving, delivering, scaling, and governing agentic AI solutions across core business services including Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody.The role is accountable for enterprise‑level product strategy, investment prioritization, roadmap governance, and value realization of agent‑based automation, ensuring solutions deliver material operational impact while meeting regulatory, audit, data governance, and model risk management expectations.Success in this role requires the ability to set clear strategic direction, balance innovation with operational resilience, and institutionalize controls, auditability, and explainability as non‑negotiable product standards.Key Responsibilities Own enterprise‑level business outcomes for agent‑based automation, including efficiency, capacity, quality, client experience, and risk reduction. Define and communicate the long‑term vision and strategy for agentic AI across global operations. Set strategic priorities across Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody based on materiality, risk, and value. Sponsor identification and sequencing of high‑impact automation opportunities across the operating model. Ensure alignment of product strategy with regulatory expectations, enterprise AI risk frameworks, and control standards. Govern translation of simplification objectives into coherent product portfolios, roadmaps, and investment cases. Provide executive oversight of agile delivery, ensuring consistency of standards, outcomes, and operational readiness across PODs. Own the full lifecycle governance of agentic AI solutions, including approval frameworks, human‑in‑the‑loop models, escalation design, and decommissioning decisions. Establish enterprise standards for controls, auditability, explainability, and evidence capture in agent‑based solutions. Set materiality thresholds, risk tolerances, and escalation models for autonomous and semi‑autonomous execution. Make portfolio‑level decisions to scale, pause, remediate, or retire agents based on performance, risk, and value realization. Oversee production performance management including accuracy trends, systemic failure patterns, and control effectiveness. Lead and develop senior Product Owners and product leaders, setting clear expectations and accountability for outcomes. Partner with senior operations, risk, compliance, audit, data, and technology leaders to ensure enterprise alignment. Define, track, and report value realization, risk metrics, and control outcomes to executive governance forums. Represent Global Delivery Simplification in senior leadership discussions related to AI strategy, operational resilience, and regulatory engagement.Skills And Capabilities Advanced product leadership capability, including portfolio strategy, investment governance, and organizational alignment. Exceptional judgment in balancing automation ambition, operational risk, regulatory scrutiny, and reputational considerations. Accountable for maximizing growth and profitability through strategic capital allocation, pricing, monetization, and optimizing commercial metrics like ARR, NRR, CAC payback, LTV/CAC, ACV, and sales productivity.

normalizedText: About RateGainRateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality, working with 13,000+ customers and 700+ partners across 160+ countries. RateGain helps travel and hospitality businesses accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet-share expansion.Today, RateGain is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data, enabling revenue management, distribution, and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, destination marketing organizations, metasearch companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises, and ferries to drive better business outcomes.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, RateGain works with 33 of the Top 40 Hotel Chains, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, 7 of the Top 10 Car Rental companies, and all leading Destination Marketing Organizations, Online Travel Agents, and metasearch platforms, including 25 Global Fortune 500 companies, unlocking new revenue every day.Recognized globally for its innovation and impact, RateGain has been named Best Digital Marketing Agency by HotelTechReport Awards and Best Channel Manager by the World Travel Tech Awards. The company has also been certified as a Great Place to Work® in the USA, Spain, and India, with recognition in India for seven consecutive years. In 2025, RateGain was honored as Emerging Company of the Year at The Economic Times Awards for Corporate Excellence, named among Deloitte India Technology Fast 50 for the sixth time, and won Excellence in Best AI Solution Showcase for UNO VIVA at the CII National AI Awards 2025, among other industry recognitions.Mission: Build and institutionalize RateGain’s growth engine by systematically identifying, prioritizing, and executing the highest return growth opportunities across products, markets, and go -to-market, ensuring capital is deployed deliberately to maximize growth and profitability.Purpose & Strategic Significance This role exists to answer one question, every quarter: “Where should RateGain invest next to grow fastest and most profitably?” You will understand how the company allocates capital across products, markets, and go-to-market, ensuring every investment is deliberate, sequenced, and accountable for outcomes.Primary Responsibilities: 1. Portfolio Strategy • Classify current product lines: DaaS, Distribution, MarTech, and sub-products across growth, share, and profitability to define clear invest/scale / maintain / harvest/exit postures.• Build a forward -looking view of the business across:- Core revenue engines (driving current cash flow)- Growth accelerators (scaling businesses)- Future bets (emerging opportunities)• Translate this portfolio view into explicit capital allocation decisions, including:- Where to increase investment (product, GTM, partnerships)- Where to protect margins and optimize- Where to reduce or redeploy resources• Own the annual portfolio strategy and quarterly refresh cycles, stress-testing assumptions with data, scenario planning, and market signals.2. Founded in 2014, the firm serves ultra-high net worth individuals, family offices, institutional investors, and an ecosystem of founders and entrepreneurs through its Wealth Management and Asset Management divisions. The firm operates across Singapore, Dubai (DIFC), India, and the UK, regulated by MAS, DFSA, and registered with AMFI.Keenai, a wealthtech platform, is part of the Lighthouse Canton Group and represents the technology-forward evolution of the group’s wealth capabilities.ROLE OVERVIEW & CONTEXTWe are seeking an Assistant Vice President – Digital Marketing to develop and lead the digital and social marketing strategy for the business, based in Bangalore (with Mumbai as a secondary location). Digital marketing has advanced significantly through AI-enabled workflows, marketing automation, data-driven personalisation, and integrated marketing technology. This is a strategic, process-driven and data-led role: you will own the group’s digital channels — web, email, social, webinars and paid media — while shaping scalable, AI-enabled processes, marketing operations and technology-enabled ways of working that improve efficiency, governance, engagement and brand awareness across the group’s businesses.Importantly, the group is currently mid-way through a complete transformation of its MarTech stack — spanning the website, content management system (CMS), analytics, and marketing automation platforms — alongside a migration of the Salesforce CRM. This is a priority backfill, and the incoming AVP will be expected to step into this transition at pace, take ownership of in-flight workstreams, and ensure there is no loss of momentum or institutional knowledge during the changeover.KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1. Digital Marketing Strategy & Operating Model•Develop the digital marketing roadmap, strategy and operating model across brand promotion, client acquisition, client retention and marketing operations.•Translate business and revenue goals into digital campaigns, working closely with internal stakeholders and digital vendors.•Manage the digital marketing budget to ensure efficient and effective spend.2. Campaign Execution & Full-Funnel Performance•Plan, implement, measure and optimise digital campaigns across social media, paid ads, website, webinars and email.•Drive full-funnel optimisation to improve engagement, lead generation, lead nurturing and conversion across channels.•Run paid search and organic / natural search campaigns in-house across geographies (India, Singapore, UAE, UK).•Own digital analytics, insights and reporting — attribution modelling, CAC/LTV analysis, conversion-rate optimisation, and campaign ROI.3. AI-Enabled Marketing & Operations•Design and improve AI-enabled marketing processes — content workflows, campaign optimisation, audience insights and reporting automation.•Establish responsible, well-governed use of AI tools across the marketing function.•Build repeatable marketing operations processes, SLAs and reporting cadences; coordinate with marketing counterparts in Singapore and Dubai.4. MarTech Stack, CRM & Data•Own, run and scale the marketing technology stack across key layers — CRM, CMS, CDP and engagement platforms — ensuring systems, integrations and data flows support execution, measurement and growth.•Administer and govern the Salesforce CRM — data hygiene, lead routing, segmentation, and campaign orchestration.•Operate and optimise marketing automation and personalisation for triggered, multi-market lifecycle campaigns.•Maintain a robust analytics and tagging framework (e.g., GA4, Google Tag Manager), ensuring accurate, privacy-compliant measurement.5. Website, Content & Brand Amplification•Own the group’s websites and CMS — performance, SEO, UX, content publishing and conversion optimisation.•Amplify thought-leadership and brand content across digital and social channels (LinkedIn, YouTube, podcasts, webinars).•Partner with content and design teams to translate research and insights into high-performing digital assets, and support commercialisation plans for products and campaigns.6. Compliance & Regulatory Alignment•Ensure all digital marketing communications comply with MAS, DFSA, SEBI/AMFI, FCA, and PDPA/DPDP regulations across jurisdictions.•Work closely with Legal and Compliance on approval workflows for client-facing materials, disclaimers, and financial-promotion content.CANDIDATE PROFILE — MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS•Graduate with 6–10 years of strong experience in digital, performance and social media marketing, and a proven record of scaling new-customer acquisition and funnel conversion.•Proven knowledge of digital marketing channels and best practices.•Hands-on fluency across digital and marketing-technology platforms — including MoEngage, Segment, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, paid search and social advertising platforms, CRM, CMS, marketing automation, tagging, data-capture and campaign-workflow tools.•Experience running paid search and natural (organic) search campaigns in-house across geographies.•Strongly data-driven — confident using analytics, reporting and performance insights to guide decisions.•Familiarity with practical AI applications in digital marketing — content normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typePermanent LocationMumbai, Maharashtra Full job description Job Description Senior Manager / Associate Director - Branding Company: Upstox Location: Mumbai, Bangalore Work arrangement: 5 days in the office About Upstox Upstox is building the future of investing — simple, powerful, and accessible to everyone. As one of India’s fastest-growing fintech platforms, Upstox is backed by leading global investors, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global. Our mission is to enable wealth creation for every Indian, serving millions of users ranging from first-time investors to experienced traders. We operate at speed, with purpose, and in an environment that values impact, ownership, and innovation. The Role: Senior Manager / Associate Director - Branding This is a mid senior role for a strategic brand builder and storyteller with a strong analytical mindset. You will own and execute full-funnel marketing initiatives, and drive measurable business outcomes in a digital-first, consumer technology environment. If you know how to build a brand people trust, spend media dollars with intent, and turn a market moment into a campaign, this role is for you. What You'll Own Brand Strategy & Positioning: Define, refine, and reinfoirce Upstox’s brand positioning, voice, and messaging across all touchpoints, establishing a clear, differentiated point of view. Brand Storytelling: Work with founders and define the brand narrative end to end - craft the stories that build trust and affinity with millions of Indian investors and traders. Integrated Campaigns: Conceptualize and execute integrated 360° marketing campaigns (ATL, digital, and organic), balancing creativity with performance. Performance & ROI: Track campaign effectiveness and optimize marketing investment, ensuring strong ROI through data-driven decision-making. Media Investment: Own media planning and spending with a mindful, ROI-first approach - ensuring every rupee is deployed with intent and measurable impact. Go-to-Market Leadership: Lead go-to-market strategy for new product and feature launches, from positioning and messaging through to execution. Brand Growth Ownership: Own brand health and growth metrics — awareness, consideration, and share of mind — translating insight into action. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Growth, Design, and leadership stakeholders to embed the brand across every customer touchpoint. Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing brand marketing team. Who You Are A seasoned marketing professional with 8 - 12 years of experience, including 3 - 5 years leading brand or growth strategies at a senior level. Demonstrated success in establishing or expanding a consumer-facing brand, with a focus on tech-driven, digital-first, or fintech landscapes.. Deep mastery of full-funnel marketing strategies, spanning ATL and digital media, coupled with a rigorous, hands-on approach to media investment. A compelling brand storyteller who excels at crafting narratives that drive impact, whether in a high-level boardroom or on a public billboard. Sharp analytical capabilities, with a proven knack for converting complex consumer insights and market data into strategic brand actions. Thrives in agile, high-velocity settings, demonstrating extreme ownership and accountability in a fast-scaling corporate landscape. Possesses a decisive bias for action and the leadership presence to influence leadership stakeholders and collaborative cross-functional partners. An MBA degree or comparable professional background is highly valued. If you have built a brand in a niche market, or a digital consumer facing brand, we want to speak to you! Why This Role Rocks Opportunity to own and shape the brand narrative of one of India’s most dynamic fintech companies. Significant influence across brand, product marketing, and communications strategy. Direct impact on millions of customers and the future of investing in India. A culture that values creativity, agility, and leadership ownership. normalizedText: Overview Were introducing a new Marketing Capability and Operations role for India to drive and embed key marketing capabilities whilst retaining direct connectivity with the Global Marketing Capability and Operations team. This role will also be responsible of driving the marketing capability agenda for the India market across both Foods and Beverages. This is a key role as part of the Global Marketing Capability Operations sub-function to land our Powering Positive Growth (PPG) Agenda for PEPs consumer organization across both food and beverages for PepsiCo globally. The global capability and operations program is expected to deliver step-changed brand-building organization capability to support development of our overall pull muscle through our PPG priorities of developing Iconic Brands, embedding the PepsiCo-wide growth model, Growth Navigator and delivering significant AM efficiencies through Becoming Better Investors for reinvestment in top markets, key brands and new future-facing capabilities This role is to elevate India PO1 marketing capability efforts through the partnership with Global marketing capability operations team to develop and deploy world class marketing capability content and drive the capability building. This role will deliver and embed the global transformation capability program which is expected to deliver step-changed brand-building capabilities to support development of Iconic Brands, embed the PepsiCo growth model, and new future facing capabilities. Responsibilities Key responsibilities of this role include: Marketing Transformation leadership: enabling, launching and removing barriers to embed the transformation in International Beverages with a focus on Iconic Brands inclusive of the overall Creative excellence and content workstream and Growth Navigator. Lead Marketing Capability Operations in India to embed sustain change across PepsiCo Land the priority workstreams of Iconic Brands that move culture and Growth Navigator across India Foods Beverages. Ensure close cooperation with the CMO India Foods to orchestrate the transformation within International Beverages and India Foods. Be the Change Agents for PepsiCos Consumer Organization in India. Marketing Insights Capability Strategy Leadership Build deployholisticcapability programming calendar for inclusive of: Upskilling against PPG priorities of Growth Navigator, Iconic Brands, and Human Centricity using the global PPG Marketing Academy material, to build knowledge amongst relevant associates Ongoing support/consulting/coaching opportunities on key brand artifacts (Brand Pulse, CBPs, DBAs) and growth planning documents (BGS, TCP Architecture, TCP Opportunity Briefs, etc.) to elevate deliverable quality Governance process for key brand deliverables within the growth planning process (BGS, ABP, TCP Architecture, TCP Opportunity Brief) to drive oversight and accountability amongst India leadership Align agenda and collaborate on deployment with the Global Marketing Capabilities team, and ensure ongoing tracking of deployments within the global tracker.Ensure full utilization and understanding of latest global tools (e.g. Ada Amplify+), frameworks (e.g. TCP KPI Objectives framework), and templates (e.g. new BGS template) across the full growth planning processConsult global marketing capabilities team on future priorities and areas of focus to drive continued impactCoordinate as needed with global MCO comms team on communications plans to support capability and culture initiatives within India teams Creative Excellence Leadership Serve as the Creative excellence champion for India with focus on: Aligning and executing a holistic plan to elevate the creative capability within the India teams with support from the global marketing capabilities team. Plan to include amplification of global Creative Spark townhalls/emails as well as any additional inspiration and learning opportunities for the India teams Coordinating execution of One PepsiCo Creative forums (Strategic Brand Week, Global Creative Council, Global Creative Advisory) partnering with the global creative capabilities team and India brand teamsEstablishing protocol for Market Creative Reviews within IndiaOwning the external Awards process to deliver a winning awards pipeline across priority awards including Cannes an Effies, supporting teams as needed with awards information and case study developmentDriving and managing the BAM process for the India teams: aligning campaign submissions and entries among India brand and leadership teams, coordinating all BAM related communications across India, and ensuring strict adherence to the timeline and process protocols. Growth Navigator Deployment Support GN roll out across India in line with ExComm: Embed scorecards, develop and deliver core enhancements as needed Embedding GN through OU Growth planning processes Qualifications Bachelor Degree in Marketing or related field At least 10 years working experience related to Marketing Strong leadership, organizational savvy and high learning agility Strong timeline and project management capability. Ability to build excellent relationships, including senior leader stakeholder management Knowledge of PepsiCo Marketing organization and previous brand management experience preferred with critical experience in creative development, planning, and awards preferred Experience with Learning and Development, training content development and center of excellence experience is an advantage.
