normalizedText: StellenbeschreibungHead of Global Marketing Market Insight, Access and EvidenceStellenstandort: L&R A WienUnbefristet / Befristet: UnbefristetWir suchen Top-Talente, die Know-how, Ideen und Ambitionen in unsere internationalen Teams einbringen und realisieren möchten. L&R ist ein weltweit agierendes und expandierendes Unternehmen für Medizinprodukte. In unseren Kerngeschäftsfeldern entwickeln und produzieren wir innovative Produkte und Lösungen für PatientInnen; von Hightech-Anwendungen in der Unterdrucktherapie bis zur modernen Wundauflage.Startdatum der Ausschreibung: 29.06.26Your Impact:We are seeking an experienced and strategic leader to join our Global Marketing Leadership Team as Global Head of Market Insight, Access & Therapy Evidence. This pivotal role will lead the organisation’s market insight, market access, and therapy evidence capabilities, ensuring data-driven and evidence-based decision-making across the business.You will play a critical role in shaping commercial strategy, driving market access initiatives linked to adoption of pathways and solutions, generating meaningful clinical and health economic evidence, and providing the insights needed to support customer engagement, strengthen advocacy, and accelerate sustainable growth. Develop and lead the global strategy for market insight, market access, and therapy evidence, aligned with business priorities and growth objectives. Translate market, customer, competitor, and environmental data into actionable insights that inform strategic decisions and portfolio priorities. Lead the development of global market access strategies and support compelling value propositions that drive adoption and growth. Oversee the generation and application of clinical, health economic, and outcomes evidence to demonstrate the value of products and solutions. Partner closely with marketing, commercial, clinical, finance, and regional teams to embed insight and evidence into business planning and execution. Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. Ensure robust data governance, quality, compliance, and ethical use of information across all activities. Establish performance metrics and evaluate the impact of insight, access, and evidence initiatives. Champion innovative methodologies, technologies, and external partnerships to enhance insight generation and future market readiness.Lead strategic projects and respond effectively to evolving business prioritiesYour Impact:You are a commercially minded and analytically strong leader with a passion for using insights and evidence to influence strategy and drive business performance. You thrive in complex global environments and have a proven ability to lead teams, influence senior stakeholders, and translate complex data into meaningful business actions. Significant leadership experience in market insight, market access, health economics, evidence generation, commercial strategy, or a related discipline. Experience within healthcare, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or another highly regulated industry. Proven track record of developing market access strategies and leveraging clinical, health economic, or outcomes evidence to support adoption and growth. Strong experience translating complex internal and external data into strategic recommendations and business decisions. Demonstrated success leading and developing high-performing teams within matrix organisations. Experience working across global, regional, and cross-functional environments.Why you should choose L&RFlexible working hours through flextime and the option to work from homeIn-house employee cafeteria with meal subsidiesCorporate health promotion measures (e.g., myClubs, company bike program)Training opportunities both internally (L&R Academy) and externallyEmployee events and one month of free childcare during the summerWe would like to get to know youFor this full-time position, we offer you a minimum annual gross salary of € 80,000.00. role: Strategy & Planning, Finance Team, Vice President

jdEvidence.value: Global Head of Corporate Strategy and FP&A
Financial strategy, planning, reporting, and analytics for BlackRock firm-wide and JioBlackRock, advising senior leadership on financial objectives and strategic initiatives.

normalizedText: About This RoleBusiness Unit Overview:Finance and Strategy is critical to BlackRock for profitable growth. The team shapes long-term objectives for growth and scale; guides near-term objectives, resource allocations and budgets; analyzes business metrics to identify growth and scale opportunities; and brings insights to help successfully manage our financial objectives amidst a dynamic business environment. We are at the center of the firm, working across all levels of BlackRock to provide both a broad and deep understanding of the firm’s business and financial position and opportunities.Role DescriptionWithin the Finance and Strategy group, BlackRock is seeking a Vice President to join the Strategic Finance team in Mumbai. The Strategic Finance team is responsible for overall financial strategy of the firm and rolls up to the Global Head of Corporate Strategy and FP&A. The team also works closely with the Financial Information and Analytics (FI&A) team which operates with a Center of Excellence (CoE) model and is responsible for efficient, thoughtful, and scalable production to meet operational excellence, deliver high-value business insights through front-end visualization tools, application of modelling and analytics to generate new insights at scale, engage with technology partners to accelerate data and process transformation. The group is also responsible for engaging with business partners to advise and offer expertise on the fundamental building blocks of how we manage the firm and bring insights from our financials.This proposed role is envisioned to have 3 parts to it:Firm wide Reporting, Analytics and Strategy: Working with the global strategic finance and FP&A team on overall BlackRock firm wide long-range forecasts and planning process, board presentations, as well as strategic projects, investment and growth priorities, and analytics (using different types of financial and business metrics to generate insights for the most senior leaders at the firm incl. Global CFO). Key target outcome here will be to have a step jump in the strategic finance work which happens out of India and add overall value to the firm. This will also involve driving forward key CoE priorities of FI&A team to being in efficiency as the firm scales towards 2030 strategy.JioBlackRock: Working front-end with JioBLK teams (asset management, wealth management and brokerage) in Mumbai and helping them set up the right building blocks for Finance and Strategy. This will involve engaging directly with CEO, CXOs and other leaders at JioBlackRock applying a shareholder lens i.e. advising and reviewing business plans, managing capital requirements / cash burn levels, setting right reporting frameworks and being a thought partner to global business leaders at BlackRock ensuring right oversight and pursuing select strategy/ change management initiatives.Select strategy projects / building India as a platform: Working with India leadership on other special projects from time to timeKey ResponsibilitiesFoster and develop strong business partnering relationships, becoming a trusted advisor to the CXOs, business and finance stakeholdersDevelop and maintain financial models to provide accurate and timely insights into business performance, robust long-term planning, and scenario analysisConduct in-depth analysis of business and financial results highlighting key drivers and present analysis in a clear and concise manner appropriate for senior leadershipOversee periodic financial reports (i.e., weekly, monthly, quarterly) for senior management; includes quarterly earnings support, Board of Directors presentations, and firm forecast / budgetDelivering data-driven insights and recommendations to influence key business decisionsDrive enhancement, automation, and scalability in processes and reportingManage a high-performing team, providing mentorship and clear direction to drive excellenceBe hands-on in executing the key priorities along with the people manager responsibilitiesCollaborate with cross-functional partners and other Finance & Strategy sub-teamsDrive a collaborative and supportive work environment, coaching and developing team membersSkills & QualificationsChartered Accountant (first attempt or rank mandatory) with 8-12 years of post-qualification experience in financial due diligence or top tier management consulting or innovate tech organization with strategy/ finance experience or premier asset managerMBA in Finance from top tier institution, CFA from CFA Institute USA (both preferred but optional)Strong problem solving and first principle thinkingExperience in engaging with CXOs with ability to articular well in verbal and written communicationExperience in building and managing high performance teams and grooming young talentStrong commercial and business mindset with ability to identify key drivers moving the needle on top and bottom lineStrong command of data analytics, financial modeling, and scenario planningAbility to manage fragmentation in a fast paced environmentHigh intent to perform and ownershipCollaborative to be able to navigate through the organizationExperience with driving tech transformation and AI initiatives in past organizations a big plusStrong proficiency in all Microsoft Office applications; advanced Excel and PowerPoint skillsOur BenefitsTo help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.Our hybrid work modelBlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.Guidance on AI use for candidatesAt BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.About BlackRockAt BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law. role: VP Retail Marketing Strategy and Brand Partnerships
normalizedText: Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. Job Title Vice President – Retail Marketing strategy, Brand Partnership & Events Business / Function International Wealth & Personal Banking / Global Banking & Markets Location [Mumbai India] Grade GCB 5 Job Introduction The Global Marketing function is focused on supporting the strategic and revenue growth priorities of the Bank. The function focuses on understanding customers and the identification, development and execution of Marketing strategies, campaigns and activities that support and strengthen the HSBC brand, support the drive for revenue and increase customer value and satisfaction in order to meet agreed targets and objectives at both a global and market level.This role will be responsible to bring new Brand partners, create long term Intellectual properties(IPs), strategy and framework for delivery of all events, third party sponsorships and the coordination of all activities to drive Brand recall, acquire new customers and engage with existing customers for HSBC Wealth & Personal Banking business in India.Principal Responsibilities Lead the development and execution of HSBC India’s brand partnership strategy to strengthen brand equity, deepen customer engagement and drive commercial outcomes across priority businesses. Identify, evaluate and negotiate strategic partnerships across sports, entertainment, fashion, travel, luxury, culture, technology and lifestyle that enhance HSBC’s brand proposition and create differentiated customer value. Build and manage a portfolio of signature HSBC-owned intellectual properties (IPs) and flagship experiences that reinforce the bank’s positioning and support customer acquisition, engagement and retention. Develop integrated content strategies that amplify campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels, ensuring consistency of brand messaging and measurable business impact. Lead the conceptualisation and delivery of premium client experiences, large-scale events and sponsorship activations, ensuring world-class execution and alignment with HSBC’s global brand standards. Work closely with business teams including Wealth & Premier Banking, Credit Cards, Commercial Banking and Corporate Communications to translate business priorities into impactful marketing programmes. Collaborate with global, regional and local stakeholders to identify opportunities to localise global partnerships and maximise their relevance for the Indian market. Establish strategic relationships with leading rights holders, agencies, creators, media partners and event organisers to unlock innovative collaboration opportunities. Drive end-to-end management of sponsorships and partnerships, including commercial negotiations, governance, activation planning, legal and compliance coordination, measurement and reporting. Lead content creation across multiple formats including digital, social, experiential, video and thought leadership, ensuring relevance to target customer segments and HSBC’s brand positioning. Develop measurement frameworks and KPIs to evaluate partnership effectiveness, event ROI, customer engagement, brand health and commercial impact, using insights to optimise future investments. Manage annual budgets, procurement processes and agency partnerships to ensure efficient allocation of resources and delivery against agreed objectives. Ensure all marketing activities comply with HSBC’s governance, regulatory, legal, risk and brand requirements. Stay abreast of emerging consumer trends, cultural movements, technology innovations and partnership opportunities to continuously evolve HSBC India’s marketing capabilities. Mentor and develop team members while fostering a culture of creativity, collaboration, accountability and execution excellence. Key Success Measures Brand consideration and perception improvement. Growth in customer acquisition and engagement through partnerships. Commercial impact generated from sponsorships and partner programmes. ROI and effectiveness of events and experiential marketing. Reach and engagement of integrated content campaigns. Successful delivery of flagship HSBC IPs and customer experiences. Stakeholder satisfaction across business, regional and global teams. Strong governance, risk management and budget optimisation. Role Requirements / Qualification / Experience Strategic thinker with the ability to translate business priorities into differentiated brand, partnership and experiential marketing strategies. Proven capability to originate, negotiate and manage high-value strategic partnerships with leading brands, rights holders, agencies and commercial partners. Strong commercial acumen with experience demonstrating measurable business outcomes, customer acquisition, engagement and return on marketing investment. Deep understanding of affluent and wealth customer segments, premium consumer behaviour and luxury marketing. Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior business leaders across local, regional and global teams. Demonstrated leadership in delivering integrated marketing programmes across digital, content, events, sponsorships and customer experiences. Strong negotiation, influencing and contract management capabilities. Experience managing multiple agencies, production partners and cross-functional teams in a highly matrixed organisation. Ability to balance creativity with governance, regulatory requirements, risk management and brand compliance. Strong analytical mindset with experience using customer insights and campaign performance metrics to drive optimisation. Exceptional communication, presentation and executive storytelling skills. Ability to lead through ambiguity while managing multiple high-profile initiatives simultaneously. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications or a related discipline. MBA or Postgraduate qualification from a reputed institution preferred. Professional certifications in Marketing, Brand Strategy, Digital Marketing or Sponsorship Management would be advantageous. Strong understanding of financial services marketing and regulatory requirements is desirable. Experience 12–15+ years of progressive experience in strategic marketing, brand management, partnerships, sponsorships, content or experiential marketing. Demonstrated success in leading large-scale integrated marketing campaigns with measurable commercial impact. Proven track record of developing and commercialising strategic partnerships across sectors such as sports, entertainment, travel, luxury, fashion, technology or lifestyle. Experience leading premium customer experiences, flagship events and sponsorship activations from strategy through execution. Experience managing significant marketing budgets and driving optimisation based on ROI and performance metrics. Strong experience working with senior executives, external partners and global stakeholders. Prior experience within banking, financial services, premium consumer brands or multinational organisations is highly preferred. Experience leading and developing high-performing marketing teams in a matrix environment. Demonstrated ability to build and scale proprietary brand IPs that enhance customer engagement and brand differentiation. Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.Additional Information Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required. You’ll achieve more at HSBC.HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationMumbai, Maharashtra Full job description About the Company: Capwise Financial Services Pvt. Ltd. (CFSPL) is a boutique investment bank providing comprehensive financial advisory services across sectors in India. Since our inception in 2020, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing investment banks in Mumbai, having successfully closed 35 equity and M&A transactions and raised ₹22,000 crore in debt. Our services span across debt syndication, private equity, M&A advisory, and capital markets. Role Overview: We are looking for a seasoned professional to lead our Debt Capital Markets (DCM) vertical. The role involves full ownership of origination, structuring, execution, and closure of DCM transactions including structured finance, project finance, acquisition finance, and refinancing. The ideal candidate will bring deep lender relationships, proven deal-making ability, strong leadership, and a track record of delivering large-ticket transactions. Key Responsibilities: Transaction Execution: Drive execution of debt transactions including term loan syndication, structured finance, refinancing, securitization, and acquisition finance. Oversee the preparation of detailed proposals, project reports, CMA data, and Information Memorandums (IMs). Ensure timely execution and closure of transactions, coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders. Lender Relationships & Syndication: Maintain and expand a strong network with Banks, NBFCs, Financial Institutions, and Mutual Funds. Liaise with lenders to secure approvals and ensure smooth disbursement processes. Lead negotiations on terms, pricing, and documentation. Credit Appraisal & Financial Analysis: Evaluate business models and perform detailed financial and credit analysis. Review and guide the development of robust financial models. Ensure compliance with RBI guidelines and bank credit norms. Origination & Business Development: Identify and originate new debt syndication and structured finance mandates. Build and nurture client relationships across industries. Strategize and lead client pitches to win mandates. Leadership & Team Management: Lead and mentor a high-performing team across origination and execution. Provide guidance on project evaluation, structuring, and market strategy. Foster a collaborative, agile, and target-driven team culture. Required Skills: 15+ years of relevant experience in debt syndication, project finance, or structured finance. Deep network across banks, NBFCs, and FIs. Strong financial acumen with hands-on experience in credit appraisal and structuring. Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with a strong sense of ownership. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders and lead end-to-end deal execution. Qualifications: Chartered Accountant (CA), MBA (Finance), or equivalent qualification. 15+ years of experience in Debt Syndication, Investment Banking, or Corporate Finance with strong lender and client network. Why Join Capwise: Take charge of a high-impact vertical with complete ownership of strategy, team, and outcomes. Be part of a dynamic and fast-growing investment bank that has closed marquee deals in a short span of time. Enjoy the agility and autonomy of a boutique setup with the backing of experienced leadership. Work on a wide range of complex and innovative transactions across sectors and structures. Your performance and initiative are directly recognized and rewarded at Capwise.

role: Senior Marketing Manager – Real Estate Projects & Corporate Branding
normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationMumbai, Maharashtra Full job description Senior Marketing Manager – Real Estate Projects & Corporate Branding Driving Real Estate Growth Through Strategic Marketing At Adwise, we are more than just a real estate mandate firm , we are strategic growth partners for developers. With expertise in project advisory, sales strategy, pricing intelligence, market research, channel partner activation, and project marketing, we help real estate projects gain stronger positioning and faster sales. Our mission is to bridge the gap between great developments and successful market execution. We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Marketing Manager to lead marketing initiatives for both our mandate projects and the Adwise brand. Position: Senior Marketing Manager Role Overview As a Senior Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for leading the complete marketing function for Adwise Elements LLP and its real estate mandate projects. You will drive end-to-end marketing strategies for residential and commercial projects while strengthening Adwise's corporate brand across digital, offline, and industry platforms. This role requires a strategic marketer who can manage project marketing, performance campaigns, brand building, public relations, creative development, vendor management, and cross-functional collaboration to generate measurable business growth. Key Responsibilities Real Estate Project Marketing Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies for assigned real estate mandate projects. Plan and manage project campaigns across every stage, including Pre-Launch, Launch, Sustenance, Inventory Movement, and Re-Launch. Create integrated marketing plans across digital, print, outdoor advertising, radio, events, activations, and channel partner engagement. Work closely with developers to define project positioning, target audience, pricing strategy, and marketing budgets. Digital Marketing & Performance Plan, execute, and optimise lead generation campaigns across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, YouTube, WhatsApp, and other digital platforms. Monitor campaign performance, optimise CPL, lead quality, CTR, and ROI, and work closely with the sales team to improve conversions. Coordinate with performance marketing agencies and media partners to maximise campaign effectiveness. Adwise Corporate Branding Lead the overall branding and positioning of Adwise across all business verticals. Manage the company's website, social media platforms, content strategy, SEO, online reputation, and digital presence. Develop and execute branding initiatives including corporate presentations, case studies, newsletters, PR activities, media coverage, recruitment campaigns, thought leadership content, and industry insights. Ensure consistent brand identity across all marketing and communication channels. Marketing for Business Verticals Develop marketing strategies and promotional campaigns for Adwise's various service verticals, including Real Estate Sales Mandates, CRM Solutions, Project Management Consultancy (PMC), and other real-estate business offerings. Support business development initiatives by creating impactful marketing collateral and sales presentations. Channel Partner & Event Marketing Plan and execute Channel Partner (CP) Meets, Broker Meets, Project Launch Events, Corporate Events, Exhibitions, and On-ground Activations. Develop marketing campaigns to increase channel partner engagement and project visibility. Creative, Vendor & Agency Management Coordinate with creative agencies, designers, photographers, videographers, printers, media buying agencies, and production houses. Review and approve all marketing creatives, brochures, presentations, videos, advertisements, and branding materials. Manage marketing budgets, negotiate vendor commercials, and ensure timely execution of all deliverables. Reporting, Research & Analytics Prepare monthly marketing MIS, campaign reports, and performance dashboards for developers and management. Analyse campaign performance, customer behaviour, competitor activities, and market trends to improve marketing effectiveness. Recommend innovative marketing initiatives and emerging technologies to drive business growth. Team Leadership Lead and mentor marketing executives, interns, and external agency partners. Establish marketing processes, reporting systems, timelines, and quality standards while fostering a collaborative and performance-driven culture. Candidate Profile Experience 3–6 years of experience in Real Estate Marketing, Advertising, Digital Marketing, or Brand Management. Proven experience managing end-to-end marketing campaigns for real estate projects from strategy to execution. Skills Required Strong understanding of real estate marketing, branding, digital advertising, and lead generation. Expertise in campaign planning, project launches, vendor management, and event marketing. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills. Strong analytical mindset with experience in campaign optimisation and ROI measurement. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Technical Expertise Meta Business Suite Google Ads & Google Analytics CRM Platforms Canva / Adobe Creative Suite (preferred) Microsoft Excel & Reporting Dashboards Knowledge of AI-powered marketing tools, SEO, website management, and marketing automation platforms will be an added advantage. Educational Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Media, Mass Communication, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA in Marketing will be preferred. Ownership and Pace Operates with urgency and accountability. Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-changing startup environments. Ability to move seamlessly between strategic planning and hands-on execution. Experience partnering directly with founders and senior leadership teams. Proven success across positioning, messaging, product launches, sales enablement, and GTM strategy. Strong track record of increasing scope, ownership, and leadership responsibility. Experience leading Product Marketing and/or Content teams. Demonstrated examples of work personally created or significantly influenced. Experience marketing AI, analytics, workflow automation, or related software products. Experience working in high-growth startup environments (Series A–C). Experience selling to finance, accounting, tax, audit, or compliance stakeholders strongly preferred. Background in fintech, ERP, data analytics, or workflow automation software is highly desirable. Ability to translate technical product capabilities into clear business outcomes. Job Details Location: Remote, India This role requires significant overlap with U.S. Eastern Time (EST). normalizedText: Marketing Head-Purple Fabric-PFLocation- Chennai ·Reports to: CEOExp-12+ About Purple Fabric-Purple Fabric is Intellect Design Arena’s enterprise AI platform product. It helps financial institutions and increasingly, enterprises beyond them, turn their data into AI outcomes they can act on and defend: governed, explainable, and orchestrated through multi-agent workflows. This isn’t a roadmap promise; it’s in production, with 45+ clients live worldwide. Behind it: a 240+ strong team with a senior core, global clients, and the fintech heritage of Intellect Design Arena (8K employees).The mandate Own the growth thesis: write the global go-to-market playbook, own and create the lead gen machine that takes Purple Fabric to $10M ARR - and be accountable for the marketing half of getting there. This seat sets a growth strategy; it does not take briefs.Make four teams one engine: Product marketing, creative/web, digital and field/event each produce; your job is that they compound, one scorecard, one weekly pipeline number, no pillar optimizing its own corner at the expense of the funnel.Win where buyers now look: enterprise buyers increasingly start with an AI answer, not a search page. Build the discipline of being that answer, AEO/GEO alongside classic SEO, Paid UA; before the category has a playbook for it. You will be writing that playbook.Move the commercial numbers, not the vanity ones: work shoulder to shoulder with Sales and Product on the buyer journey, cost.What you will own Lead generation & the engine: you create and own the pipeline number: qualified opportunities per week, by region and source, feeding coverage ≥3× target. Built on CRM as single source of truth, marketing automation, AI tooling for enrichment and personalization, lead scoring and SDR handoff SLAs. House rule: one working automation shipped every week. Your scorecard, opps/week, pipeline influenced, funnel conversion, CAC trend, search/AI visibility, is auto-generated; a hand-assembled report is a broken one.Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Design and execute hyper-targeted, multi-channel account-based campaigns for Tier-1 enterprise targets, orchestrating digital, content, and field touchpoints to accelerate high-value, complex sales cycles.Product marketing: positioning and messaging per segment, launch plans per release, sales enablement (decks, battlecards, objection handling), analyst-facing narrative, pricing/packaging input. Your PMM also runs content (CEO story stream, funnel content, newsletter) and research/competitive intelligence.Brand, design & website: identity system and templates (in tandem with head of Design), all visual and video production on an AI-assisted workflow, the website as a measured conversion asset — not a brochure. Brand architecture decisions go to the CEO; everything else is yours.Digital acquisition: SEO plus the AEO/GEO frontier (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity answers), social channel strategy, performance marketing (UA, Linkedin first and other socials like Meta, Google etc), and instrumented campaigns, every channel measured to opportunity, not clicks.Influencer & creator-led marketing: play the game the way the fastest-growing AI companies now do creator-led, not ad-led. Build relationships with the enterprise-AI and fintech voices who shape the conversation (LinkedIn creators, newsletter authors, technical YouTubers, podcast hosts, practitioner communities, Insta/Tiktok creators for PF’s derivative products), seed the product with them, and turn their credibility into reach and pipeline. Measured on qualified attention into named accounts, not vanity impressions.Events, partnerships & field: flagship event calendar per hemisphere (WHEM/EHEM field marketers on your team), CEO and leadership speaking slots, partner co-marketing including Intellect co-sell moments, post-event pipeline attribution. The team: hire, develop and run the ~10-person org above , every hire screened for ability to exploit AI in their role. You are accountable for the function outproducing its headcount.What we need from you 12+ years in B2B/enterprise software marketing with a proven track record of scaling an engine through high-growth phases (eg $1M to $10M+ ARR). You must have built or rebuilt at least one function end to end and led through managers, not just as an individual contributor.AI-native operator - a hiring gate: show us, in a work sample, how you use AI tools to do the work of a larger team, and how you would institutionalize that across your org.Enterprise and regulated-industry fluency: you can market to banks and large enterprises without triggering their allergy to hype - governance and explainability are selling points you know how to use.Hands-on command of the modern stack: CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), automation (n8n/Make/Zapier-class), enrichment (Clay/Apollo-class), analytics/attribution (GA4, Search Console, dashboarding), SEO/AEO tooling, and daily fluency with frontier AI assistants. You configure before you hire.Demand-gen credibility with a number attached: you have owned a pipeline target and can talk specifically about what worked. Strong written English and comfort in a written-first culture — the pre-read replaces the status meeting here. normalizedText: OverviewThis is a senior orchestration role at the heart of our ecommerce marketing engine. We have dedicated, specialist teams for off-app marketing (YouTube, Meta, Influencer), on-app performance marketing (sponsored shelf, in-app activation), and customer relationship management. What we need now is an integrator/orchestrator who makes all of them work as one.The Ecommerce Integrated Marketing Manager (Full-Funnel) will be the connective tissue between these teams — owning the integrated full-funnel strategy, the shared calendar, the unified attribution framework, and the commercial outcomes that result. This role ensures alignment on the agenda, identifies gaps, and holds the funnel accountable end-to-end.The right person for this role is a systems thinker with deep ecommerce fluency — someone who can speak the language of each specialist team, translate brand objectives into channel-level briefs, and connect off-app demand signals to on-app conversion outcomes with rigor.Responsibilities Full-Funnel Strategy & Integrated PlanningUnderstand the Digital Shopper and translate that into a cross functional strategy between the Channel/Media/GCC teams — ensuring each team understands the commercial context behind every activation.Build and maintain the integrated ecommerce marketing calendar, sequencing off-app campaigns, on-app activations, and customer engagement initiatives so they work in concert, not in silos.Work with the Media team to build a first party database – to be used to drive targeted marketing full funnel interventions across our brandsIdentify white spaces — occasions, audiences, or conversion moments — and drive cross-functional solutions.Work with media team on the first party data — Leveraging this data to design targeted, brand-specific full-funnel interventions: using known audience signals to personalise off-app media, sharpen on-app promotional targeting, and enable the customer team to drive higher-value retention and cross-sell across the portfolio. Cross-Functional Orchestration & AlignmentAct as the primary integration point between the off-app marketing team (YouTube, Meta, Influencer), the on-app performance marketing team, and the customer/ecommerce account management team.Run a regular cross-functional rhythm — weekly syncs, monthly funnel reviews, quarterly planning sessions as needed — to ensure shared visibility of goals, metrics, and campaign progress. Attribution, Measurement & Commercial AccountabilityOwn the full-funnel attribution framework — defining how off-app media investment connects to on-app GMV outcomes, and holding each team accountable to their contribution in the funnel.Build unified dashboards giving a single view of full-funnel health: reach, frequency & branded searches (off-app), share of search, conversion and ROAS (on-app), and repeat rate and retention (customer).Run post-campaign analyses and QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews) with internal teams, translating performance into actionable optimisation briefs. Platform & Ecosystem StewardshipRepresent the ecommerce marketing in Joint Business Plan (JBP) discussions with platform partners, ensuring marketing commitments are integrated with commercial and supply chain plans.Stay ahead of emerging formats, features, and first-party data opportunities across platforms and feed these insights into the specialist teams' roadmaps. Capability Building & GovernanceEstablish and maintain ecommerce marketing SOPs, playbooks, and governance frameworks that help specialist teams operate with speed and consistency.Champion best-in-class practices — from creative standards for quick commerce to influencer-to-conversion tracking — and drive adoption across teams.Build internal capability by facilitating knowledge sharing across the three specialist teams, reducing duplication and accelerating learning loops. Stakeholder ManagementManage relationships with a broad and complex stakeholder map: internal teams (E-Com Sales, Media, Brand ), specialist ecommerce teams (off-app, on-app, customer), and external partners ( agencies, influencer networks).Build and sustain trust with platform partners, ensuring PepsiCo is positioned as a preferred brand partner for co-investments, early access to new ad products, and strategic collaboration.Navigate competing priorities and tensions across stakeholder groups with maturity — balancing short-term commercial pressures with long-term brand and channel health.QualificationsMust-Have11–12 years of experience with at least 4 years in ecommerce, digital marketing, or digital commerce within FMCG, D2C, or a large consumer tech platform.Demonstrated experience working across — not just within — multiple digital marketing specialisations (paid media, on-app, CRM/retention), whether in a central role, consulting capacity, or matrixed leadership position.Strong commercial acumen: ability to connect campaign activities to NSR, GMV, and marketing ROI outcomes with clarity.Fluency in the Q-com platform landscape: Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and familiarity with their advertising products, promotional mechanics, and JBP structures.Proven ability to lead and align cross-functional teams without direct authority — a natural integrator and influencer.MBA from a reputed institution strongly preferred.Good-to-HavePrior experience in strategy, planning, or centre-of-excellence role within a large FMCG or digital commerce organisation.Exposure to full-funnel attribution methodologies and multi-touch measurement frameworks.Familiarity with first-party data strategy and its role in connecting off-app audiences to on-app conversion.Experience working directly with platform category or marketing teams at Blinkit, Zepto, or Swiggy Instamart at a senior level. normalizedText: The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of FinanceAt CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance. As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale. We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next. If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.About The RoleAt CoinDCX, Brand is our primary trust engine - the system that translates frontier financial technology into mass adoption, institutional credibility and category leadership.As SVP - Marketing, you will be the Category Architect for Crypto in India. Your mandate is not to promote crypto, but to normalize and institutionalize it - shaping how millions of Indians understand, assess and trust this new asset class.You will own the full arc of brand impact: trust, recall, organic acquisition and market share. Operating at the intersection of cultural narrative, regulatory nuance, reputation management and capital discipline, your work will determine how CoinDCX is seen as the default, responsible gateway to the future of finance.This role calls for a leader who thinks in multi-year horizons, stays steady under external scrutiny and builds brand systems that endure market cycles. You will lead a 20+ member, multi-disciplinary team across brand, media, social, PR, content and creative, while partnering closely with Growth, Product, Policy, Business and Leadership to ensure absolute alignment between what we build, say and stand for.If defining a category, stewarding institutional trust at scale and building one of India’s most consequential financial brands excites you, this role will both challenge and reward you.What You’ll DoMetric & Budget Ownership: Directly own all Brand KPIs (Brand Health and Social Media Metrics, and Organic Acquisition) and a ₹100Cr+ annual brand budget. You are the DRI (Direct Responsible Individual) for optimizing spend across ATL, BTL, Digital Media, Social, Content and PR to drive organic pull and ROI. You are accountable not just for outcomes, but for capital allocation logic behind every brand decision. Category Architecture: Own the multi-year category roadmap. Translate technical VDA (Virtual Digital Asset) complexities into high-trust, education-led consumer narratives that move the Trust Index.Org Design: Scale and lead a 20+ person team across Brand and Media, Creative, PR, Social, and Content. Build a "minus-one" leadership layer to reduce SVP intervention in daily execution.Category Creation and Market Leadership: Define and execute the playbook for expanding the Indian crypto category while disproportionately increasing CoinDCX’s share of users, trust and mindshare.Reputation Systems: Design and own proactive PR and "Issue Readiness" playbooks to safeguard institutional credibility during market volatility.Strategic Integration: Partner with Product and Policy teams to ensure the brand promise of "Responsible Education" is lived in the App UX and is fully compliant.You’ll Excel in This Role If YouThink in First Principles: You solve for the root "Trust Gap" rather than quoting standard marketing frameworks.Act as an Owner: You treat company capital and reputation as your own; you make difficult trade-offs to protect long-term equity over short-term "hacks."Translate Strategy: You convert disruptive technologies into simple, trusted, mass-market stories without losing technical accuracy.Build Systems: You prioritize building scalable content and PR engines over managing individual creative tasks.You are comfortable being the final decision maker during moments of reputational, regulatory or public scrutiny. You’ll Know You’re Winning WhenTrust & Recall: Measurable uplift in "Institutional Trust" scores and "Responsible Education" recall.Efficiency: Blended CAC reduces as a result of improved organic acquisition and brand-driven conversion.Market Share: Targeted increase in CoinDCX's % share of the total Indian crypto user base.Independence: Your leadership bench executes high-impact campaigns with minimal intervention from you.Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For YouYou are shaping how an entire nation perceives the future of money. This is a rare opportunity to define the category standards for a $2.45B unicorn and work side-by-side with founders to drive the company’s mission. You will gain an unfiltered view of how a brand scales from 10 → 100 in one of the world’s fastest-evolving industries. Very few roles allow you to shape how a nation learns to trust a new financial system. This is one of them.Hiring ProcessHere’s what your journey with us looks like:Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intentRecruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you betterFunctional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solvingAssignment / Simulation Round – A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenariosCulture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive bestFounder Conversation – For certain roles at senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fitWhere We WorkWe believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. Proven experience in people management, preferably managing a team of Business Analysts and client-facing/internal stakeholder-facing roles. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment within the technology industry. normalizedText: About Snapmint: India’s booming consumer market has over 300 million credit-eligible consumers, yet only 35million actively use credit cards. At Snapmint, we are building a better alternative to credit cards that lets consumers buy now and pay later for a wide variety of products, be it shoes, clothes, fashion accessories, clothes or mobile phones. We firmly believe that an enduring financial services business must be built on the bedrock of providing honest, transparent and fair terms.Founded in 2017, today we are the leading online zero-cost EMI provider in India. We have served over 10M consumers across 2,200 cities and are doubling year on year. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs and alumni of IIT Bombay and ISB with over two decades of experience across leading organizations like Swiggy, Oyo, Maruti Suzuki and ZS Associates before successfully scaling and exiting businesses in patent analytics, ad-tech and bank-tech software services.Role Overview As Senior Manager / Associate Director – Growth & Retention, you will own the full lifecycle P&L—from activation to repeat behaviour to reactivation—and lead a multidisciplinary team of 12–15 across analytics, CRM, campaign operations, personalisation, and rewards. This is a function-head role. normalizedText: LocationIndia Full job description Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work. Why Skan AI We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes. Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises. Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself. AI Solutions is our global post-sales and professional-services organization — the team that takes process intelligence and agentic AI out of pilots and into production, and owns customer outcomes end-to-end. We are AI-first by default: we spot repeating patterns and build agents to automate them, scaling the value we deliver with the book of business, not with headcount. The role. Build a net-new, AI-first delivery pillar from the ground up to serve our global SMB and mid-market customers — enterprise-grade companies that need fast, productized, high-value delivery. You design a scalable model that absorbs volume and demand peaks without growing headcount one-for-one, protecting margin while funding the next phase of growth. This is a builder's role: little scaffolding, a blank canvas, and the chance to define how Skan delivers at scale. What you own The SMB & mid-market operating model — a lightweight, productized, fast onboarding designed to scale elastically. A delivery engine that blends a dedicated specialist core with flexible managed-services and partner capacity, sized to demand. Profitable delivery and strong unit economics across the global SMB and mid-market book. AI-first innovation as the default — agents and accelerators that let a lean team serve many customers exceptionally well. Value realization, adoption and renewal across the portfolio. What we look for Built or scaled a productized, high-volume delivery model for SMB or mid-market customers. Strong unit-economics instinct — knows how to serve many customers profitably without linear headcount growth. Partner-management and managed-services experience. AI-first to the core — productizes and automates onboarding and delivery. Background in process intelligence, workflow automation or data-intelligence platforms is a plus. Pragmatic builder who thrives standing up something new from scratch. Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate. We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

normalizedText: DescriptionTitle: Research - Assistant Director / DirectorLocation: Bangalore, IndiaWebsite: Leading Global Technology Research & Advisory Firm | ISG (isg-one.com)ISG (Nasdaq: III) is a global AI-centered technology research and advisory firm. A trusted partner to more than 900 clients, including 75 of the world’s top 100 enterprises, ISG is a long-time leader in technology and business services that is now at the forefront of leveraging AI to help organizations achieve operational excellence and faster growth. The firm, founded in 2006, is known for its proprietary market data, in-depth knowledge of provider ecosystems, and the expertise of its 1,600 professionals worldwide working together to help clients maximize the value of their technology investments.ISG Software Research, part of ISG Research, delivers trusted advisory and research services to enterprise decision-makers. For over 20 years, we’ve combined deep knowledge of software categories and providers with the expertise of seasoned analysts to help clients navigate constant technological change. Our mission is to deliver independent, insightful research and tailored advisory services through a client experience built on trust and empathy.Position OverviewISG is seeking a leader to serve as Research Director for Marketing Technology, with expertise across software domains including, CRM, marketing automation, customer data platforms, SEO/GEO and related systems. This role will guide ISG’s consulting, advisory, research, and thought leadership portfolio in these areas, helping enterprises optimize people, processes, information, and technology.The Research Director will drive market research of enterprises, software providers, and products to deliver high-quality insights and ensure the strength of ISG Research offerings. Success requires close collaboration with marketing, revenue, product, and client success teams to execute programs effectively and support enterprise clients. Working closely with analyst peers and research teams, the Research Director will ensure reliability, depth, and relevance across ISG’s product portfolio. Performance will be measured by three key objectives: Client Engagement, Market Expertise, and Revenue Bookings, supported by defined KPIs.ResponsibilitiesThe Research Director will lead the research agenda for marketing technology, working closely with analysts and the product team to apply both experience and subject-matter expertise. This role ensures the full value of the analyst team is realized across consulting, advisory, research, and thought leadership, and will represent the team in key products such as Analyst Perspectives, Market Perspectives, and the ISG Buyer’s Guides. A core responsibility is the analysis of software providers and the leadership of ISG Buyer’s Guides. The Research Director will also support ISG enterprise clients through advisory and consulting engagements, partnering with Client Success and Product teams to strengthen relationships, engage new and existing clients, and drive revenue growth.This position will report to the Executive Director for Business Research.This is a remote position located in the India Travel is potentially 25-50%, with most of it to the United States Provide thought leadership in the office of the CMO and marketing functions Build and maintain working relationships with software providers Guide enterprises and buyers on software categories and products Engage into research processes to ensure critical and timely research and client deliverables Collaborate with sales and client success teams to achieve revenue Participate in analyst leadership and team meetings to help improve and innovate processesRequired SkillsetsOverall 18 to 22 years of experience in Research Advisory.At least 5 years of experience as a recognized thought leader, serving as an industry analyst and/or leading Product Marketing or Product Management functions at a recognized technology vendor. ORMinimum 10 years of practitioner experience working with Sales and Marketing processes, platforms, and systems, combined with a strong consultative and analytical background, fast-paced company environmentPrevious experience providing guidance in strategy and planning on marketing processes and technologyKnowledge of business technology industry in area of marketing related softwareDemonstrated ability to engage with a well-developed point of viewStrong communication and collaboration skills with industry leadersExperience in managing multiple priorities yielding positive resultsDemonstrated writing and presentation skills are essentialEducationBA/BS degree in Communications, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related discipline.An advanced degree (MBA, Master's, or equivalent) is preferred but not required.At ISG, we don’t just accept difference — we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our clients, and our communities. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. ISG is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. The more diverse and inclusive we are, the better our work will be.The duties and responsibilities described in this job description may not be a comprehensive list. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time and/or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands. job description Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup building a real-time transportation visibility platform for global supply chains. We help shippers, manufacturers, and logistics service providers turn data into decisions and decisions into measurable business impact. Our platform goes beyond visibility. Portcast enables action at scale by surfacing the right risks early, helping teams prevent detention and demurrage, accelerate exception management, and close invoices faster with built-in evidence. We turn visibility into outcomes: reduced costs, improved operational control, and more predictable supply chains. Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to make supply chains not just visible, but decisively actionable end-to-end. ABOUT THE ROLE: We're looking for a Technical Lead, AI & Platform to lead our engineering, ML/DS, and analytics teams while staying close to architecture and execution. This role will lead and manage the Engineering team, ML/Data Science team, and Data Analytics team. You'll drive how we build, how we use data and AI, and how our systems scale as the company grows. We're looking for a strong technical leader who thinks from first principles, makes clear decisions, and stays close to the technology. Someone who can step into complex problems, break them down clearly, and guide teams toward practical, scalable solutions. You'll work closely with the CEO, Product, Sales, and Customer teams to translate real customer problems into systems, tools, and AI capabilities that drive outcomes, value to our customer and company revenue, not just features. This is not a pure management role. It requires strong technical judgment, comfort operating across engineering and data, and the ability to lead through both direction and execution. You'll set the technical bar, strengthen how teams work together, and ensure engineering, ML, and analytics move as one cohesive capability supporting the business. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE: Engineering, ML, and Analytics operate as a clear, structured, and high-performing unit with defined ownership and strong delivery predictability. Technical decisions are grounded in first-principles thinking, scalable architecture, and long-term product clarity. AI and data capabilities are consistently deployed into production and directly tied to measurable business impact. WHAT YOU'LL OWN: Engineering Leadership & Architecture Drive technical direction across platform, infrastructure, and product systems Define scalable architecture and ensure reliability, performance, and security Improve engineering velocity, code quality, and delivery discipline Strengthen documentation, ownership, and system clarity Mentor tech team: Engineering, ML, Analytics AI, Data Science & Analytics Strategy Define how AI and data drive competitive advantage in our product Ensure ML models move from experimentation into production environmentsStrengthen MLOps, data pipelines, and real-time data systems Align analytics insights with product and customer decision-making Ensure AI investments translate into real outcomes, not just experiments Product & Business Alignment Partner closely with Product to shape technical roadmap Work with Sales and Customer teams to understand enterprise requirements Guide solution design for complex customer use cases Ensure engineering effort maps directly to business impact Team, Culture & Organizational Development Lead and develop Engineering, ML/Data Science, and Analytics teams Hire strong senior talent and raise the technical bar Create clarity in roles, responsibilities, and technical ownership Reduce single-point dependency across critical systems Build a culture of accountability, curiosity, and effectiveness Hands-On Technical Leadership Stay close to architecture and key system decisions Review critical designs and technical proposals Step into complex technical problems when neededPrototype or validate high-impact ideas Lead by example in technical depth and problem solving WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: Experience: 10+ years in software engineering, data, or ML environments Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Experience leading technical teams in a startup or product-driven B2B SaaS company Track record building and scaling production AI/ML systems Experience with distributed systems, real-time data, and cloud infrastructure Background in logistics or supply chain industry, or data-heavy SaaS is a strong plus Previous experience working in enterprises/fortune 500 is a plus Technical Depth Strong backend and system architecture expertise Experience deploying ML/AI systems into production, not just research Deep understanding of MLOps, data platforms, and model lifecycle management Comfortable operating across engineering, data science, and analytics domains Leadership & Culture First-principles thinker who breaks down complex problems clearly High ownership and accountability Builder mindset with strong technical judgment Clear communicator across technical and business teams Focused on effectiveness and real outcomes WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: Work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe,built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Our diversity of perspectives fuels innovation and keeps us curious. Tech-first team: You'll work with like-minded individuals who share a passion for solving difficult problem using technology. Accelerated growth: Compress the learning curve in a couple of years by owning the web app from day one as your own baby. We are building our company to be the next B2B market leader in predictive global supply chains and you'll be a major part of our story. Impact you can see: With a lean structure, your work is effective from the start. You'll see the results of your ideas and decisions directly moving the business forward. Our CORE Values Guide Everything We Do: Curiosity: We stay hungry to learn and explore. Ownership: We act like founders and take responsibility. Raising the bar: We aim higher, never settling for good enough. normalizedText: Marketing Head-Purple Fabric-PFLocation- Chennai ·Reports to: CEOExp-12+ About Purple Fabric-Purple Fabric is Intellect Design Arena’s enterprise AI platform product. It helps financial institutions and increasingly, enterprises beyond them, turn their data into AI outcomes they can act on and defend: governed, explainable, and orchestrated through multi-agent workflows. This isn’t a roadmap promise; it’s in production, with 45+ clients live worldwide. Behind it: a 240+ strong team with a senior core, global clients, and the fintech heritage of Intellect Design Arena (8K employees).The mandate Own the growth thesis: write the global go-to-market playbook, own and create the lead gen machine that takes Purple Fabric to $10M ARR - and be accountable for the marketing half of getting there. This seat sets a growth strategy; it does not take briefs.Make four teams one engine: Product marketing, creative/web, digital and field/event each produce; your job is that they compound, one scorecard, one weekly pipeline number, no pillar optimizing its own corner at the expense of the funnel.Win where buyers now look: enterprise buyers increasingly start with an AI answer, not a search page. Build the discipline of being that answer, AEO/GEO alongside classic SEO, Paid UA; before the category has a playbook for it. You will be writing that playbook.Move the commercial numbers, not the vanity ones: work shoulder to shoulder with Sales and Product on the buyer journey, cost.What you will own Lead generation & the engine: you create and own the pipeline number: qualified opportunities per week, by region and source, feeding coverage ≥3× target. Built on CRM as single source of truth, marketing automation, AI tooling for enrichment and personalization, lead scoring and SDR handoff SLAs. House rule: one working automation shipped every week. Your scorecard, opps/week, pipeline influenced, funnel conversion, CAC trend, search/AI visibility, is auto-generated; a hand-assembled report is a broken one.Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Design and execute hyper-targeted, multi-channel account-based campaigns for Tier-1 enterprise targets, orchestrating digital, content, and field touchpoints to accelerate high-value, complex sales cycles.Product marketing: positioning and messaging per segment, launch plans per release, sales enablement (decks, battlecards, objection handling), analyst-facing narrative, pricing/packaging input. Your PMM also runs content (CEO story stream, funnel content, newsletter) and research/competitive intelligence.Brand, design & website: identity system and templates (in tandem with head of Design), all visual and video production on an AI-assisted workflow, the website as a measured conversion asset — not a brochure. Brand architecture decisions go to the CEO; everything else is yours.Digital acquisition: SEO plus the AEO/GEO frontier (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity answers), social channel strategy, performance marketing (UA, Linkedin first and other socials like Meta, Google etc), and instrumented campaigns, every channel measured to opportunity, not clicks.Influencer & creator-led marketing: play the game the way the fastest-growing AI companies now do creator-led, not ad-led. Build relationships with the enterprise-AI and fintech voices who shape the conversation (LinkedIn creators, newsletter authors, technical YouTubers, podcast hosts, practitioner communities, Insta/Tiktok creators for PF’s derivative products), seed the product with them, and turn their credibility into reach and pipeline. Measured on qualified attention into named accounts, not vanity impressions.Events, partnerships & field: flagship event calendar per hemisphere (WHEM/EHEM field marketers on your team), CEO and leadership speaking slots, partner co-marketing including Intellect co-sell moments, post-event pipeline attribution. The team: hire, develop and run the ~10-person org above , every hire screened for ability to exploit AI in their role. You are accountable for the function outproducing its headcount.What we need from you 12+ years in B2B/enterprise software marketing with a proven track record of scaling an engine through high-growth phases (eg $1M to $10M+ ARR). You must have built or rebuilt at least one function end to end and led through managers, not just as an individual contributor.AI-native operator - a hiring gate: show us, in a work sample, how you use AI tools to do the work of a larger team, and how you would institutionalize that across your org.Enterprise and regulated-industry fluency: you can market to banks and large enterprises without triggering their allergy to hype - governance and explainability are selling points you know how to use.Hands-on command of the modern stack: CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), automation (n8n/Make/Zapier-class), enrichment (Clay/Apollo-class), analytics/attribution (GA4, Search Console, dashboarding), SEO/AEO tooling, and daily fluency with frontier AI assistants. You configure before you hire.Demand-gen credibility with a number attached: you have owned a pipeline target and can talk specifically about what worked. Strong written English and comfort in a written-first culture — the pre-read replaces the status meeting here. Our MissionAt Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.Who We AreIn order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. Build the master brand narrative and differentiation story versus Jindal Stainless and other organised players. Own brand guidelines and ensure consistency across manufacturing plants, service centres, dealers, and digital touchpoints.Marketing Build the annual marketing plan and calendar, aligned to sales and production capacity ramp-up. Own market research, customer insight generation, and brand tracking (awareness, consideration, NPS/recall). Plan and execute above-the-line and below-the-line campaigns across trade, architect, and consumer segments.Digital Marketing Own website, SEO/SEM, marketing automation, CRM-led lead nurturing, and social media strategy. Develop showroom and experience-centre strategy to showcase finishes and applications to specifiers. Manage presence at design and architecture platforms, award programmes, and industry bodies (IIA, IIID, CII, etc.).Product Marketing Translate technical grades and finishes into customer-facing product stories and application-led collateral for each segment (kitchen, lifts, automotive, EPC, white goods). Oversee CSR/sustainability communication — increasingly important for steel-sector brand credibility.

role: Associate Director - Marketing, Obesity & Key Accounts
normalizedText: CardioMetabolic MarketingNovo Nordisk Pvt Ltd (Affiliate)Your new roleThe Associate Director – Marketing, Obesity & Key Accounts will be responsible for leading the end-to-end brand strategy and execution for Wegovy in India. The role is accountable for driving business growth, strengthening brand positioning, and shaping the obesity care market through insight-led and customer-centric strategies. It requires strong cross-functional leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to translate plans into impactful and compliant execution. The role also requires agility to understand and adapt to evolving organisational structures, go-to-market models, and customer needs as the obesity market develops in India.Your key responsibilities as Associate Director – Marketing, Obesity & Key Accounts will include:Own and drive Wegovy brand strategy with accountability for business performance, including sales, market share, and profitabilityLead market shaping initiatives to improve obesity awareness, diagnosis, and treatment adoption in partnership with Medical, Market Access, and external stakeholdersDesign and execute an effective omnichannel customer engagement strategy for HCPs, institutions, and priority customer segmentsEnsure execution excellence through timely, high-quality implementation of marketing plans aligned to field needs and execution prioritiesDrive cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Medical, Market Access, and Global teams to ensure integrated planning and delivery of business objectivesManage lifecycle planning to support launch readiness, portfolio expansion, and long-term brand sustainabilityDevelop and execute key account/institution engagement plans, ensuring measurable outcomes and continuous adaptation to evolving market and organizational needsAbout International OperationsAs part of International Operations, you will join our largest operational unit. Covering 194 countries and 95% of the world's population, more than 18,000 of us work passionately to serve 35 million patients each day. With a promise to outperform the competition, we continue to be the growth driver for Novo Nordisk, and to improve health at scale across the globe.About The DepartmentThe Cardio-Metabolic Marketing team is responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies for cardiometabolic and related therapeutic areas. The team ensures strong brand leadership and measurable business performance by driving initiatives that improve disease awareness, appropriate diagnosis, and treatment adoption in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.Your Skills & QualificationsMBA / PGDM or equivalent qualification, preferably with a strong academic background.Approximately 12 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare marketing7–8 years of experience in the marketing domain and at least 4+ years of people management experiencePrior experience in launch strategy and execution, along with consumer awareness or patient activation campaigns, will be an added advantage.Demonstrated experience in leading brands, launch readiness, lifecycle management, or specialty portfoliosStrong track record in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaborationPrior exposure to high-growth, competitive, or innovative therapy areas will be an advantageWorking at Novo NordiskEvery day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.What We OfferThere is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.Deadline31 July 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants. We’re not your typical healthcare company. In a modern world of quick fixes, we focus on solutions to defeat serious chronic diseases and promote long-term health. Our unordinary mindset is at the heart of everything we do. We seek out new ideas and put people first as we push the boundaries of science, make healthcare more accessible, and treat, prevent, and even cure diseases that affect millions of lives. Because it takes an unordinary approach to drive real, lasting change in health.
