normalizedText: Join Us!At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!Program Management Senior Specialist is the glue that keeps all the elements of an owned marketing channel campaign (i.e. email) project together. They are well organized project managers, excellent communicators, proactive problem solvers and technical subject matter experts well versed in growth marketing. They are the connective tissue between the business (product marketing managers), production project managers and development team. They ensure projects are well defined, and delivered on time and meet quality standards.Position ResponsibilitiesPartner with product marketing managers (PMMs) in campaign ideation and intake document formulationCollaborate with PMMs during the campaign ideation stage, gather technical requirements, confirm feasibility of ideated campaign features, define potential execution timeline and the intricacies of email personalization and complex logic.Provide strategic input on growth best practices, segmentation, and user journey optimization to help achieve campaign business goals.Act as a consultative partner, advising PMMs on how to translate business objectives into effective owned channel (i.e. email) strategies.Guide the PMM through the Campaign Requirement Document creation, ensure the intake documents are completed and comprehensive for the production team.Project manage campaign development and deploymentKick off and strategically manage campaign development with offshore production team, provide guidance and answers to production team during the production process, manage production timelines. Prepare work orders for the production team and create project estimations for the PMM, managing the approval process for these estimates.Coordinate with Data Specialists to ensure that data requirements and inputs are fully aligned with HTML development and production process, as well as be a strategic partner between Data Specialists and offshore production team.Conduct thorough quality assurance (QA) reviews on all deliverables against client specifications before releasing to the PMMCommunicate production progress to PMM, facilitate approval of simulations, proofs and prototypes, ensure any changes are implemented after prototype and proof review.Flag issues that arise during the production process and proactively seek solutions. Manage campaign deployment in Internal Growth tools, monitor campaign healthActively manage the Internal growth tool (i.e..Gamma) campaign deployments and proactively manage the campaign lifecycle (pause, activate, launch Gamma campaigns). GAMMA is Google’s internal email marketing platform.Be the expert on Gamma campaigns under their management.Monitor campaign deployment health through Gamma reporting tools and internal tools. Where applicable, delegate monitoring to Data Specialists and email specialists acting as the accountable party for campaign health monitoring and error escalation.Conduct post-launch campaign performance analysis to derive engagement insights and identify areas for future improvement.Troubleshoot and solve escalationsWhen issues arise on existing or newly deployed campaigns, proactively lead the resolution process by quickly identifying root causes, work closely with product marketing managers, production project managers, and the development team.Document the issue in the form of a blameless post mortem, ensure alignment across stakeholders and facilitate process adjustments mitigating repetition of the issue in the future across the team. Keep things organized Attend regular scrums and stand ups, provide updates on project status and act as a collaborative business partner to the PMM leading the scrum.Effectively and proficiently communicate with the offshore production team by setting up and leading weekly calls. Maintain internal project status trackers and post launch quality control sheets.Ensure accurate work progress tracking in Asana. Drive innovation and thrive for excellenceProactively look for ways to improve the process to drive efficiency and reduce risk such as through implementing AI tools in the email creative or production processes.QualificationsMinimum Qualifications:Overall 5+ years of experience in project management roles, coordinating projects across multiple organizations/cross functional teams.Complex Email Campaign Management: 2-3 years of proven ability to manage high-complexity, interdependent email campaigns, anticipating risks across multiple systems and stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment.Email Marketing Technology Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in primary email marketing technology tools (e.g., Marketo, Eloqua, Hubspot etc.) with the ability to learn and navigate independently across multiple platforms.Technical Proficiency (HTML): Basic understanding of web development, HTML/CSS & QA processes, with the ability to identify root causes, troubleshoot technical issues, and architect resilient solutions."Strategic Client Handling: Advanced client handling skills with a track record of acting as a strategic advisor, understanding scope and providing estimates that align with long-term business goals.Data Analysis: Proficiency in data analysis tools to interpret performance results and recommend strategic improvements to stakeholders.Communication: Strong, polished, and professional communication skills required for interacting with stakeholders and leading the production team.Preferred QualificationsPreferred Qualifications:Understanding of marketing operations, processes, business requirements.Proactive and curious attitude, strong problem solving skills.Familiarity using GenAI (generative AI) for email marketing content, production and optimization.Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with rapidly changing priorities and a high volume of projects.BenefitsWe support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverageWe support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimumsEmployees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiencesInformation collected and processed as part of your Google Operations Center (GOC) normalizedText: Job Title: ISPL Head of Corporate Credit ITDepartment: Banking Platform ITAbout Business Line/FunctionCorporate Credits at BNP Paribas CIB is the bank’s dedicated platform for delivering large scale, customized financing solutions to corporates and institutions worldwide. It combines deep sector expertise, a robust risk framework, and a global syndication network to support M&A, project development, working capital needs, and other strategic financing objectives. Must be very well versed with Corporate Credit business, its challenges and operational needs.Build strong relationship with global and regional Business, IT & Ops leaders, in collaboration with different IOCs, to drive business successfully and to ensure consistency and alignment across systems.Visualize business changes and create an IT/innovation mindset so that solutions are ready for the growth of business and are future ready. role: Chief Operating Officer | Design Systems, Strengthen Delivery, and Power High-Growth Execution
normalizedText: We are looking for a seasoned operator who can scale a growing business, streamline execution, and build a culture that delivers excellence every day. At CareerXperts, this means strengthening the backbone of a company trusted by founders for closing their toughest mandates and delivering consistent, high-quality hiring outcomes.The COO will partner closely with the CEO to drive strategy, create operational clarity, and ensure every team is aligned, accountable, and moving with purpose. This is a role for someone who thrives in high-growth environments and knows how to turn vision into disciplined execution - especially in a company that operates at the speed, depth, and precision that CareerXperts is known for.1. Strategy & ExecutionConvert long-term business goals into clear operational plans and measurable outcomes.Lead organisation-wide execution across Product, Sales, Finance, HR, and Delivery.Build systems that make growth predictable, sustainable, and data-driven.2. Operational LeadershipOwn day-to-day business operations and ensure smooth functioning across all verticals.Standardise processes, improve delivery frameworks, and strengthen quality governance.Build operational dashboards, metrics, and reporting structures to track performance.3. role: Senior Principal - Development & CMO Digital & Tech Strategy

Your roleAs the Senior Principal, Strategy you will be a pivotal partner for the Development and CMO Digital and Technology leadership team, responsible for both shaping our strategic agenda and driving its execution to help us radically accelerate the delivery of medicines and vaccines.You will probe and clarify strategic choices, lead analysis on critical business problems, and own high-priority initiatives from concept to completion. Alongside this, you will serve as a chief of staff to the leadership team - acting as the throughline across our planning cycles, governance, and leadership sessions to ensure strategy translates into decisive action. You will work closely with the R&D Digital and Technology Portfolio team, ensuring their capabilities and processes are leveraged in service of our objectives.This role requires you to move seamlessly between high-level strategic thinking and the hands-on work of keeping a complex leadership team focused, aligned, and moving forward.Your ResponsibilitiesDrive and Facilitate the Leadership Team's Strategic Agenda: Act as the throughline for the leadership team's strategic agenda - ensuring what gets discussed becomes decided, and what gets decided gets done. You will own the meeting rhythm: setting agendas, ensuring pre-reads are in place, and working with teams across the department to drive actions to completion between sessions.Lead High-Priority & Cross-Cutting Strategic Initiatives: Take direct ownership of ambiguous, high-impact projects, particularly those that cut across multiple programmes and teams. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle: shaping the hypothesis, conducting analysis, building consensus, and delivering integrated solutions that drive our transformation forward.Co-lead Annual Planning: In partnership with the Strategy Director, co-lead the annual planning cycle - driving both the OKR-setting process and the investment planning process, ensuring the two are aligned and that clear trade-off decisions are made.Build and Communicate a Shared Strategic Narrative: Own the communications that bring our strategy to life across the department - translating leadership decisions and strategic priorities into clear, compelling messages for all staff, so that everyone understands where we are going and how their work connects to it.Partner with the R&D Digital and Technology Portfolio Team: Work closely with the Portfolio team to ensure the operational processes that underpin both our strategic programmes and the day-to-day running of the department are effective and efficient — identifying where things aren't working and driving improvements that help the department deliver against its objectives.Why you?Basic Qualifications:Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a scientific area (e.g. computer science, engineering, mathematics), or related quantitative discipline.15+ Experience in technology strategy, within a large-scale technology organisation, a corporate strategy function, or a management consulting firm.Experience supporting or operating as chief of staff to a senior leadership team, including owning meeting rhythms, governance forums, and cross-team action tracking.Relevant experience in the life sciences industry.We are looking for professionals with the following capabilities:Senior Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to act as a trusted partner to leaders, building strong relationships, providing candid advice, and facilitating high-stakes discussions to drive alignment and clear decisions.Structured Problem-Solving and Analysis: A highly analytical mindset with the ability to take ambiguous, complex business problems, structure them, and drive them to a concrete solution through hands-on analysis and project management.Exceptional Communication and Synthesis: The ability to synthesise complex information into clear, concise narratives for a range of audiences, from executive leadership to all staff. You can distil the "so what" and make strategy feel relevant and actionable at every level.Preferred Qualifications:R&D Domain Knowledge: Understanding of the pharmaceutical R&D value chain, from drug discovery and clinical development through to regulatory submission.Agile Ways of Working: Familiarity with Agile principles and ways of working (e.g. Scrum, SAFe), with the ability to operate effectively within an organisation that runs on agile rhythms.AI-Augmented Working: Practical experience applying AI tools to accelerate strategic and analytical work, and a track record of helping others do the same — for example, driving adoption of AI tools that enhance how product owners and delivery teams operate day-to-day.SkillsChange Management, Compliance Risk Management, Dependency Analysis, Executive Reports, Financial Acumen, Portfolio Performance Management, Portfolio Prioritization, Problem Solving, Project Management Governance, Shareholder Communications, Stakeholder ManagementWhy GSK?Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.Inclusion at GSK:As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.Important notice to Employment businesses/ AgenciesGSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. normalizedText: Requisition Id: 1698140As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.The opportunity : Director-TMT-Business Consulting PI-CNS - BC - Marketing Sales & Service - BangaloreTMT : Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.CNS - BC - Marketing Sales & Service : EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.It has multiple fields of play such as:Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.Business Transformation - a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.Your Key ResponsibilitiesTechnical ExcellenceAbout SAT and EY Parthenon EY Strategy and Transactions teams work with clients to navigate complexity by helping them to reimagine their eco-systems, reshape their port- folios and reinvent themselves for a better future. Whether they are a corporate, private equity, government, sovereign wealth fund, private or family business, or educational institution client, we help with all their key strategy and transaction decisions EY-Parthenon is a unique, world-class strategy practice that delivers long-term value to our clients, our people and EY. As a sub-service line within Strategy and Transactions, EY-Parthenon brings together professionals with diverse strategic capabilities and deep sector insights. We enable our professionals to lead from the front, unlock the full potential of strategy, transactions and restructuring, and reshape work, paving the way for high value impact for our clients. EY-Parthenon plays a critical role in driving collaboration between sub-service lines, within service lines and across the firm. The opportunity EY is looking for a suitable member for our team in Strategy practice. The role provides an opportunity to be part of the team which assist businesses in setting strategic goals and identifying the steps to meet them, analyse industry dynamics such as market size, growth, and share of leading competitors, identify the business’ unique competitive advantage and help create alignment among all business units and functions to support and enhance this positioning. Team offers clients with Business Model Reinvention, New Market Entry Opportunities and Digital Strategy and Innovation Your key responsibilities? Client service delivery/execution Lead the delivery and execution of high-quality deliverables, managing service quality, brand, and client expectations. Build and maintain strong relationships with client personnel, ensuring quality client services. Conceptualize the overall solution for a given client problem and lead the engagement team to deliver client objectives Monitor progress, manage risk and ensure clients are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes Review deliverables prepared by the team; Manage project, engagement economics and receivables, project resources and team utilization Lead the delivery / execution of high-quality deliverables and manage service quality, brand and client expectations Build relationships with client personnel and deliver quality client servicesKnowledge Management Contribute to brand development by writing articles, developing thought leadership and point-of-views Contribute to knowledge development and managementBusiness development: Manage client accounts, build professional relationships, and meet business development targets by identifying new opportunities with existing clients. Demonstrate significant industry and solution expertise to enhance business solutions.Demonstrate significant industry / solution expertisePeople Management Be a strong team player Build a strong team and be a strong role model, mentor and coach Assist in resolving people issues Support people development through guidance and feedback Take the lead in recruiting activitiesEnsure compliance to the EY’s standards, processes and policies?Contribute to the firm’s initiatives in enhancing market leadership & growth, quality, people agenda and operational excellence?The role will evolve from engagement delivery to engagement management and pro-active business development over time Technical Excellence:Strong analytical skills and structured thinkingExcellent communication skills (written and oral)Proficiency with MS-Office (particularly, Power Point and Excel)Professional network and networking skillsAbility to work with tight timelinesAbility to manage client interactionsAttention to detailWillingness to travel within India and abroad To Qualify for the role you must have MBA from a premier institute (Tier-I Indian B-school) with experience in transaction advisory, commercial due diligence, strategy verticals will be preferredPreferred : 10+ years of professional experience (post MBA) in Consulting/PE/VC firms Ideally, you’ll also haveStrong analytical, communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility. Skills and attributes In addition to technical competence, what will set you up for success at EY is your ability to:Cham- pion start up thinking and deliver innovative solutionsEnhance business solutions by blending emerging technologiesEmbrace technology to transform new ways of workingDeliver highest quality resultsDrive a culture of continuous improvement and learning for yourself and othersCreate value and build sustainable relationships that last a lifetimeBe involved in a cause for the benefit of larger communityPursue passions beyond work and invest in your wellbeing What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. normalizedText: About WPP MediaWPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.For more information, visit wppmedia.com.About WPP Media WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.comAt WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. Role: Platform Innovation, Emerging Tech & GamingTeam: Content & CultureReporting into: Content leadRole Purpose: Lead the end-to-end process of designing, executing, analysing and scaling creative experiments across the emerging tech, gaming and platform innovation agenda for HUL brands that enables breakthrough content experiences, richer storytelling, stronger engagement and measurable business impact.Key Responsibilities Emerging Tech, Innovation and Problem SolvingReframe brand, category and business challenges through a tech-led innovation lens and identify where technology can unlock speed, scale, personalisation, participation, experience, measurability or commerce.Connect tech choices to brand truth, audience behaviour, culture, commerce and business outcomes.Lead innovation across AI, AR, VR, interactive content, automation, mobile-tech, immersive experiences, social destinations, web/app-based platforms and other emerging technologies.Build sustainable experience engines that can support both tactical campaigns and longer-term platforms or IPs.Develop tech-enabled destinations across content creation, content optimisation, community participation, commerce, shoppability and online-offline integrations.Assess feasibility, operating logic, partner capability, scalability, cost and execution complexity for every tech-led idea. Platform Innovation and Creative ExperimentationDevelop and champion a quarterly test-and-learn roadmap for creative innovation, esp with digital media and non-media platforms.Identify and prioritise platform-led innovation opportunities across, but not limited to Meta, Google, Snap, JioStar, Pinterest, ShareChat, Spotify, Gaming networks and other emerging digital partners.Drive experiments across ad formats, content strategies, interactive user journeys, creator-led formats, platform-native storytelling and new engagement mechanics that improve creative effectiveness, engagement and campaign performance.Translate successful experiments into scalable BAU solutions, playbooks and reusable frameworks. Gaming, Esports and Interactive CommunitiesBuild gaming-led brand solutions across esports, mobile gaming, casual gaming, streaming, creators, tournaments, communities and interactive experiences.Develop strong gaming formats across in-game integrations, playable ads, branded environments, creator streams, out-of-game content, community challenges, live tournaments, campus activations, AR, AI and interactive pilots.Lead large-scale gaming events, esports associations and brand-owned gaming IPs from opportunity mapping to execution.Ensure gaming solutions are strategically sharp, brand-safe, executable, measurable and commercially viable.What We’re Looking For10+ years of experience across emerging tech, platform innovation, gaming, esports, digital platforms, brand partnerships, media, content, entertainment, creator economy or youth culture marketing.Deep understanding of digital platforms, platform betas, ad innovation, interactive formats, content experimentation and emerging consumer behaviours.Ability to connect technology, platform behaviour, gaming culture and brand strategy into sharp consumer-facing ideas.Proven ability to build and execute large-scale partnerships, IPs, events, experiments, platform-first campaigns or integrated brand solutions.Strong network across platforms, publishers, gaming partners, right holders, tournament organisers, creators, streamers, production partners, tech partners and communities.Commercially sharp, with strong negotiation, partner evaluation, budget ownership and cost-efficiency skills.Comfortable working across ambiguity, rapid experimentation, multiple stakeholders and evolving technologies.Strong storytelling ability to turn experiments into case studies, internal learnings and scalable brand playbooks.Life At WPP Media & BenefitsOur passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide. Simplilearn offers 1,500+ live classes each month across 150+ countries, impacting over 8 million learners globally. The programs are designed and delivered with world-renowned universities, top corporations, and leading industry bodies via live online classes featuring top industry practitioners, sought-after trainers, and global leaders. normalizedText: About The RoleThe Social team is responsible for telling Uber's story in an engaging, inspiring, humanizing and innovative way across global channels, and to a global audience. We develop creative programming ourselves, build relationships with key influencers and creators, and launch new products and partnerships in a Social-first way.As the Head of Social Media Manager for India and Sri Lanka, you will play a crucial role in developing and executing strategic social plans to evolve and elevate our social media presence for Uber in India and Sri Lanka.You will work closely with cross-functional partners to bring new products, partnerships (comms, marketing and policy), campaigns, owned programming and events to life on our channels. This role requires excellent written and verbal communication skills, iPhone shooting and editing skills, an eye for graphic design, thumb-stopping content ideas, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.What You'll Do Set the Social Strategy : Develop, execute and launch the channel strategies for Uber and Uber Eats across Instagram, X/Twitter, YouTube, and emerging platforms. Manage day-to-day social media responsibilities for Uber India's consumer channel, earner's channel, and Uber Sri Lanka channel, which support both the mobility and delivery businesses. Drive Cultural Relevance: Identify trends, conversations, and opportunities where our brands can show up with POV, humor, speed, and creativity. Create culturally relevant, platform-native ideas that tap into trends, moments, and consumer behavior in smart, strategic ways. Create & Lead Creators : Shoot, edit, and create original content for new products, partnerships, and campaigns, as well as manage folks who will do the same. Ensure the work is cohesive, high-quality, and consistently on brand. You will build and scale a federated automation model—combining centralized standards, governance, and reusable assets with distributed delivery through aligned teams and Citizen Developers—promoting measurable outcomes, adoption, and strong controls.Job ResponsibilitiesLead day-to-day project management for a portfolio of automation and transformation initiatives; deliver high-quality results on time and within budget.Design and oversee solutions using UiPath, Power Automate, and other low-code/RPA tools (e.g., Instabase, Xceptor, and similar platforms as applicable). normalizedText: Job DescriptionJoin the team redefining how the world experiences design.Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte, namaste!Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.Where And How You Can WorkOur headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role, we’re focusing on Bangalore so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.What You’d Be Doing In This RoleOwn Canva’s product and localisation strategy for India, with a strong focus on user growth and experience across languages. Contribute to the product roadmap for India, including features, payment methods, authentication flows, and other market-specific initiatives. Analyse the active user and subscription funnels to identify opportunities for improving activation, engagement, and conversion. Evaluate and adapt global messaging, campaigns, and product experiences to resonate with Indian users across different regions and languages. Provide cultural and linguistic insights to global teams to inform product, content, and marketing decisions. Project management to drive cross-functional collaboration on localisation: Marketing, Content, SEO and ProductManage relationships with external localisation partners and collaborate with external linguists, translators and the in-house Language Manager, to ensure clarity, cultural nuance, and consistency across all Indian-language experiences. Together, develop and evolve style guides, tone of voice principles, and best practices for the region. Help prioritise localisation investments across languages and regions based on impact, scale, and user needs. QualificationsWhat we're looking for5+ years of experience working in product, growth, or localisation roles within a high-growth SaaS or product-led company. Strong product and growth mindset, with an understanding of how India’s language ecosystem (including regional languages and English usage patterns) influences user behaviour and product adoption. Strong understanding of content and UX copy, including the ability to write and adapt English-language messaging for Indian users across product and growth surfaces. Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across product, marketing, content, and regional teams. Fluency in English, with strong proficiency in at least one major Indian language. Familiarity with multiple Indian languages is a strong plus. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and scaling solutions in complex, multi-market environments. A strategic thinker who is equally happy rolling up their sleeves and executing. Genuine passion for Canva’s mission to empower the world to design. Additional InformationAbout the Group/TeamCanva’s International Supergroup is responsible for driving growth and deepening adoption across our key regions worldwide. We are an entrepreneurial, cross-functional team that turns bold strategy into culturally resonant execution.In India, our mission is to empower people across the country to design and express themselves, regardless of language, geography, or background. India represents one of Canva’s most important growth opportunities, with a deeply diverse language ecosystem, a rapidly expanding creator economy, and millions of users coming online for the first time. Our goal is to make Canva feel intuitive, accessible, and truly local for users across India.About The Role/SpecialtyAs the India Localisation Lead, you will own Canva’s product and localisation experience in India, ensuring users across different regions and languages have the best possible Canva experience. You will be the voice of Indian users and a champion for culturally and linguistically relevant product experiences.This role goes beyond translation. It requires a strong understanding of India’s language landscape, how users switch between languages, and how localisation decisions impact trust, usability, and growth at scale. OverviewPart of The Weber Shandwick Collective, we’re the earned-first global communications agency, led by world-class strategic thinkers and creative activators. We create shared and sustainable value for businesses, people, and society. We energize the right mix of talent, using the right platforms and latest technology to choreograph stories that make a real and meaningful impact for some of the world’s leading brands and businessesOur game-changing work is recognized by some of the most prestigious industry awards bodies, and we have won more than 135 Lions at the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity. We’re also PRWeek’s 2024 Global Agency of the Year as well as being listed on the Ad Age A-List 2024 and Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies 2024.More than ever, organizations need to solve for unprecedented challenges born of technology-driven disruption. We fuse global teams grounded in technology, digital innovation and analytics to help clients. As we live in an always-on world, our brand positioning reflects this need to engage with our always-on audience, just as we advise our clients to do. We inspire. We incite. We shape ideas and conversations, and we activate our global reach for local causes and multinational brands alike, and we’re always ready for more problems to solve.Our Values:CURIOSITY – We cultivate curiosity and challenge convention. Because solving any problem begins by asking the right questionsINCLUSION – We foster teams and environments built on belonging and openness to possibility. Because the best ideas have no biasCOURAGE – We stand up for what we believe in. Because being comfortable with the uncomfortable is how progress is madeIMPACT – We strive to make a meaningful difference in everything we do. Because we owe it to our people, or clients and the worldAbout the opportunityDigital is no longer a specialist capability. It’s central to how brands build reputation, engage communities and create business impact.We’re looking for a leader who can shape the future of Weber Shandwick’s digital offering in Mumbai by bringing together strategy, creativity, technology and communications into truly integrated client solutions.You’ll lead our digital business in the market, partner with multidisciplinary teams, and help clients navigate an increasingly connected communications landscape. Just as importantly, you’ll play a key role in growing our digital capabilities, developing talent, and identifying new opportunities for our clients and our business.This role offers significant autonomy. You’ll have the support of senior leadership, but we’re looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, is comfortable making decisions, and can maintain momentum in a fast-moving environment with the judgement to know when to seek support and when to lead from the front.If you’re excited by building capabilities, solving business problems through integrated communications, and helping shape what’s next, we’d like to hear from you.What You’ll Be Responsible ForLead Digital CommunicationsLead Weber Shandwick’s digital practice in Mumbai – standalone and integrated, ensuring strategic approach and business success as key outcomes.Develop integrated digital strategies that combine earned, owned, paid, influencer and content into cohesive communications programs.Partner closely with Consumer, Corporate, Public Affairs, Strategy and Creative teams to deliver integrated solutions that solve business challenges.Provide senior strategic counsel on digital communications to clients across sectors.Build Client & Business GrowthIdentify opportunities to expand digital capabilities across existing client relationships.Support and lead digital-led new business opportunities and integrated pitches.Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and become a strategic advisor on digital communications.Evolve the CapabilityContinuously evolve our digital capabilities by identifying and embedding emerging platforms, technologies and AI into client solutions.Drive excellence across social media, content, influencer marketing, paid amplification and community engagement.Establish best practices that improve the quality, consistency and effectiveness of digital delivery across teams.Drive Operational ExcellenceOwn the commercial performance of the practice, including forecasting, resourcing and profitability.Ensure high standards of client delivery, operational rigour and execution.Work seamlessly across multidisciplinary teams to deliver best-in-class integrated programs.Who We’re Looking ForWe’re looking for someone who combines digital expertise with commercial thinking and a passion for building integrated communications record of growing client relationships and contributing to business development.Strong commercial acumen and experience managing practice performance.Experience building, mentoring and leading high-performing teams.Note from the teamWeber Shandwick is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. normalizedText: About the Role GrowthJockey is building an AI-native, full-stack venture creation institution that unifies strategy, product, technology, design, digital growth, commerce, operations and capital discipline. The CVGO will work directly with the Founder, executive leadership, promoters, investors and enterprise partners to build ventures that win in the market — and to convert founder-led capability into a repeatable institutional system.This is a founding mandate for a deeply digital business creator who can repeatedly build from 0–1, 1–10 and 10–100. It is not a general management role and not a conventional marketing leadership position.Key ResponsibilitiesCreate and scale ventures — Translate market opportunities into differentiated propositions, brands, customer engines, commercial models and category leadership.Own venture outcomes — Carry direct accountability for venture success, revenue quality, market traction, unit economics, BU P&L, cash flow, working capital and capital productivity.Steward promoter and investor confidence — Engage credibly with promoters, investors and boards; align ambition, milestones, risks, capital choices and performance with transparency and judgement.Build the digital growth engine — Integrate brand, performance, content, creative, SEO, CRM, lifecycle, analytics, D2C, marketplaces and quick commerce into one accountable business system.Institutionalise the chaos — Bring method, operating cadence, decision rights, playbooks, data discipline and governance to ambiguity, without reducing entrepreneurial speed.Build internal capability — Recruit leaders, create specialist centres of excellence, develop succession and ensure capabilities compound beyond individual founders or executives.Embed AI as an operating advantage — Redesign digital research, content, creative production, media, personalisation, CRM, commerce, analytics and decision workflows around AI.Make portfolio choices — Know when to accelerate, reposition, partner, fix or stop; allocate leadership attention and capital to maximise enterprise value.Mandatory Digital & New-Age CapabilityPerformance and digital marketing — full-funnel acquisition, media economics, experimentation, attribution, optimisation and scaling across major paid ecosystems.Brand building — positioning, category creation, consumer insight, communication architecture and sustained brand-equity development, not only campaign execution.Content and creative systems — strategy, storytelling, high-velocity production, creative testing, channel-native formats and measurable creative effectiveness.CRM and lifecycle growth — segmentation, journeys, lead/customer conversion, retention, loyalty, personalisation, automation and customer-value expansion.Analytics and commercial intelligence — funnel diagnosis, cohort and unit-economics analysis, attribution judgement, dashboards, forecasting and decision-making from imperfect data.Digital commerce — direct ownership across D2C, marketplaces, merchandising, pricing, promotions, catalogue, conversion, fulfilment economics and channel profitability.Quick commerce — practical understanding of assortment, availability, platform economics, demand shaping, dark-store/channel dynamics and rapid experimentation.AI in digital growth — applied use of generative AI, agents, automation, predictive systems and experimentation to improve insight, content, creative, media, CRM, commerce and productivity.Growth technology — fluency with modern martech, CDP/CRM, analytics, automation, commerce and experimentation stacks; able to challenge architecture and connect systems to business outcomes.Creator Profile — MandatoryA repeated record of creating or scaling businesses, categories or digital commerce engines, not merely supervising agencies or mature functions.Enjoys pace and ambiguity; can move from first-principles strategy to weekly execution while remaining methodical, consistent and commercially rigorous.Builds systems, leaders and institutional memory so the organisation becomes stronger than the individual who created it.Can make high-quality decisions with incomplete information, sustain intensity over years and combine entrepreneurial urgency with governance.Willing to inspect detail personally, intervene where necessary and then codify the solution so it becomes repeatable.Eligibility & Leadership BarEducation — Tier-1 B.Tech or equivalent engineering qualification (mandatory); Tier-1 MBA or equivalent management qualification (mandatory).Experience — Significant leadership experience with direct business, growth, commerce or venture-building accountability; exposure across multiple growth stages is essential.Consulting background — Tier-1 strategy or management consulting background strongly preferred, provided it is complemented by substantial operating and creation experience.P&L ownership — Demonstrated ownership of BU P&L, cash flow, investment choices and senior stakeholder communication.Stakeholder credibility — Credibility to engage founders, promoters, investors, boards, enterprise clients and high-calibre specialist teams.Authority Founding-leadership access; meaningful influence over venture strategy, organisation design, senior hiring, resource allocation, digital operating standards and portfolio priorities.Long-Term Value Creation Executive remuneration will be paired with a meaningful long-term ownership opportunity, aligned to scope, sustained contribution and institution-building impact.What Success Will MeanVentures achieve durable market traction, improving economics, capital discipline and credible paths to category leadership.Promoters and investors experience clear strategy, transparent governance, decisive execution and dependable leadership.GrowthJockey develops a world-class digital, commerce and AI capability that can scale several ventures simultaneously.High-calibre leaders, playbooks, data systems and operating cadences reduce founder dependency and compound across the portfolio.The CVGO becomes one of the principal architects of GrowthJockey's next decade and the long-term enterprise value it creates. jdEvidence.value: Drive divisional transparency, consistency, and performance across the entire commercial funnel and pipeline, ensuring robust commercial governance and continuous improvement.

normalizedText: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping.As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.We are looking for a Head of Commercial Excellence for the Food & Pharma Division at Alfa Laval. We are dedicated to helping billions of people access nutritious food, clean water, and safe medicine. We pioneer technologies and solutions for life-critical industries, including food, pharmaceutical, and water sectors, enabling our customers to produce more while using less water, energy, and valuable raw materials.About The JobThe Head of Commercial Excellence is a key leadership role within Division Marketing, reporting to the VP Marketing. The role works closely with divisional leadership, Business Units (BU), and stakeholders across the organization, and is responsible for driving divisional transparency, consistency, and performance across the entire commercial funnel and pipeline of the Division.The Head of Commercial Excellence ensures robust commercial governance, actionable performance dialogue, and continuous improvement, in alignment with group frameworks. The role translates pipeline, sales, and commercial performance data into actionable recommendations, supporting fact-based decision-making and business growth.Key Responsibilities Funnel and Pipeline performanceLead divisional oversight of the commercial funnel, from demand creation through pipeline progression to conversion.Monitor pipeline health and commercial performance across the Division, including conversion, aging, quality, coverage, business risk, and forecast reliability.Identify bottlenecks, gaps, and improvement opportunities, and translate pipeline, sales, and commercial performance data into actionable recommendations for divisional and BU leadership.Drive a divisional performance rhythm for funnel and pipeline reviews, ensuring consistent reporting, follow-up, and performance dialogue.Work closely with BUs to link the actual pipeline to the sales forecast, supporting forecast validation, risk assessment, and remedial actions. CRM & Installed Base VisibilityDrive adoption and effective use of CRM systems and tools by defining and enforcing divisional standards for CRM discipline, funnel hygiene and commercial data quality, and monitoring adoption and improvement across regions to enable reliable performance management and decision-making.Ensure visibility and effective use of installed base and customer prioritization data to support targeted commercial actions. Service and Lifecycle Opportunity AnalysisAnalyze service upselling opportunities within the installed base, track their development across segments and accounts, and provide insights to BUs sales and service functions to unlock further service sales potential. Monitor the speed and quality of opportunity progression through stage gates Cross-functional alignmentWork cross-functionally with Sales, Service, Marketing, BUs, Digital Marketing, and Group Sales Commercial Excellence to improve pipeline conversion, planning quality, and commercial execution.Establish structured dialogue with BU and regional commercial excellence and sales leaders to capture and integrate market needs, feedback, and execution barriers into divisional priorities, processes, and tools. Data & AnalyticsUse dashboards, analytics, and commercial data hands-on to support fact-based decision-making, pipeline transparency, and performance improvement across the division.Monitor and report on key commercial metrics, including revenue growth in prioritized accounts, customer retention, and customer experience, while supporting broader adoption of relevant tools across divisional and BU teams.Contribute to divisional efforts to monitor and improve customer experience and satisfaction in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.Who You AreProven track record of driving commercial performance, pipeline management, and cross-functional improvement in complex, matrixed organizations.Strong analytical skills and proficiency in commercial data analysis, pipeline reporting, and performance management tools.Experience influencing senior stakeholders and leading performance dialogue at executive level.Proficiency in CRM, BI tools, and ExcelExperience in complex international B2B environments, preferably in industrial, process technology, or related industries.Experience leading teams and working across diverse marketing and business functions.Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.What You KnowBachelor’s or master’s degree in marketing, Business, Engineering Economics, or related field.Significant experience (8+ years) in commercial excellence, business performance management, or related roles in an international B2B environment.Experience from management consulting is a strong advantage.This position is based at our Stockholm, Lund, Søborg, Kolding, Pune or Shanghai office. The role requires regular international travel.For more information, please contact Regina García Moguel, Talent Acquisition Partner, regina.garciamoguel@alfalaval.comUnion information Axel Scharing, Akademikerna, axel.scharing@alfalaval.comAnders Jansson, Unionen, anders.jansson@alfalaval.comKenneth Wideström, Ledarna, kenneth.widestrom@alfalaval.comWe review applications continually so please send in yours not later than July 31st, 2026.Please note that, in compliance with GDPR, we cannot accept applications submitted via email. We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games. As part of Alfa Laval’s commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, alcohol and drug testing is applied during the preemployment process. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role. The platform enables seamless collaboration across multiple stakeholders while supporting institutions and students through advanced digital technology, data-driven insights, and innovative solutions. With operations spanning Canada, the United States, India, and other global markets, MSM Unify is committed to delivering scalable technology solutions that support academic delivery, student mobility, and international education services. Role Purpose The Head Technology will lead the end-to-end technology ecosystem supporting academics, student journeys, and business operations across MSM Unify and associated global entities operating in Canada, the United States, and India. This role ensures that all digital platforms are stable, secure, scalable, and continuously enhanced in alignment with academic delivery needs, operational priorities, and regulatory requirements. The position requires a hands-on technology leader with strong technical depth, delivery discipline, and the ability to closely oversee engineering output, platform evolution, and system reliability while collaborating with cross-functional teams. Key Responsibilities 1. Technology Strategy Governance Define and execute a group-wide technology strategy aligned with academic, operational, and regulatory requirements. Establish technology standards, architecture principles, and governance frameworks across regions. Ensure seamless integration between academic systems and technology platforms, eliminating operational silos. Own platform and architecture decisions, including technology roadmaps, prioritization, and sequencing of initiatives. 2. Digital Platforms Systems Ownership Lead the full lifecycle management of all major digital platforms, including Public-facing and internal websites Student and partner portals Learning management, academic, and enterprise systems Ensure platforms are continuously improved, optimized, and enhanced based on business and academic requirements. Drive prioritization and execution of functional enhancements, system upgrades, and capability expansion. Ensure all platform updates are delivered efficiently, securely, and with minimal operational risk. Maintain strong collaboration between technology, academics, operations, and leadership teams. 3. Cloud, Architecture Infrastructure Define and manage cloud architecture and infrastructure strategy across all technology platforms. Ensure systems are designed for high availability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency. Provide architectural guidance and technical direction to engineering teams. Review system designs, deployment strategies, and infrastructure configurations. Ensure infrastructure meets security, compliance, and audit standards. 4. Engineering Delivery DevOps Leadership Establish strong engineering delivery governance and development standards across teams. Oversee release planning, deployment governance, and environment management. Implement and promote automation, CICD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices. Monitor delivery timelines and proactively address risks, bottlenecks, and delays. Ensure robust rollback mechanisms, incident response procedures, and contingency planning. 5. Security, Data Protection Audit Readiness Lead cybersecurity, access control, and data protection frameworks across all platforms. Ensure readiness for internal audits, external security assessments, and regulatory reviews. Maintain documentation for architecture, security policies, access management, and change management processes. Represent the technology function during audits, compliance reviews, and regulator interactions. Ensure effective business continuity and disaster recovery planning, including regular testing. 6. AI, Automation Advanced Technology Enablement Enable responsible adoption of AI and intelligent automation across learning platforms and internal systems. Collaborate with academic leadership to support AI-assisted learning, assessments, and analytics. Apply analytical and technical expertise to evaluate system performance, engineering output, and platform capabilities. Ensure advanced technologies align with governance, ethics, and compliance standards. 7. Vendor, Cost Build-vs-Buy Management Lead vendor evaluation, selection, and ongoing performance management. Drive build-vs-buy decisions for technology platforms, tools, and integrations. Ensure vendor deliverables meet agreed service levels, security requirements, and contractual obligations. Optimize technology spending while maintaining high system reliability and performance. 8. Team Leadership Capability Building Lead engineering, infrastructure, platform, and support teams across multiple geographies. Define team structures, hiring plans, and Key Performance Areas KPAs Platform reliability, scalability, and performance Timely delivery of platform enhancements and upgrades Security, data protection, and audit readiness Alignment between technology platforms and academic operations Engineering delivery efficiency and operational stability Vendor performance and cost optimization Required Qualifications Experience Bachelors or Masters degree in Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 10-15 years of experience in technology leadership roles with strong hands-on technical depth. Proven experience managing complex, multi-platform digital ecosystems. Strong expertise in cloud architecture and infrastructure leadership. Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams with deep technical oversight. Experience working in regulated, compliance-driven, or audit-intensive environments is preferred. Skills Technical Competencies Strong expertise in cloud platforms and infrastructure management. Solid understanding of DevOps practices, CICD pipelines, release management, and automation. Working knowledge of AI-enabled systems and data-driven platforms. Proficiency in Python or similar programming languages for technical evaluation and analysis. Ability to critically assess architecture decisions, engineering quality, and system performance. Excellent English communication skills written and verbal for collaboration with leadership, partners, and auditors. High discipline in documentation, process management, and risk mitigation.

normalizedText: This role is with one of our portfolio companies.Responsibilities:The Head of Brand Marketing will own end-to-end brand strategy, positioning, and storytelling for the company across different cities in India.Define and own brand strategy, positioning, and messaging architecture as we expand into new category, cities, and consumer segments.You'll own the strategy, voice, and visual identity of the brand across every consumer touchpoint.Lead major brand campaigns end-to-end: strategy, creative brief, agency management, media planning, execution, and post-campaign analysis.Own brand content across digital, social, OOH, TV/OTT, and on-ground activations as relevant to the categories.Partner closely with Performance Marketing/Growth to ensure brand investment compounds performance efficiency (CAC, LTV) rather than working in a silo.Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify opportunities for brand differentiation and value positioning.Set and maintain brand and creative standards (voice, tone, visual identity) across web, product, social, and paid media.Build and track brand health metrics (awareness, consideration, NPS, brand equity).Requirements:10+ years in brand marketing, with 4+ years in a senior leadership role, ideally at a high-growth consumer tech company.A track record of building or meaningfully elevating a consumer brand at scale.Experience in category-defining or category-creation brand building.Strong track record of leading integrated campaigns across TV/OTT, digital, social, and on-ground/OOH.Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities.Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience presenting to founders/CXOs. jdEvidence.value: Take end-to-end ownership of Patrika Digital's organic traffic footprint, including traffic recovery, future-proofing against AI search, and optimizing Google News/Discover placement.

normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Pay₹22,00,000 - ₹24,00,000 an hourJob typeFull-time LocationJaipur, Rajasthan Full job descriptionWe are seeking a deeply hands-on and technical Head of SEO to take end-to-end ownership of Patrika Digital's organic traffic footprint. You will not function as an isolated individual contributor; instead, you will lead a dedicated team of technical and content SEO analysts and possess the authority to mandate technical adjustments to our CMS/dev pipelines and content standards to editorial. Years of Experience: 12 years + Key Responsibilities & Core Problems to Solve Traffic Recovery: Perform a swift, root-cause diagnosis of our organic traffic bleed (evaluating indexation, Core Web Vitals, E-E-A-T/YMYL health for critical segments like astrology/health, and competitor market share loss) and reverse it within 60–90 days. Future-Proof Search Shift: Formulate and execute strategies to protect traffic against AI-driven search models, zero-click landscapes, and AI Overviews across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode. Optimize Primary Acquisition Levers: Refine technical and structured data configurations exclusively for Google News and Google Discover placement—our largest acquisition funnel. Editorial Integration: Actively embed with the newsroom planning conversations daily to ensure headline architectures and story verticals maintain top Discover eligibility. Experience & Scale Requirements Must have owned SEO strategy for a massive news or publisher platform generating 10M+ monthly organic sessions, ideally within Hindi or Indic language markets. Hands-on mastery of Google News and Discover optimization pipelines, including schema markup, Core Web Vitals for news, and Publisher Center ecosystem management. Demonstrated history of successfully navigating and recovering a major content site through at least one Core Update or Helpful Content Update. Critical Disqualifiers SEO backgrounds confined strictly to e-commerce or B2B/SaaS verticals; news/publishing SEO is fundamentally different and mandatory here. Lacking hands-on technical depth (e.g., someone who can only brief developers but cannot personally debug indexation errors or audit raw schema markup). Lack of an immediate actionable perspective on AI search engines, treating them as a future concern rather than an active shift. Pay: ₹2,200,000.00 - ₹2,400,000.00 per hour Work Location: In person

About UgaooUgaoo is India’s leading gardening and home-grown lifestyle brand, building a deeper connection between people and plants. What started as a horticulture-first business has evolved into a full-stack D2C ecosystem, with our website serving as a key growth engine where customers across the country discover plants, gardening essentials, and plant care solutions.Alongside our D2C platform, Ugaoo also reaches customers through select offline (Retail, Corporate Gifting, Services & Maintenance) and marketplace channels. Team Management: - Supervise, guide, and mentor junior social media managers, ensuring successful campaign execution. - Coordinate team efforts to ensure smooth day-to-day execution of social media tasks and initiatives. - Brand Partnerships & Collaboration: - Manage brand tie-ups, collaborations, and influencer partnerships to increase brand visibility and engagement. - Ensure effective communication and coordination between internal teams and external stakeholders for seamless campaign execution. Social Media Optimization (SMO): - Implement best practices for Social Media Optimization to improve organic engagement and visibility. - Continuously optimize content for performance across various social media platforms. Miscellaneous Tasks: - Travel for shoots and other brand-related activities as required. - Perform miscellaneous tasks as assigned by management to support the growth of the social media strategy.
