Job Description Job ID 2602123 Category Technology Date posted 07/20/2026 Role Title: VP, Business Intelligence - Bank, Digital and DV&L (L12) Company Overview: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com. Organizational Overview: Our Analytics organization comprises of data analysts who focus on enabling strategies to enhance customer and partner experience and optimize business performance through data management and development of full stack descriptive to prescriptive analytics solutions using cutting edge technologies thereby enabling business growth. Role Summary/Purpose: VP, Business Intelligence - Bank, Digital and DV&L: This People Manager role is part of India Analytics Hub & Business Intelligence (IAH & BI) org. The role will deliver on business and organizational priorities for Consumer Bank, Digital, and Diversified and Value and Lifestyle platforms focusing on business intelligence solutions, that are powered by data and analytics. The candidate will own both product outcomes (roadmap, adoption, value realization) and delivery execution (planning, dependencies, predictable releases) for assigned Business Intelligence products and capabilities. The candidate will also collaborate with internal Synchrony platform analytics teams across US and India, cross-functionally and with our partners to enhance overall customer experience and guide our stakeholders in making more informed decisions by delivering governed, scalable, and user-friendly BI solutions. Key Responsibilities: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of assigned BI products/features (intake discovery build launch adoption continuous improvement). Define and maintain product vision, roadmap, and priorities, securing alignment and leadership buy-in. Establish and track success measures / OKRs (e.g., adoption and usage, stakeholder satisfaction, time-to-deliver, data quality/accuracy, productivity). Lead discovery to translate business needs into clearly defined problem statements, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and standardized metric definitions. Drive adoption and change management: communications, training, user guides, release notes, onboarding, and recurring enablement (office hours). Ensure on-time delivery, high-quality outputs, including performance, scalability, reliability, and supportability; and complete documentation in alignment with audit and governance requirements. Own project execution from scoping through delivery using Agile/Hybrid methods; manage scope, schedule, resourcing, and delivery commitments. Maintain an up-to-date, transparent delivery plan (backlog, milestones, and dependencies) and a RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, decisions) for leadership reporting. Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned platform/CoE/enterprise stakeholders; run operating cadences (e.g., weekly status, prioritization reviews, steering updates). Lead stakeholder working sessions and product demos in partnership with analytics teams; document decisions, actions, owners, and timelines. Mentor/coordinate team members in a matrix environment; clarify RACI, ensure accountability, and remove blockers. Manage and develop the team, including workforce planning, hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development. Required Skills/Knowledge: Minimum 8+ years of hands-on experience in relational databases (SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) for validation, reconciliation, and data-driven decisioning. Minimum 8+ years of hands-on and demonstrated experience delivering BI/analytics products (dashboards, standardized reporting, self-service BI, metrics/semantic layers) with measurable adoption and business outcomes. Hands-on familiarity with Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI/visualization platforms and BI best practices (performance, usability, basic security/access concepts). Strong project and team management capability: workload, backlog management, user stories, dependency estimation, sprint/release planning. Working knowledge of data warehousing/lakehouse concepts, ETL patterns, and data modeling fundamentals (schemas, dimensions/facts). Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and ability to tell a clear story with data and numbers to senior leaders. Experience in managing teams with ability to motivate team, drive change, create a culture of learning, innovation and recognition Ability to solve complex technical and business problems with minimal supervision. Desired Skills & Knowledge: Python and/or SAS for analysis, automation, or prototyping. Experience with modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks) and related tooling. Knowledge of AI/GenAI applications in BI and associated considerations. Functional knowledge of Marketing, Sales, and/or Credit lifecycle. People and project management experience along with superior thought leadership and framework based solutioning abilities. Innovative mindset to improve current capabilities and discover new ones. Eligibility Criteria: Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or any other quantitative streams with 8+ years of hands-on relevant analytics/business intelligence experience, or in lieu of a degree 10+ years of relevant analytics/business intelligence experience. Work Timings: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events. For Internal Applicants: Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before ing Inform your manager or HRM before ing for the role on Workday Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format) Must not be on any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP) Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible L10+ Employees can Grade/Level: 12 Job Family Group: Information Technology

Who are we? Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work.This intelligence powers our entire product suite.Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster. Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps. Mirror allows employees to train in safe, simulated environments. These are embedded with Whatfix AI Agents which supercharge creation, insights, and user guidance.Our upcoming AI-first products are already creating a buzz in the market.Seek is an AI-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf. Whatfix Mirror 2.0 is the world’s only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category. Together, these products reflect Whatfix’s commitment to building enterprise-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. It gives users a unified, intelligent way to find answers across systems, apps, and knowledge silos and helps anyone looking to deliver fast and contextual answers.Whatfix is bridging the gap between rapid technological change and human enablement—ensuring AI is not only embedded but also usable, trusted, and outcome-driven for every employee.At Whatfix, we’re not just making software easier—we’re making AI work for people.The company has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40+ countries.Customers: 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.Investors: A total of ~$270 million USD has been raised as yet. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million USD led by Warburg Pincus, with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.Whatfix’s leadership is consistently recognized across top industry analysts and business rankings:Won the 2025 AI Breakthrough Award for the Overall AI-based Analytics Solution of the Year Only DAP to be recognized as a “Leader” across various DAP reports for the past 5+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group. With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards. Named a Gartner Customers’ Choice for DAP for the second year in a row (2024 and 2025)—the only vendor in the market to earn this distinction consecutively. We also boast a star rating of 4.6 on G2 Crowd, 4.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a super-high CSAT of 99.8% Stevie Award winner in the category (Bronze): Customer Service Department of the Year – Computer Software - 100 or More Employees. Winner of the ISG Paragon Innovation Award in partnership with Sophos (customer) for the EMEA region and finalist in the Transformation Award category. RemoteTech Breakthrough Awards winner for “Software Asset Management Solution of the Year” These recognitions are matched by business performance:Highest-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ North America for Fifth Consecutive Year Listed on the Financial Times & Statista's High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2025 list. Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022-2023 Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal Be one of the key Leaders in this awesome journey of building a billion-dollar company!Key Responsibilities:Own and drive GRR performance across the Americas portfolio by ensuring strong customer outcomes, adoption, renewals, and expansion opportunities. Build strong executive relationships with enterprise and Fortune 500 customers, acting as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders. Drive effective onboarding and time-to-value programs to ensure successful deployments, stakeholder alignment, product adoption, and long-term customer success. Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Partnerships, Services, Product, Support, and Renewals teams to deliver a seamless customer lifecycle experience and improve retention outcomes. Develop scalable adoption and engagement strategies across portfolio accounts using customer health insights, usage trends, and proactive engagement models. Bring experience working within partner ecosystems including GSIs, SIs, ISVs, and strategic consulting partners; experience supporting customers in the Americas market is strongly preferred. Possess a foundational understanding of web technologies and digital adoption concepts including HTML, CSS, JavaScript basics, SaaS applications, integrations, analytics, and enterprise application workflows to effectively engage with customers and understand Whatfix platform capabilities. Qualification Criteria:10–12+ years of overall professional experience with at least 4–5 years of leadership experience in Customer Success, Partner Success, Account Management, Renewals, or related customer-facing SaaS roles. Proven track record of driving GRR, NRR, customer adoption, renewals, and expansion outcomes within enterprise or SaaS organizations. Demonstrated experience managing and growing relationships with enterprise and Fortune 500 customers, including executive stakeholder engagement and strategic account management. Strong experience leading customer-facing teams and coaching individuals on EBRs, value communication, adoption strategies, customer lifecycle management, and renewal motions. At the same time, we recognize the importance of flexibility in balancing personal and professional priorities. To support this, we offer the option to work from home up to two days per month. normalizedText: CTO - Global Capability CentreReporting to – COOLocation: GurgaonBudget: 60-65 LPA Executive SummaryAIONOS is seeking an exceptional Executive Leader with 10+ years of experience to drive the commercialization and delivery of AI-powered solutions for Global Capability Centres. This senior role combines strategic business development, executive-level communication, and technical acumen to establish AIONOS as the preferred AI platform partner for GCC operations. You will engage C-suite executives at Fortune 2000 organizations, identify AI transformation opportunities across our four platforms, and architect customized solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.Role OverviewThis is a strategic leadership position that sits at the intersection of business development, solution architecture, and executive communication. You will own the end-to-end engagement model for GCC customers, from initial discovery through proof-of-value execution and commercial closure. Your deep understanding of GCC operating models, combined with your ability to translate complex AI capabilities into actionable business value, will be critical to AIONOS's growth in this high-value segment. Key ResponsibilitiesExecutive Engagement: Lead discovery conversations with C-suite stakeholders (CFOs, COOs, CIOs, Chief AI Officers) at GCC organizations, translating business challenges into AI-driven solutions using AIONOS's platform portfolio.Business Development: Identify, qualify, and shepherd high-value GCC opportunities through the sales pipeline; build and maintain executive relationships; structure commercial terms and engagement models (SaaS, consulting, proof-of-value arrangements).Solution Architecture: Conduct comprehensive discovery of GCC operational models, pain points, and AI maturity; design customized solution architectures that integrate AIONOS platforms or recommend custom development; build compelling business cases with ROI analysis.Strategic Storytelling: Develop compelling narratives around AIONOS capabilities tailored to GCC contexts (cost optimization, quality assurance, compliance, workforce enablement, vendor risk management); deliver executive presentations and thought leadership content.Proof-of-Value (PoV) Leadership: Own the design and delivery of structured PoV engagements (typically 60–90 days); manage customer expectations, coordinate internal cross-functional teams, and drive successful outcomes that lead to commercial deals.Market Intelligence: Monitor GCC trends, competitive positioning, and emerging AI opportunities; provide insights to product and marketing teams to inform roadmap and go-to-market strategies.Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, engineering, delivery, and customer success teams to ensure successful implementation and customer satisfaction post-sale.Required Qualifications10+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, solutions architecture, business development, or consulting with a demonstrated track recordProven ability to engage and influence C-suite executives (CFO, COO, CIO level); comfort with boardroom-level presentations and strategic business discussions.Deep familiarity with Global Capability Centre (GCC) operations, shared services models, or business process outsourcing environments. Understanding of GCC cost structures, governance, compliance, and typical operational challenges is essential.Strong technical foundation: ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, data infrastructure, observability, agentic workflows, and security—without requiring hand-holding from technical teams.Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to adapt messaging for diverse audiences (C-suite, technical teams, procurement); demonstrated thought leadership (publications, speaking engagements, or industry recognition).Experience designing and delivering proof-of-value engagements or managed consulting projects; thinks in terms of customer outcomes, not features.Executive Presence: Commands respect in the room; articulates complex ideas with clarity and conviction; comfortable in high-stakes negotiations.Consultative Problem-Solving: Diagnoses customer challenges; proposes solutions; balances customer needs with AIONOS capabilities and constraints.Relationship Building: Develops deep, multi-threaded relationships with customers; earns trust through expertise and follow-through.Resilience & Adaptability: Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments; pivots strategy based on market feedback; handles rejection and ambiguity well.Ownership Mentality: Takes end-to-end accountability for customer outcomes; champions customer interests internally; drives closure and results. You will be responsible for devising and executing innovative digital strategies that enhance customer engagement and satisfaction across multiple channels. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you will leverage cutting-edge technologies and industry insights to deliver seamless, personalized customer journeys that drive business growth and loyalty.This role leads North America Financial Services' Digital Customer Experience (DCX) technology strategy and major transformation deals. The leader owns large pursuit strategy end-to-end—shaping solutions, developing value narratives, estimating, differentiating competitively, and guiding cross-functional teams—while engaging C-suite stakeholders to deliver outcomes in growth, experience, and efficiency. normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeContractual / TemporaryFreelancePart-timeFull-time LocationChandigarh Full job description We are seeking a visionary and experienced Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead our technology department and drive innovation in our organization. The CTO will be responsible for defining the technology strategy, managing technology teams, and ensuring the effective use of technology to achieve business goals. Key Responsibilities: Develop and communicate a clear technology vision and strategy in alignment with the company's goals and objectives. Identify opportunities for technological innovation and lead the implementation of new technologies. Recruit, manage, and mentor a high-performing technology team, including software developers, engineers, and IT professionals. Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of the company's technology infrastructure, including networks, servers, and databases. Ensure the security, scalability, and reliability of technology systems. Lead the software development process, from design and coding to testing and deployment. Drive the development of high-quality software products and solutions. Build and maintain relationships with technology vendors, partners, and service providers. Evaluate and select technology solutions that align with business needs. Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends. Identify opportunities for research and development to enhance the company's competitiveness. Develop and manage the technology budget, allocating resources effectively to meet project and departmental goals. Ensure cost-effective technology operations. Identify and mitigate technology-related risks. Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements. Provide regular reports to the CEO and executive team on technology initiatives, progress, and performance. Communicate technology strategies and achievements to stakeholders. Drive innovation through the development of intellectual property and patents. Protect and leverage the company's intellectual assets. Qualifications and Skills: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (Master's degree or MBA is preferred). Proven experience as a CTO or in a senior technology leadership role, with a successful track record in technology strategy and management. Deep understanding of technology trends, software development, and IT infrastructure. Strong leadership and team-building skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate technology teams. Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, with the capacity to engage with stakeholders at all levels. Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with a focus on innovation and business outcomes. Financial acumen and budget management experience. Knowledge of data security, compliance, and risk management. Experience with technology partnerships and vendor management. Patents or intellectual property portfolio is a plus. Benefits: Competitive compensation package and executive-level perks. Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. A dynamic and collaborative work environment. The chance to lead technology innovation and drive business growth. Job Type: Full-time / Freelance / Part-time / Contract Location: Chandigarh (U.T.) jdEvidence.value: Develop and execute B2B marketing strategies focused on lead generation, pipeline growth, and brand awareness.

normalizedText: LocationBengaluru Rural District, Karnataka Full job description Role:B2B Marketing Lead Location: Bangalore Experience: 2 - 5 years Key Responsibilities Develop and execute B2B marketing strategies focused on lead generation, pipeline growth, and brand awareness. Create and manage multi-channel campaigns (LinkedIn, email, SEO, paid search, webinars, etc.). Collaborate with sales to align messaging, target segments, and drive qualified leads. Own the creation of marketing content such as whitepapers, case studies, blog posts, and email nurtures. Manage marketing automation and CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce) to track lead lifecycle and campaign performance. Conduct market research and competitor analysis to refine positioning and value propositions. Optimize website and landing pages for lead capture and SEO. Track and report on key performance metrics (MQLs, CPL, CTR, CAC, etc.).

Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together. Director, Customer Success (Regional Leader)Location: Chennai, India | Work Model: In-office (5 days per week)About the TeamOur Chennai Shared Services Center (SSC) is the engine room that powers Appian’s global Customer Success delivery. We are a high-performing, rapidly growing hub of world-class consultants and specialists who enable global enterprise clients to maximize the value of the Appian platform. Our culture thrives on operational excellence, collaboration, and a shared pride in driving tangible business outcomes for our customers worldwide.The OpportunityAs the Director, Customer Success (Regional Leader), you will hold the keys to the overall health, performance, and scalability of our Chennai SSC. This is a pure operational and people leadership role where your success is measured not by technical code, but by organizational vitality- ensuring we have a healthy, optimally staffed, and highly motivated operation. Acting as a critical bridge between local execution and global strategy, you will balance the fast-paced expectations of our US headquarters with the unique needs of our regional talent. If you are an operational strategist who loves building cohesive team cultures, managing global stakeholder matrices, and scaling high-performing regional hubs, this role offers an incredible platform for global impact.What You’ll DoBuild and Scale the Team: Define hiring profiles in collaboration with Capability Leaders and Talent Management, support interviewing, and manage headcount growth to keep supply aligned with the SSC's expanding service portfolio. Proactively keep an eye toward the operational infrastructure needed as the center scales.Set and Uphold the Standard: Establish a culture of excellence and intensity across the Chennai team. Hold consultants to high expectations for quality, accountability, and conduct. Reinforce those standards through performance conversations, recognition, and a consistent, visible leadership presence. Resolve performance issues quickly. Own the Supply Side of the Business: Maintain complete visibility into available capacity across all resource pools and make final consultant assignment decisions in close consultation with Chennai Leaders, who advise on technical readiness, Engagement Managers, who carry the engagement context, and US HQ.Drive Utilization Performance: Monitor and manage billable utilization across the Chennai team as an active, ongoing discipline. Proactively identify underutilization risk. Resolve allocation gaps before they become problems, and hold theater leaders accountable for the pipeline visibility that makes good staffing possible.Govern Regional Finances: Collaborate closely with operations to manage cost tracking, theater charge-backs for unbillable work, and financial discipline across the SSC. Serve as the primary point of contact for Ops finance and ensure the center operates within a clear, defensible cost model.Create and Run Operational Governance: Lead the BAU steering cadence, manage the staffing conflict resolution process, and enforce the lead-time and forecasting expectations that theater leaders must meet. Treat reactive, last-minute staffing requests as a governance issue to be corrected, not an inconvenience to be absorbed.Lead People and Organizational Health: Own the full people management lifecycle for the Chennai team, including performance reviews, career development conversations, compensation inputs, and HR matters. Tools and Resources Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires. Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. This is a pure operational and people leadership role where your success is measured not by technical code, but by organizational vitality- ensuring we have a healthy, optimally staffed, and highly motivated operation. Acting as a critical bridge between local execution and global strategy, you will balance the fast-paced expectations of our US headquarters with the unique needs of our regional talent. If you are an operational strategist who loves building cohesive team cultures, managing global stakeholder matrices, and scaling high-performing regional hubs, this role offers an incredible platform for global impact.What You’ll DoBuild and Scale the Team: Define hiring profiles in collaboration with Capability Leaders and Talent Management, support interviewing, and manage headcount growth to keep supply aligned with the SSC's expanding service portfolio. Proactively keep an eye toward the operational infrastructure needed as the center scales.Set and Uphold the Standard: Establish a culture of excellence and intensity across the Chennai team. Hold consultants to high expectations for quality, accountability, and conduct. Reinforce those standards through performance conversations, recognition, and a consistent, visible leadership presence. Resolve performance issues quickly. Own the Supply Side of the Business: Maintain complete visibility into available capacity across all resource pools and make final consultant assignment decisions in close consultation with Chennai Leaders, who advise on technical readiness, Engagement Managers, who carry the engagement context, and US HQ.Drive Utilization Performance: Monitor and manage billable utilization across the Chennai team as an active, ongoing discipline. Proactively identify underutilization risk. Resolve allocation gaps before they become problems, and hold theater leaders accountable for the pipeline visibility that makes good staffing possible.Govern Regional Finances: Collaborate closely with operations to manage cost tracking, theater charge-backs for unbillable work, and financial discipline across the SSC. Serve as the primary point of contact for Ops finance and ensure the center operates within a clear, defensible cost model.Create and Run Operational Governance: Lead the BAU steering cadence, manage the staffing conflict resolution process, and enforce the lead-time and forecasting expectations that theater leaders must meet. Treat reactive, last-minute staffing requests as a governance issue to be corrected, not an inconvenience to be absorbed.Lead People and Organizational Health: Own the full people management lifecycle for the Chennai team, including performance reviews, career development conversations, compensation inputs, and HR matters. Ensure consultants have the support and clarity they need to grow and stay.Required QualificationsBachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.10+ years of professional experience with a proven track record of leading operations, resource management, or regional hub delivery within a global enterprise software company or top-tier consulting firm.Direct experience working within a US-headquartered organization, with a demonstrated ability to successfully navigate the pace, operating frameworks, and communication style of a US-based matrixed business.Deep expertise in managing resource management metrics, including billable utilization, capacity planning, and operational forecasting.Demonstrated experience in people management, including performance development, compensation planning, and scaling large teams.Strong financial acumen with experience managing regional budgets and internal charge-back models.Ability to work on-site 5 days a week at our Chennai office.Preferred QualificationsMaster of Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent advanced degree in Operations or Management.Experience scaling a Global Capability Center (GCC) or Shared Services Center (SSC) during a phase of rapid growth.Exceptional stakeholder management and conflict resolution skills, with a history of successfully partnering with global executives across different time zones. normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationGurugram, Haryana Full job descriptionSenior Manager, Marketing (FRWD) - MarTech Region: New Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these do not happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH FRWD is Bain & Company's marketing acceleration capability—a community of expert practitioners who partner with clients and their agencies to drive meaningful business results and transformation. Our team brings together specialists from leading in-house marketing organizations, agencies and technology platforms who combine deep practical expertise with a passion for measurable results. We don't just help clients determine what to do—we work alongside them to define how to make it happen. FRWD partners with Bain clients across a range of strategic marketing challenges, including: Marketing diagnostics to identify performance improvement opportunities Marketing transformation and capability building E-commerce acceleration across retail, marketplace and direct-to-consumer channels Marketing operating model, MarTech and data strategy design Commercial due diligence and value creation planning for private equity investments WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM We're looking for a Senior Manager, MarTech to join FRWD in APAC. You'll bring broad marketing expertise together with deep MarTech experience, helping clients integrate technology, customer data and digital capabilities into larger marketing, commercial and growth transformations. As a senior practitioner and workstream leader, you'll shape MarTech strategies, operating models and implementation roadmaps while partnering closely with Bain consulting teams, FRWD practitioners and senior client stakeholders across marketing, sales, technology, analytics and digital functions. You'll also play an important role in growing Bain's MarTech capability across the APAC region through thought leadership, coaching and business development. WHAT YOU'LL DO Lead MarTech strategy and client delivery Lead MarTech diagnostics, assessments and client workstreams across marketing technology, CRM, CDP, marketing automation, personalization, customer journey orchestration, analytics, attribution, privacy and AI-enabled marketing capabilities. Develop data-driven recommendations, investment cases, implementation of roadmaps and capability-building plans that connect technology decisions with measurable business outcomes. Assess existing MarTech ecosystems, vendor landscapes, organizational models and operating processes to identify opportunities for simplification, optimization and growth. Design customer data and activation strategies across leading platforms including Adobe Experience Cloud, Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze, Segment/Twilio, Amplitude, Google Analytics 4, AppsFlyer and related technologies. Develop measurement frameworks, experimentation strategies and attribution approaches that improve customer acquisition, retention, lifecycle engagement and marketing ROI. Collaborate closely with client implementation teams, agencies, platform partners and Bain technical specialists, translating complex technical concepts into actionable business recommendations. Build trusted client relationships Develop strong relationships with senior client stakeholders across marketing, growth, digital, technology, sales and executive leadership. Facilitate executive workshops and stakeholder interviews to align priorities and define practical transformation roadmaps. Deliver clear, compelling presentations that connect MarTech investments to commercial performance, customer experience and operating model improvements. Ensure all analyses, recommendations and client deliverables meet Bain's high standards for quality, accuracy and impact. Lead teams and grow the FRWD capability Lead and coach integrated Bain and FRWD teams throughout client engagements. Share MarTech expertise across the broader Bain ecosystem through tools, methodologies, training and case examples. Support capability building, recruiting, intellectual property development and business development across the APAC FRWD practice. Foster a collaborative, feedback-rich culture while modeling Bain's values and leadership expectations. ABOUT YOU You are an experienced MarTech leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on experience delivering marketing transformation. Required Qualifications 5-8 years of experience across marketing, digital, growth, marketing operations or MarTech, with demonstrated leadership progression. 5+ years of experience in MarTech strategy, technology stack assessments, CRM, CDP, marketing automation, customer journey orchestration, measurement, attribution or marketing technology investments. Experience in consulting, agencies, in-house marketing, customer data or marketing technology environments; client services experience is strongly preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to connect technology, data and process decisions to commercial outcomes. Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams across marketing, technology, analytics and business stakeholders. Practical experience with leading MarTech platforms such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Marketo, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Segment/Twilio, Amplitude, Google Analytics 4, AppsFlyer and related customer data and marketing automation technologies. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage both executive business leaders and technical stakeholders. Experience working across APAC markets or the ability to navigate diverse regulatory environments, partner ecosystems and client cultures. Bachelor's degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred. Willingness to travel as required. MarTech capabilities we're seeking While candidates are not expected to have expertise across every platform, we value experience in several of the following areas: MarTech strategy, technology stack assessments and roadmap development Customer data platforms (CDP), CRM, identity resolution, segmentation and customer activation Marketing automation, lifecycle marketing, personalization and journey orchestration Marketing measurement, attribution, experimentation and performance analytics Privacy, consent management, AI-enabled marketing, workflow automation, e-commerce, retail media and AdTech integration Certifications or practitioner experience across platforms such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Marketo, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Google Marketing Platform, Meta, Amazon Ads, The Trade Desk, Segment/Twilio, Amplitude or comparable technologies ABOUT BAIN & COMPANY Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world's most ambitious change makers define the future. We work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Our vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators complements our integrated consulting expertise to deliver better, faster and more enduring outcomes. Since 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients and continue to lead the industry in client advocacy.

normalizedText: LocationGurugram, Haryana Full job description Location: Gurugram, India Date Posted: Jun 29, 2026 About Alvarez & Marsal Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work-guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M. The Team Our DTS team provides following services to clients: Data & Applied Intelligence - Helping clients in harnessing the power of data and cutting-edge analytics to drive intelligent decision-making and transform businesses Product and Innovation - Empowering clients to innovate, develop, and launch products that drives growth and competitive advantage Technology M&A and Strategy - Assist clients to manage the technology aspects and business enablement of complex M&A, integrations and carve-outs Technology Transformation - A&M helps clients create a scalable, cost-effective IT function that delivers the company's strategic vision and priorities. How you will contribute The Change Manager will play a critical role in enabling end to end change management for Digital & Technology initiatives across A&M client engagements. Sitting within DTS, this role partners closely with technology, data, AI, and business teams to translate complex digital transformations into practical, adoptable change - driving value realization and sustained outcomes. This role is particularly relevant to A&M’s growing work across enterprise digital transformation, AI-led solutions, platform modernization, and technology-enabled operating model changes Key Responsibilities 1. Change Leadership within DTS Engagements Lead end-to-end change management for DTS-led transformations, including digital platforms, analytics, AI solutions, and operating model redesigns Embed change management into tech delivery lifecycles, ensuring adoption is planned alongside build, not post-implementation Act as the bridge between business, technology, and leadership, translating technical change into business-relevant narratives 2. Enable Digital & AI-Driven Adoption Support adoption of AI-enabled tools and digital solutions such as intelligent workflows, agentic or decision-support systems Design user-centric adoption strategies covering communications, enablement, risk management, and behavioural change Partner with product owners and tech teams to ensure solutions are usable, explainable, and responsibly adopted 3. Stakeholder & Leadership Engagement Partner with client leadership, DTS engagement leads, and internal stakeholders to shape change strategies aligned to value and outcomes Develop leadership-ready materials (change roadmaps, adoption dashboards, rollout approaches) tailored to senior audiences 4. Operating Model & Capability Change Support digital operating model shifts, including ways of working, role changes, governance, and capability uplift Design practical enablement approaches that help business users work differently from Day 1 5. Measurement & Sustainment Define and track adoption and change metrics tied to business value, not just activity completion Put in place sustainment mechanisms to ensure changes hold post go-live Skills & Capabilities (Must-Have) Change & Transformation 5–10 years of experience in Change Management, preferably in technology-led or digital transformation programs Strong grounding in change frameworks (Prosci, ADKAR, or equivalent) with the ability to apply pragmatically, not theoretically 6. Digital & Technology Orientation Proven experience working with DTS, Digital, Data, or Technology teams Strong comfort engaging with technical concepts (digital platforms, AI, automation, analytics) and translating them for business audiences Experience integrating change into agile / product-based delivery models 7. Stakeholder & Consulting Skills Consulting-grade communication and storytelling skills, especially for leadership and senior stakeholders Ability to operate in complex, fast-moving, ambiguous environments typical of A&M engagements Strong facilitation, problem-solving, and influencing skills Exposure to Tech-enabled M&A (technology separation, integration, or value creation) • Experience supporting adoption of AI, GenAI, or Agentic A Qualifications Master’s degree in business, Change Management, Organizational Psychology, HR, Technology Management, or a related field Change certifications (Prosci, APMG, etc.) preferred but not mandatory Prior experience in consulting or transformation-heavy environments strongly preferred Your journey at A&M We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals. Culture & Values At Alvarez & Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts. environment with global stakeholders across multiple time zones.Essential Skills/Basic QualificationsProven track record in technology-intensive Business Process Design and Analysis within the BFSI ManagementBusiness Process Analysis & TransformationStakeholder Management & LeadershipBanking Proposition & Product ManagementRegulatory & Governance KnowledgeBusiness Analysis & Solution DesignRisk & Control ManagementDecision Making & Problem SolvingCommunication & Influencing SkillsJob location is Mumbai.Purpose of the roleTo support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by ensuring the business is ready to receive the agreed change (address business problems and opportunities), ensuring that change initiatives are successfully assessed and implemented to enable them to be embedded in the organisation. AccountabilitiesIdentification and analysis of business impact and opportunities that require change within the organisation.Development of business readiness strategies that will help to ensure the successful implementation of change initiatives.Communication with stakeholders, including senior management, project teams, and external partners, to ensure that they are informed about change initiatives and that their needs and expectations are being met.Collaboration with Client Readiness, Operational Readiness & Tech Delivery to ensure business, sales, operations, client servicing and functional partners are prepared for a smooth transition of technology delivery into BAU (including Target Operating Model, Training, Communications, Service Agreements.) .Management of resistance to change, ensuring that stakeholders are engaged and that their concerns are addressed.Review of business readiness plans and status reports in conjunction with change delivery managers to ensure business readiness activities completed on time including newly identified risks, issues and dependencies.Collaboration with project teams to ensure that change initiatives are aligned with project objectives and that change management activities are integrated into project plans.Provision of guidance and support to business stakeholders, ensuring that they have the necessary skills and knowledge to implement change initiatives successfully.Vice President ExpectationsTo contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. OverviewPart of The Weber Shandwick Collective, we’re the earned-first global communications agency, led by world-class strategic thinkers and creative activators. We create shared and sustainable value for businesses, people, and society. We energize the right mix of talent, using the right platforms and latest technology to choreograph stories that make a real and meaningful impact for some of the world’s leading brands and businessesOur game-changing work is recognized by some of the most prestigious industry awards bodies, and we have won more than 135 Lions at the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity. We’re also PRWeek’s 2024 Global Agency of the Year as well as being listed on the Ad Age A-List 2024 and Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies 2024.More than ever, organizations need to solve for unprecedented challenges born of technology-driven disruption. We fuse global teams grounded in technology, digital innovation and analytics to help clients. As we live in an always-on world, our brand positioning reflects this need to engage with our always-on audience, just as we advise our clients to do. We inspire. We incite. We shape ideas and conversations, and we activate our global reach for local causes and multinational brands alike, and we’re always ready for more problems to solve.Our Values:CURIOSITY – We cultivate curiosity and challenge convention. Because solving any problem begins by asking the right questionsINCLUSION – We foster teams and environments built on belonging and openness to possibility. Because the best ideas have no biasCOURAGE – We stand up for what we believe in. Because being comfortable with the uncomfortable is how progress is madeIMPACT – We strive to make a meaningful difference in everything we do. You’ll lead and grow our Consumer Practice in Mumbai, partnering with some of the country’s leading brands while expanding our presence across lifestyle, hospitality, travel & tourism and FMCG.You’ll be responsible for developing client relationships, growing the business, mentoring teams and shaping the future of the practice.This role offers significant autonomy. You’ll have the support of senior leadership, but we’re looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, is comfortable making decisions, and can maintain momentum in a fast-moving environment with the judgement to know when to seek support and when to lead from the front.If you’re energized by building businesses, developing people and creating lasting client partnerships, we’d like to hear from you.What You’ll Be Responsible ForLead the Consumer PracticeLead and grow Weber Shandwick’s Consumer Practice in Mumbai.Provide senior strategic counsel across a portfolio of consumer client relationships.Lead new business conversations and pitches.Build a healthy pipeline across lifestyle, hospitality, travel & tourism and FMCG sectors.Contribute to the long-term growth of the We are seeking a metrics-obsessed operator to own the full-funnel expansion of our mobile application environment. As the Head of Growth (App), you will be directly accountable for active app MAU, retention curves, user activation, and premium subscription conversions. You will maintain a direct integration line into the App Product team to unify feature engineering with rigorous growth loops. Key Responsibilities & Core Problems to Solve Build Conversion Funnels: Establish an efficient web-to-app infrastructure that successfully migrates Patrika's high-volume, unowned web traffic into logged-in, highly trackable app users. Solve the Retention Challenge: Redesign user journeys to move away from low-duration "drive-by" visit behaviors, cementing the app as a home for habitual, daily interaction. App Store Discovery Optimization: Drive strategic App Store Optimization (ASO) and user acquisition architectures to compete effectively against premium news application offerings from major regional competitors. Continuous Experimentation: Conduct continuous, small-scale onboarding, push notification, and pricing tests to steadily improve CAC and LTV economics. Experience & Scale Requirements Must have led the growth engine of a consumer app with several million MAU featuring a live subscription or paywall business model. Complete mastery over full-funnel analytics, including onboarding drop-offs, D1/D7/D30 retention analytics, and trial-to-paid conversion metrics. Practical familiarity operating within price-sensitive, low-ARPU emerging markets dominated by payment friction (such as UPI-dependent behaviors). Critical Disqualifiers Growth expertise limited to paid-acquisition-heavy categories (such as gaming or fintech) that bypass structural retention and long-term habit-loop design. No direct exposure to subscription or premium paywall models (having only scaled free, fully ad-supported applications). Inability to address technical Indian Android ecosystem realities, such as optimizing for low-RAM performance, minimizing app download sizes, and navigating data constraints. Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹3,600,000.00 per year Work Location: In person

Job description:Join us at GPN and inspire people everywhere to achieve their performance and healthy lifestyle goals! At Glanbia Performance Nutrition (GPN), our mission is to inspire people everywhere to achieve their performance and healthy lifestyle goals! We are a global leader in the performance nutrition industry and have a portfolio of nine brands including Optimum Nutrition (ON), BSN and Isopure. Our products are sold in over 130 countries and our brands are in the top three performance nutrition brands in more than 20 countries. Glanbia Performance Nutrition (GPN) is headquartered in Dublin, ROI, with operating facilities in Illinois, California, South Carolina, the UK, the Netherlands, India, Asia and Australia. GPN employs more than 1,800 people globally and has revenues of approximately $1.5B. We are a values led organisation focused on driving sustainable business performance. Join us on our journey now! Head of RGM We are seeking a Head of Revenue Growth Management for driving RGM analytics for pricing, assortment, promotion and trade, drive insights to support RGM strategy-setting for Asia, Middle East and Africa.This role will work with the Commercial functions in ad-hoc requests (e.g., new customer VC, evaluating new promotion) The opportunity where you will make an impact: Work on the AMEA Business Strategy as RGM is a key Business driver Lead revenue analytics - core pricing, assortment analytics (e.g., brand ladders, pack price curves) and promotional analytics for key accounts and across channel archetypes Analyze market trends and create associated reports for key brands and pack sizes Analyze product volume, margin and competitive prices to provide recommendations Provide fact base to assist in determining pricing guidelines on brand/pack/channel level Run analytics to measure trade spend efficiency (e.g., incremental margin or growth per dollar invested in a given account) and make recommended changes Build and update pricing & assortment guidelines Develop promo event-level guidelines and work with Sales to develop ROI-informed promotional calendars/plans Maintain promo effectiveness scorecards Monitor pricing, assortment, promotion and trade execution (e.g., create summary reports & score cards) and participate in regular reviews Monitor and provide consolidated view of competitor activities Partner with Sales & Marketing to develop customer sell-in stories when needed Db ROI annual exercise Channel wise value chain Performance marketing ROI Business case for Retailer Investments What you will bring to GPN: 10+ years experience within finance or commercial. Broad multi-channel experience preferably in established FMCG industry Strong strategic mindset with deep understanding of commercial and financial drivers Experience leading pricing, promotions, and trade investment strategies Ability to analyze complex datasets and convert insights into actionable business plans Strong leadership and influence skills to drive change across the organization, collaborate cross functionally and feed functions with market trends. Results-oriented approach focused on sustainable growth and profitability Advanced writing and communication skills, and be able to interact and persuade individuals levels senior to him or her, as well as actively participate in meetings and group discussions with individuals from other functions (e.g., Marketing, Sales, Finance) Analytical skills – ability to follow detailed instructions to perform complicated financial analyses, as well as determine basic analyses required to support pricing decisions (e.g., structure the problem, collect data, identify issues and present results) Computer skills – advanced knowledge of Excel, Tableau, and PowerPoint is required CA or MBA is an added bonus Knowledge of SAP Where and how you will workThe opportunity will be based in Gurgaon office with hybrid working arrangements available through our Smart working model which allows you a greater choice in how you work and live, giving you a better work-life balance. What we would like to offer you!The opportunity to develop your career on a global stage, continuous learning through an on-demand learning platform, and a competitive compensation package. role: Director - Customer Marketing, B2C, India, Creativity & Productivity (C&P)
normalizedText: The opportunityIn this leadership role, you’ll be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing the India marketing strategy to meet the business’ goals for the Digital route to market covering flagship products like Adobe Photoshop, Firefly and Acrobat. As an innovative marketing leader, with a deep understanding of the Indian market and a passion for driving marketing excellence in a competitive environment, you will shape the future of digital marketing in India and are pivotal to Adobe's continued growth in the Asia Pacific region.What You’ll DoSet the vision and provide strategic marketing leadership for the Creativity & Productivity (C&P) portfolio in India. Develop the marketing strategy, aligning cross-functionally to meet quarterly and annual targets including revenue, conversion, retention and ROMS. Lead content creation for full-funnel marketing campaigns, managing creative agencies. Adapt global strategies to the local market and capitalize on regional opportunities. Build effective relationships with Go-to-Market, Product Marketing Management, Comms, A.com, Corporate Marketing and other functions to ensure the India marketing strategy is aligned and delivered effectively. Set and communicate the cross-functional team’s marketing priorities, adapting and making necessary trade-offs. Mange the marketing budget, working with Corporate and regional PMM to allocate across the product portfolio and manage spend to achieve targets. Lead and develop a high-performing cross-functional team and cultivate a working environment aligned to Adobe’s values. Oversee efforts to enhance and localize the Adobe brand for the India market, ensuring cultural relevance and resonance. Influence the martech/infrastructure used internally to shape the future of Adobe and the industry. Develop strategic partnerships for the C&P business unit in India collaborating with the Corp Partnerships team. Play a key role in quarterly business and marketing reviews, defining the ‘narrative’ for India and influencing the Executive team including the India SVP and Country Manager to again agreement on strategic shifts and trade-offs. Establish meaningful regional targets to measure the effectiveness of marketing programs, gaining agreement from Corporate. Use data analytics and market insights to identify key drivers for growth and optimization. What You Need To SucceedDemonstrated track record of working in a global marketing organization as well as “matrixed” functions to deliver more than double digital growth. Excellent project management skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, with attention to detail. 20+ years of marketing leadership experience in B2C, in software or a technology related field. Deep understanding of the digital marketing (including social & influencer) and media landscape in India with a customer-first approach. Strong understanding of digital business models and demonstrated impact creating and launching initiatives to drive conversion, paid member value expansion and increase customer engagement and retention. Demonstrated success in fast-paced environments, rapidly anticipating and adapting to shifting priorities with strong project management skills. Excellent leadership skills, showing strength in motivating a team to exceed goals. Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills. Exceptional critical thinking, with the ability to translate market insights into actionable marketing strategies focused on outcomes. Outstanding communication, presentation and negotiation skills (verbal and written) in English. Fluent Hindi. Additional local languages highly desirable. Ability to engage and manage culturally diverse team members cross-functionally. Proven success in influencing executives, VP and/or “C” level. Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field. MBA is preferred. Knowledge of Adobe products desirable. About AdobeAdobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.Let’s Adobe togetherAt Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Develop strategic partnerships for the C&P business unit in India collaborating with the Corp Partnerships team. Establish meaningful regional targets to measure the effectiveness of marketing programs, gaining agreement from Corporate. Deep understanding of the digital marketing (including social & influencer) and media landscape in India with a customer-first approach. Strong understanding of digital business models and demonstrated impact creating and launching initiatives to drive conversion, paid member value expansion and increase customer engagement and retention. Demonstrated success in fast-paced environments, rapidly anticipating and adapting to shifting priorities with strong project management skills. Excellent leadership skills, showing strength in motivating a team to exceed goals. Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills. Exceptional critical thinking, with the ability to translate market insights into actionable marketing strategies focused on outcomes. Outstanding communication, presentation and negotiation skills (verbal and written) in English. Fluent Hindi. Additional local languages highly desirable. normalizedText: Associate Director- MarketingAbout Urban CompanyUrban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high-quality, standardized and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.Urban Company started out as UrbanClap in Nov 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav and Varun realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented and offline. Customers found it difficult to avail quality services in a convenient manner, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind -Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated servicesPartner empowerment: Build a deep, full-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihoodTechnology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age-old industry.What will you do?As a leader for Cleaning & Pest Control, you will be the "CEO of Demand" for our largest and most complex business cluster, covering Bathroom & Kitchen Cleaning, Full Home Deep Cleaning, and Pest Control. Your mandate is to move the needle on top-line growth while building a brand that customers trust for their most intimate home needs.Key Responsibilities 1. Consumer Insight & Empathy: Go beyond the data. Spend time with customers and service partners to understand the "why" behind the "what." Identify the triggers and barriers for professional cleaning versus the unorganized sector.2. Growth Charter & Problem Identification: Take a first-principles approach to identify why a category isn't growing faster. Is it a frequency issue? A trust deficit? You will define the 6-12 month roadmap to unlock exponential growth.3. Full-Stack Brand Marketing: Lead the creative and media strategy for the cleaning cluster. Whether it’s a massive TVC or a hyper-targeted digital "InstaHelp" campaign, you will ensure the brand remains salient and "top of mind."4. Pricing & Revenue Strategy: Own the P&L levers. You will design pricing experiments, loyalty constructs, and promotional guardrails to optimize for both market share and unit economics.Who Should Apply?● You have experience in brand/content management, growth in start ups, or top-tier consulting.● You get a kick out of building things and growing them, you aren’t afraid of ambiguity.● You are comfortable with data analytics and data visualization but can also write a compelling creative brief that inspires an agency.● First-Principles Thinker: You don't do things because "that's how it's done." You question every assumption until you find the most efficient path to growth.● Cultural Fit: You thrive in high-intensity environments, value radical candor, and have a deep sense of ownership.What Can You Expect? ● Unmatched Ownership: You are the primary driver of a multi-hundred crore business vertical.● High-Growth Environment: A seat on a rocket ship that is scaling globally.● Peer Excellence: Work alongside some of the sharpest minds from IIMs, ISB, and top global firms. ● Impact: The opportunity to build a brand that changes the lives of thousands of service professionals and millions of households. jdEvidence.value: Own and grow total subscription revenue across a portfolio of four products by building and running a unified acquisition and monetization engine.

normalizedText: In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place — one app, local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight: when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies and marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalizing. Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the knowledge, opportunities, tools, and experts they've always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:Edutainment & Skill Learning — practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)Matrimonial Matchmaking — hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)Agri Consulting — farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)Local Jobs — blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs)Social & Community — a place to find and post social updates (Lokal app)Emotional Well-being & Peer Support — safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)Astrology & Guidance — instant access to trusted astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)& many more in testing & experimental spaceUnder the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight + AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a WhatsApp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the center: access changes lives. We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.RequirementsFour of those focused apps — GyanTV, Sahi English, Poster Maker, and Matrimony — run on subscription revenue. What's missing is one owner who can see all four at once, allocate the next rupee and the next hire across them, and build the acquisition and monetization engine as a single system instead of four disconnected ones.You will own subscription revenue — the whole number, not a slice of it — across four products with four different consumers, four different LTV curves, and one shared marketing org that you build and run. This is not a "run performance marketing" role. It's a P&L seat, sitting in leadership, parallel to the product heads, not underneath them — partnering with them as an equal.What You'll OwnThe number Total subscription revenue across the four-product portfolio, tracked on revenue scale and LTV/CAC — not spend, not impressions, not a ROAS target handed down from someone else.Acquisition, end-to-endPerformance marketing across Meta, Google, and emerging channels, with an explicit mandate to cut single-platform dependenceASO and organic pull, so growth isn't 100% spend-ledInfluencer marketing and channel mix decisions across four audiences that don't look alikeHigh-volume, vernacular-first creative testing — an iteration engine, not a monthly campaign calendarCAC optimization as an ongoing discipline, not a one-time fix — jdEvidence.value: Drive success of AMD's Embedded Partner Marketing initiatives by accelerating co-marketing, partner enablement, and demand generation across the Embedded Partners ecosystem.

normalizedText: WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHINGAt AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. The RoleThe right candidate will drive the success of AMD's Embedded Partner Marketing initiatives by accelerating co-marketing, partner enablement, and demand generation across the Embedded Partners ecosystem, including ODMs (Original Design Manufacturers), IP (Intellectual Property) providers, Software, and Design Services partners. This highly collaborative role partners closely with Product Marketing, Partner Management, Field Marketing, and Sales to develop and execute integrated marketing programs that strengthen partner engagement, increase solution awareness, and generate measurable business impact.The PersonYour passion for technology marketing and partner collaboration will enable you to build strong relationships across AMD's ecosystem while delivering impactful marketing programs. You are a proactive self-starter with exceptional organizational skills who thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. You have the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling value propositions and can successfully manage multiple initiatives while driving alignment across internal teams and external partners.Key ResponsibilitiesBuild and execute joint co-marketing plans with priority partners across the AMD Embedded Partner ecosystem, aligned with AECG (Adaptive and Embedded Computing Group) business objectives and regional priorities. Drive partner enablement through the development of sales and technical enablement materials, including messaging frameworks, pitch decks, FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions), training content, and sales tools for partner sellers, FAE (Field Application Engineering) teams, and solution architects. Support solution and platform launches by developing positioning and messaging, coordinating campaign assets, managing launch calendars, driving stakeholder alignment, and ensuring launch readiness. Plan and execute integrated partner demand generation campaigns, including audience targeting, campaign offers, landing pages, email nurture programs, webinars, paid media, and lead management coordination. Lead partner events and activations, including trade shows, workshops, demonstrations, and webinars by managing timelines, logistics, speaker preparation, asset delivery, and post-event reporting. Manage marketing program operations, including project intake, cross-functional schedules, legal and brand reviews, localization requests, MDF (Market Development Funds) planning and claims where applicable, and executive reporting. Serve as the primary day-to-day marketing liaison for assigned partners by leading status meetings, tracking actions and risks, resolving issues, and ensuring effective communication across AMD and partner organizations.
