normalizedText: LocationBengaluru, Karnataka Full job description Senior Director, Product Management About GW RhythmX AI GW RhythmX platform delivers precision care intelligence natively embedded in Epic EHR, putting the right treatment recommendation in front of the right clinician at the right moment without adding to their burden. Our products reach 85M+ patients including 8M US military veterans across 150+ health systems. We are recognized by KLAS Research, Fierce Healthcare, and AVIA Marketplace. We operate with startup agility backed by $1B+ in R&D investment, longitudinal data on 300M patients, 4.4B annual claims, and a global network of 1.8M healthcare professionals across 3,000+ facilities. Our core thesis: AI should find the patient not the other way around. The Precision Care Platform is how we deliver on that thesis at scale across inpatient, outpatient, specialty, and nursing care settings, embedded in the daily workflows of every clinician who touches a patient. The Platform You Will Lead The Precision Care Platform is a clinical intelligence layer embedded in Epic EHR. It surfaces contextual, guideline-driven insights derived from our library of clinical guidelines from professional societies at the moment a clinician needs them, within the workflow they are already in. Care Settings and Product Areas Inpatient: AI-driven clinical intelligence across admission, rounds, handoffs, and discharge workflows — supporting hospitalists, attendings, and care teams in real-time inpatient decision support Outpatient: Context-aware precision care insights for ambulatory workflows — surfacing guideline gaps, care opportunities, and documentation support at the point of outpatient encounter Specialty: Role-specific intelligence for Cardiology, Gastroenterology, Endocrinology, and other specialty service lines — driven by specialty-specific guideline sets and patient data Nursing: A dedicated and emerging product layer targeting discharge readiness, shift handoff, and break handoff — built from first-principles nursing discovery and designed for the specific workflow constraints of bedside nurses Cross-setting infrastructure: EHR-native integration architecture, FHIR-based data pipelines, AI insight generation, and clinical validation frameworks that underpin every care setting The Role As Senior Director of Product Management for the Precision Care Platform, you are the product leader for India team, accountable for the quality, execution, and strategic direction of everything the India team builds. You report directly to the Global Head of Product and operate as a true partner to US-based product, engineering, clinical, and GTM leadership. This means you are not managing a feature team. You are running a product organization - setting strategy, building teams, driving execution, and maintaining the clinical and technical depth to make the right calls across a complex, multi-setting platform. The role demands two things simultaneously: the judgment of a senior strategist and the hands-on engagement of a lead PM. You will set direction and roll up your sleeves. You will own outcomes, not just workstreams. What You Will Own Platform Product Strategy Own the product vision and roadmap for the Precision Care Platform across all care settings — inpatient, outpatient, specialty, and nursing Translate enterprise customer priorities, clinical insights, and GTM requirements into a coherent, phased product strategy Define what gets built, when, and why — with the rigor to defend those decisions to engineering, clinical leads, customers, and executive leadership Ensure continuity between short-term execution and long-term platform architecture Product Execution and Delivery Drive end-to-end product delivery across multiple concurrent product streams, from discovery through clinical validation to live deployment in production EHR environments Establish delivery cadence, sprint accountability, and cross-team coordination across the India product and engineering organization Own the dependency map across Product, Engineering, Clinical, Data, and GTM — and proactively surface risks before they become blockers Hold the bar on execution quality — products that work in real clinical environments under real time pressure, not just in controlled demos Team Leadership and PM Development Build, lead, and mentor a team of Product and Program Managers working across care settings and product areas Raise the bar on product thinking, ownership culture, and execution quality across the entire India PM team Develop PM talent through direct coaching, structured feedback, and clear career pathing Create an environment where accountability, speed, and clinical empathy coexist — startup energy with professional craft Technical and AI Depth Engage directly in architecture discussions — LLM-based insight generation, RAG pipelines, HL7/FHIR data flows, and Epic EHR integration the platform serves — rounds, clinic visits, specialty consultations, nursing handoffs, discharge planning Partner with clinicians and clinical advisors, customer champions to validate product direction clearly in global forums — as a voice for execution quality, clinical insight, and technical depth Align product roadmaps with active enterprise customer commitments and GTM priorities, HealthTech Expertise Deep experience building and shipping products in US healthcare environments, with strong preference for inpatient or multi-setting clinical experience Genuine understanding of how clinicians — physicians, nurses, specialists, CDI teams — work under time pressure inside hospital and ambulatory systems Solid knowledge of EHR systems and how software integrates into live clinical workflows, with Epic experience strongly preferred Fluency with interoperability standards including HL7 v2, FHIR R4, and common healthcare integration patterns Product and Execution healthcare products from early-stage through scaled enterprise adoption Strong execution discipline — you ship, you measure, you iterate, and you hold your team to the same standard Demonstrated ability to run programs across multiple product streams simultaneously without losing context or momentum Technical Depth Ability to engage substantively with engineering and AI teams on system design, architecture tradeoffs, and technical constraints Understanding of LLM-based product development — prompt design, RAG architecture, hallucination mitigation, clinical validation approaches Comfortable working with clinical data models, FHIR resources, and the integration patterns that connect AI systems to EHR workflows Familiarity with modern cloud infrastructure and the operational normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationPune, Maharashtra Full job description Do you enjoy turning insights and ambition into strategies that keep a business focused on what truly matters to customers? We’re now looking for two Marketing Strategy & Transformation Leads to help shape how Seco builds relevance and drives long‑term growth – one in Europe and one in the Asia-Pacific region. Your new team You’ll be part of our Marketing Strategy and Customer Insights team, a collaborative group that turns insights into strategic impact. We work across the organization to shape bold, data‑driven direction, strengthen our brand, and support marketing excellence. Our focus is to bring clarity, alignment, and practical tools that help teams create consistent, meaningful experiences for customers and the business. About the job Your role is to translate customer understanding, future signals, and business priorities into clear marketing strategies. You set up structures that help teams prioritize, make decisions faster, and stay aligned. You shape frameworks, define strategic choices and make sure insights play a natural part in how plans are developed and executed. Part of the work is transformational. You support improved operating models, develop new ways of working, and help the organization adopt strategy in a consistent, scalable way. You also turn strategic direction into compelling narratives that make sense to leaders and teams across the organization. Here are some of the areas you work with: Developing and refining marketing strategy frameworks and prioritization models. Turning strategic ambition into roadmaps, operating models, and ways of working. Facilitating cross‑functional alignment between BMC, Sales, Product, Digital, and other teams. Integrating insights and foresights into strategic decision‑making. Creating strategic narratives, communication material, and engagement plans. Preparing analyses, scenarios, and recommendations for senior leaders. Defining success metrics, objectives, and measurement structures. Supporting alignment across markets to ensure coherent brand and communication execution. Coaching colleagues and contributing to capability building within the strategy function. Location and reporting The location for this role is flexible within either Europe or the APAC region. You report to the Director of Marketing Strategy and Customer Insights. Your profile A background in strategic planning, marketing strategy, or a similar area gives you the foundation to connect insights, business objectives, and customer value. Your analytical skills are strong, and you’re comfortable interpreting data, structuring complex information and documenting strategy with precision. A proactive mindset, clear written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work both independently and in cross‑functional setups are essential. Collaboration comes naturally, and you build trust across functions through diplomacy, clarity, and steady communication. You’re able to translate big‑picture thinking into practical direction that teams can follow, and you enjoy working in a setting where structure, adaptability and continuous improvement go hand in hand. Our Seco culture At Seco, we're united by a spirit of collaboration and a shared curiosity to learn and grow. We take responsibility for our actions, stay focused on our customers, and believe in winning together. For us, it’s also clear that our diversities form an amazing foundation for achieving great results. How to apply Send us your application no later than July 26, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English.

normalizedText: OverviewThe Director of Marketing Operations & Digital is a strategic and operational leader responsible for transforming Marketing into a disciplined, data-driven growth engine. Reporting directly to the CMO, this role will architect and scale the systems, processes, analytics, and digital experiences that power demand generation, revenue acceleration, and measurable enterprise value creation.This leader will combine operational rigor with digital innovation, building the infrastructure that enables marketing and sales alignment, pipeline visibility, performance accountability, and modern buyer engagement.Critically, this role will also lead the CBTS AI-first marketing transformation. As BCG research confirms, 96% of CMOs believe AI is driving end-to-end transformation of their function but only about a third have moved beyond the basics. This leader will put CBTS in that top tier: designing, deploying, and scaling AI agents and autonomous workflows that transform marketing from a cost center into a strategic growth engine. This is not a role for someone who uses AI tools. It's for someone who builds with them and who understands that the larger opportunity is not efficiency, it's growth.AI-First Leadership & Marketing Agent DevelopmentThis is a differentiating priority. As AI agents increasingly mediate how buyers discover, evaluate, and choose technology partners, CBTS needs a leader who can build for both human and machine audiences and who can turn AI-generated customer intelligence into enterprise strategy.Lead the design, build, and deployment of AI agents across marketing functions including intake and routing, MDF automation, spend reconciliation, event management, content operations, and lead management.Serve as the internal CBTS AI subject matter expert and evangelist for marketing: driving adoption, capability building, and governance across the Marketing Team.Build a new class of market intelligence capability using agentic AI signals: track customer intent, goals, and decision context beyond traditional keyword and click data, and translate those signals into enterprise strategy.Monitor how AI platforms compare, rank, and recommend CBTS offerings. Work cross-functionally to ensure brand promise and operational performance remain aligned (AI agents now evaluate gaps between what brands claim and what they deliver at scale).Partner with the CMO on AI strategy, executive storytelling, and CBTS's AI-first marketing operating model as a board- and client-facing narrative.Identify, pilot, and scale agentic use cases; document and systematize what works for the broader team.Stay ahead of the curve on emerging marketing AI capabilities from autonomous agents and LLMs to intent intelligence and predictive analytics.Marketing Operations & Revenue InfrastructureOwn the marketing tech stack strategy, architecture, and optimization — CRM, marketing automation, intent data, ABM platforms, and analytics tools.Drive end-to-end lead lifecycle management, ensuring clear SLAs, routing accuracy, and pipeline transparency; lead CBTS's transition from MQL to MQA (Marketing Qualified Account) model.Establish marketing performance measurement frameworks tied to pipeline, revenue, and ROI — including a brand-to-revenue causal chain and emerging agent-mediated influence metrics (share of AI mentions, citation rates, recommendation rates).Partner with Sales Operations and Growth Marketing to align on reporting, forecasting, attribution, and funnel analytics.Build scalable processes that support growth, M&A integration, and cross-functional alignment.Manage marketing budget tracking, performance reporting, and investment optimization — delivering real-time spend visibility and exec-ready financial reporting.Digital Strategy & ExperienceAs BCG research shows, 43% of B2B journeys are now research-led across an average of 15+ touchpoints and 85% of buyers who use AI tools rank them among their top five most influential research sources. The CBTS digital presence must be built for both human attention and machine evaluation.Lead website strategy, optimization, and performance — ensuring CBTS.com and OnX.com digital properties function as conversion engines aligned to ICP and priority industries, and are structured for AI discoverability and credibility.Own HubSpot CMS migration and ongoing web governance, including the P1–P4 edit prioritization framework and agency/vendor relationships.Drive digital demand generation across paid media, SEO/SEM/AEO, retargeting, and account-based strategies including emerging Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) as AI-mediated search reshapes discovery.Optimize user journey, conversion paths, and content engagement through data and experimentation.Oversee marketing analytics dashboards and executive reporting across GA4, HubSpot, Salesforce, 6Sense, SEMrush, and Meltwater.Implement testing frameworks (A/B, multivariate) to continuously improve digital performance.Email Marketing & Lead ManagementOwn end-to-end email marketing execution: strategy, segmentation, automation, deliverability, and performance.Manage the campaign calendar, nurture flows, and executive communications cadence; drive KPIs including open rate, CTR, unsubscribe rate, and pipeline influence.Own the lead lifecycle from capture through handoff — forms, scoring, routing, and SLA management in HubSpot and Salesforce.Partner with Sales to optimize lead quality, follow-up velocity, and conversion rates.Data, Insights & Performance ManagementDevelop KPI frameworks and automated reporting dashboard aligned to business growth objectives, including Tier 1 metrics (share of search, branded traffic, 6Sense intent velocity, HubSpot MQA mix, Salesforce win rate by lead source) and emerging agent-mediated influence indicators.Deliver executive-level reporting and insights to the CMO and leadership team; build toward board-level marketing visibility.Reinvent intelligence-to-action workflows: use AI to democratize access to customer intelligence and connect decision makers across CBTS to a shared view of buyer intent — informing not just how CBTS goes to market, but what it brings to market.Automate and improve Salesforce accuracy, lead flow, and intent data analysis to drive revenue growth in partnership with Revenue Operations.Ensure data hygiene, governance, and compliance (GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and applicable data regulations).Team LeadershipLead a high-performing marketing operations and digital team including agency partnerships; build the AI capability of the function from within.Foster a culture of accountability, precision, experimentation, and continuous improvement.Serve as a strategic thought partner to the CMO and cross-functional leaders including Sales, Finance, and IT, with the credibility and data fluency to influence decisions at the executive level.Platform ExpertiseHubSpot — CRM, CMS, email, automation, and reporting (deep expertise required)Salesforce — pipeline reporting, lead routing, campaign attribution, and Sales alignment6Sense — intent data, account scoring, campaign orchestration, and ABM activationGoogle Analytics 4 (GA4) & Google Search Console — web analytics and SEO/AEO performanceSEMrush — share of search, competitive intel, keyword and AI visibility trackingClaude / Anthropic API — AI agent development and workflow automationQualifications15+ years of progressive experience in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or Digital Marketing leadership.Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, or managing AI tools, marketing automation agents, or intelligent workflow systems, not just using them.Proven experience managing marketing technology ecosystems (Salesforce, HubSpot, 6Sense, and related platforms).Strong analytical and financial acumen with demonstrated impact on pipeline and revenue growth.Experience aligning marketing and sales through shared metrics, operating rhythms, and data infrastructure.Familiarity with or curiosity about agentic AI's impact on B2B buyer journeys, brand discoverability, and marketing operating models.Executive presence with the ability to translate complex data into strategic insights and board-level narrative.Experience in B2B technology or managed services environments strongly preferred. normalizedText: JOB DESCRIPTION This is a senior leadership role for someone who has spent the better part of their career at the intersection of CPG business strategy and technology, and is now ready to build, own, and grow a practice.The CPG Practice Director will be responsible for defining Zensar's point of view in the Consumer Packaged Goods space, growing the revenue pipeline, and ensuring that what we deliver to clients reflects genuine domain expertise. This is not a delivery management role. It is an ownership role. The person in this seat will shape Zensar's CPG narrative externally, build the internal capability to back it up, to turn domain credibility into commercial outcomes.You will report into the Global Head of Industry Solutions Group, MCSWhat You Will OwnAI-Native Innovation Define and drive Zensar's AI-first agenda for CPG across Revenue Growth Management, Trade Promotion, Supply Chain, and Consumer Insights Identify where AI and GenAI create tangible business value for CPG clients and build that into our service offerings, not as a layer on top, but as the design principle Partner with Engineering and Data and Analytics practices to co-develop solutions that are commercially viable and domain-authentic Stay ahead of how CPG companies are adopting AI at scale and translate that into Zensar propositions before clients ask for them Revenue Pipeline: Growth and Influence Own and grow a defined revenue pipeline in collaboration with the Consulting Growth Office and account delivery teams Lead or influence pursuit strategy for CPG accounts, from shaping the conversation early to closing Bring a point of view into client conversations before an RFX exists, identify where the problem is, frame the opportunity, and position Zensar as the right partner Build and maintain relationships with economic buyers, CFOs, CCOs, CPOs, not just program sponsors Own new logo conversion end-to-end, meaning personally leading solutioning, building the commercial narrative, and closing, not directing a pursuit team from the sidelines Develop and own domain centric solution constructs for CPG pursuits, RFXs, SOW framing, pricing rationale, and delivery approach, with direct hands-on involvement, not delegation Work across Zensar's service lines, Data and Engineering, Experience Services, Digital Marketing, to assemble the right solution for each pursuit and ensure the CPG domain lens runs through the full proposal Client Excellence Set the standard for how Zensar shows up with CPG clients, in the quality of thinking, the relevance of recommendations, and the credibility of the team we put in the room Actively participate in key client engagements at a strategic level, not to manage delivery, but to ensure the client relationship grows beyond the current SOW Own client satisfaction and advocacy at a practice level. NPS, repeat business, and reference-ability are outcomes this role is accountable for Domain-Centric Delivery Aligned to SOW Commitments Ensure that IT delivery teams across CPG engagements are operating with domain context, not just technical competence Work with Delivery Heads to resolve situations where execution is drifting from the strategic intent of the engagement Review SOW commitments on key accounts and ensure the practice is delivering to the outcome, not just the activity Serve as the senior escalation point for clients when delivery conversations need strategic re-alignment Capability Building Build a CPG consulting team that can hold its own against Big 4 and specialist boutiques Define the capability profile Zensar needs, by role, by seniority, and by domain specialisation Own the learning agenda for the CPG practice, structured programs, client exposure, and knowledge assets that make the team sharper over time Identify, hire, and develop the next layer of domain leaders within the practice based on visibility of the confirmed revenue pipeline. Thought Leadership and Analyst Relations Represent Zensar's CPG point of view externally, at industry forums, analyst briefings, and client events Build relationships with ISG, Everest Group, Avasant, Gartner, Forrester, and relevant CPG-focused analyst communities Publish, speak, and create content that positions Zensar as a credible voice in CPG transformation, not generic technology content, but opinionated, practitioner-grade thinking Develop a consistent drumbeat of thought leadership that supports both brand and pipeline Industry Relationships Maintain and deepen relationships with senior leaders across Tier-1 CPG companies, built over a career, not from a CRM Represent Zensar at CPG industry associations, councils, and executive networks Bring external perspective into Zensar, what clients are prioritising, where the market is moving, and what competitors are doing, and use that to sharpen our positioning GTM Partnerships Identify, establish, and nurture GTM relationships with relevant technology and platform partners, TPM/RGM platforms, data and AI vendors, cloud providers Shape co-sell and co-delivery models with partners that expand Zensar's reach and credibility in CPG accounts Work with the Consulting, Delivery, Services Lines and Growth Office teams to formalise partner relationships into structured GTM motions with clear pipeline accountability ExperienceWhat We Are Looking For 18+ years of experience with a significant portion in CPG, either on the consulting - SDLC Implementation on either client side, or both Proven track record working with Tier-1 CPG companies, the kind where you have been in the room with the business, not just the IT team Has carried P&L or revenue responsibility, knows what it means to own a number, not just a project Has led large, complex IT programs and more importantly, has shaped the strategy that the program was built to deliver Multi-market experience, has operated across geographies, not just one region Domain Knowledge Deep expertise in Revenue Growth Management, Trade Promotion Management, and Commercial Excellence Strong understanding of CPG value chain, from demand planning and supply chain through to trade execution and consumer engagement Familiarity with the AI and data landscape relevant to CPG and a credible point of view on where it is going Working knowledge of relevant platforms, Xtel, Salesforce CG Cloud, SAP, o9, or equivalent Educational Qualifications (Good To Have) MBA or Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management from a reputed institution, preferably with a focus on Marketing, Strategy, or Operations B.Tech or equivalent undergraduate degree in Engineering or a related discipline Candidates with equivalent experience and demonstrated impact in lieu of formal qualifications will be considered Leadership Profile Has built teams and developed talent, not just managed headcount Operates with executive presence, comfortable in board-level conversations without a script Thinks commercially, connects domain expertise to revenue outcomes naturally Brings an independent point of view, not someone who waits for the brief before forming an opinion The Way You Will Need to WorkA few things that are important to be explicit about: This role starts without a team. You will not have a bench to delegate to. The expectation is that you are personally productive from day one, writing proposals, leading client conversations, shaping solutions, and developing content. The ability to build a team comes after you have demonstrated what the practice can do. You will need to travel, regularly and globally. Client relationships in CPG are built in person. This role requires presence across geographies, sometimes with short notice, and a willingness to be where the client is. You need to be hands-on. This is not a role for someone who reviews other people's work. You will be in the room, on the whiteboard, writing the narrative, and closing the deal in association with the Sales, and Service Line teams. You will work across service lines. Data and Engineering, AI, Digital, and Managed Services are your partners, not your support structure. The ability to collaborate horizontally across Zensar and bring the right capability together for a client is core to how this role operates. What This Role Is NotThis role is not for someone who is looking for a senior delivery or program management position with a domain label attached. It is not for someone who needs a team around them to be effective. It is for someone who has already made the shift from execution to strategy, has the relationships and credibility to influence CPG C-suites, and is ready to build something, starting with their own hands. normalizedText: Job DescriptionDirector - Digital Content and Customer Experience, Digital Human Health (DHH)This role sits within the Digital Content and Customer Experience vertical of Digital Human Health (DHH), India Hub. The Director, Digital Content & Customer Experience (DCCE), is a senior leader responsible for shaping and executing an omnichannel content strategy and delivering human-centric customer experiences across the Human Health division. This role bridges complex scientific and medical information with modern digital experiences for healthcare professionals (HCPs), patients, and caregivers. The Director oversees the end-to-end content lifecycle—from ideation and modular content design through Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review, approval, activation, personalization, and measurement. The role drives compliance-by-design content operations, enables scalable content innovation, and optimizes digital channel performance. The Director leads a cross-functional team and partners closely with the Customer Engagement, Innovation, and Technology teams to deliver measurable impact.Role OverviewThe Director of Content and Customer Experience drives the digital transformation of content development and customer engagement across the global enterprise. Positioned at the intersection of commercial strategy, technology, and science, this leader modernizes how our company communicates with healthcare professionals, patients, and payors. The mandate is to transition the organization from product-centric marketing to a seamless, data-driven, omnichannel ecosystem that delivers personalized, high-value experiences at every touchpoint. Operating within a highly regulated environment, the Director oversees the global content supply chain, deploying advanced MarTech and modular content frameworks to scale compliant messaging efficiently. This executive bridges institutional silos, uniting Brand Marketing, Medical Affairs, IT, and Legal/Regulatory teams while leveraging advanced analytics to optimize user experiences. Ultimately, this role is responsible for building a high-performing team and scaling a digital infrastructure that deepens stakeholder trust, enhances content and customer experience journeys, and supports optimal patient outcomes. This role will be part of DHH DCCE Leadership Team.Key Responsibilities Define and lead the content ecosystem strategy across therapeutic areas, aligned to global brand vision and customer needs across markets and channels. Establish a scalable content operating model to deliver compliant, high-quality digital and hybrid assets (e.g., interactive visual aids, websites/landing pages, email journeys, patient education modules, videos, banners, and field-enabled content). Drive modular content transformation by designing content as reusable components (modules/blocks) that enable rapid assembly, repurposing, localization, and channel-specific optimization. Advance content innovation by partnering with stakeholders to modernize formats (interactive, dynamic, and accessible experiences) and strengthen scientific storytelling through digital-first approaches. Own content performance management by defining content KPIs, testing and learning agendas, and improvement loops based on engagement and behavioral insights. Enable global-to-local execution by creating standards, playbooks, and governance that support market adaptation while protecting brand consistency and scientific accuracy.Lead customer journey strategy and orchestration by mapping and optimizing end-to-end experiences for HCPs and patients across digital and physical touchpoints.Translate insights into experience design in partnership with Advanced Analytics/Business Insights—using behavioral, preference, and channel performance data to inform best-next content, best timing, and next-best actions.Champion human-centered design by embedding UX research, accessibility considerations, and usability testing into content and experience development.Improve omnichannel consistency by aligning content, channel roles, and messaging across field, web, email, paid media, and virtual engagement.Optimize marketing technology enablement (MarTech) by maximizing platform capabilities, improving segmentation and targeting approaches, and enabling scalable personalization within compliance guardrails.Embed compliance-by-design across content creation and activation, ensuring adherence to all applicable standards and regulations (e.g., promotional/non-promotional requirements, privacy, and data use policies).Lead and streamline MLR (Medical/Legal/Regulatory) collaboration by developing clear workflows, improving cycle times, and enabling agile approvals without compromising quality or risk controls.Oversee agency and vendor partnerships (creative, digital, medical writing, production, localization, analytics) with accountability for quality, timelines, and cost effectiveness.Strengthen content operations excellence by implementing standards, templates, taxonomies/metadata, digital asset management practices, and documentation to improve reuse and findability.Build and develop a high-performing team of content strategists, UX/UI designers, channel specialists, and digital product owners; provide coaching, feedback, and growth opportunities.Influence cross-functionally in a matrix environment by aligning priorities, resolving trade-offs, and ensuring execution against business outcomes.Education RequirementsBachelor’s or Masters degree in Marketing, Communications, Life Sciences, or a related field (or equivalent experience)Required Experience And SkillsMinimum of 10+ years directing digital marketing, content strategy, content development and deployment, or customer experience initiatives, with at least 5 years of leadership experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare sector. Regulatory Expertise Deep understanding of FDA guidelines, PhRMA code, DDMAC, and international regulations governing pharmaceutical advertising and compliance. Mar Tech Architecture Proven track record managing enterprise-level marketing technology stacks, specifically Veeva (PromoMats, CRM), Adobe Experience Cloud, and Salesforce. Data & Analytics Demonstrated ability to leverage advanced data analytics, A/B testing, and metrics (such as NPS) to measure engagement and optimize the omnichannel user experience. Stakeholder Leadership Exceptional cross-functional leadership skills, with a history of successfully navigating complex Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review processes and managing substantial agency budgets. AI strategy and responsible use Articulate how content development and customer experience will adopt agentic AI and GenAI for development, integration, review, analytics, insight generation, and book-of-work execution. Maintain awareness of the opportunities, limitations, and responsible use of AI in a regulated environment.Required SkillsA/B Testing, Adobe Experience Cloud, Biological Sciences, Biopharmaceutical Industry, Client Counseling, Customer Engagement, Digital Healthcare, Digital Marketing, Digital Transformation, Emerging Technologies, Human-Centered Design, Life Science, Medical Affairs, Medical Writing, Operational Acceptance Testing (OAT), Product Management, Requirements Management, Solution Architecture, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Technical Advice, User Experience (UX) Design, Waterfall ModelPreferred SkillsCurrent Employees apply HERECurrent Contingent Workers apply HERESearch Firm Representatives Please Read Carefully Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, NJ, USA, also known as Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC, Rahway, NJ, USA, does not accept unsolicited assistance from search firms for employment opportunities. All CVs / resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at our company without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of our company. No fee will be paid in the event a candidate is hired by our company as a result of an agency referral where no pre-existing agreement is in place. Where agency agreements are in place, introductions are position specific. Please, no phone calls or emails.Employee Status RegularRelocation VISA Sponsorship Travel RequirementsFlexible Work Arrangements HybridShift Valid Driving License Hazardous Material(s) Job Posting End Date 07/31/2026A job posting is effective until 11 59 59PM on the day BEFORE the listed job posting end date. The Founder's Office at INDmoney is a small, high-intensity team that works directly with the Founder and Chief of Staff to identify, design, and execute the company's most critical strategic focus areas - across growth, new business lines, operational scale, market expansion & improving talent density. If you have ever wanted to build something from scratch, own a problem end-to-end, and see your decisions translate into outcomes within weeks rather than quarters - this is that opportunity.Founders Office roles at INDmoney have gone on to lead business units, head new verticals, and start new ventures. This is a stepping stone - one that compresses years of learning into months.Role : You will own high-stakes clear problem statements - new product lines, new markets, operational bottlenecks, scaled processes, competitive strategies, organisation design.Work alongside the Founder and Chief of Staff defining various solutions through to execution - you are not preparing decks for someone else to act on.Move fast across multiple simultaneous workstreams without losing rigour on any of them.Ability to interface with external stakeholders - partners, investors, regulators, vendors — and drive outcomesYou are a strong fit if:You have a clear entrepreneurial ambition — you want to eventually run something of your own or lead a business unit, and you recognise that this role is how you compress that learning curveYou solve problems by going to the data first — you are not comfortable with a hypothesis you cannot test or a claim you cannot quantifyYou operate well in ambiguity — you do not need a fully defined brief to start; you define the brief yourselfYou have a bias for action that borders on impatience — you find it uncomfortable when a good idea sits stillYou can influence people who do not report to you and bring stakeholders along without needing formal authorityWhat we are looking for3–6 years of experience in fintech, consumer tech, investment products, or management consultingDemonstrated ability to own a problem end-to-end — not just analyse itStrong familiarity with financial services, investments, or capital markets — either professionally or as a serious personal practitionerSharp quantitative and analytical skills — you are comfortable building models, interrogating data, and defending your numbersExceptional project management instincts — you can run five things in parallel and know which one needs your attention right nowEducation: Engineering degree or MBA from a top-tier institution. What matters more than the institution is what you have done since. Purpose of the JobWe are recruiting an experienced Managing Director (MD) in India to develop and lead a high performing team to support the growth of both domestic and international clients.The Managing Director is accountable for working with the Group Management Board to shape and deliver the country’s growth agenda, ensuring the operation, talent, and leadership capability are fit for the future needs of the market and our clients.The successful candidate will have a deep knowledge of the local market, outstanding client engagement skills, and the ability to identify, attract and lead high performing talent. Head Working Time: 9.30 am to 6.00 pm, alternate Saturday off Job description MAN Group is a prominent player, with its flagship company MAN Industries (India) Limited, a prominent player in the league of World Class Manufacturers and Exporters of large diameter HSAW, LSAW, Line pipes and Coating systems besides ERW and SS Pipes. The Group Turnover is about Rs.3000 Cr., and is well poised to double the same with the expansion of existing capacities and addition of new ERW Plant. Roles and Responsibilities We are strengthening our Business Development and Marketing Team at Senior level in Mumbai. The Jobholder should have extensive Experience of Business Development / Marketing of similar Products in the Indian / International Market. Our clients are Oil & Gas Companies, Water Pipeline Utilities, spread World over besides Public Sector Units in India. normalizedText: LocationMumbai, India Reporting to: Director of Marketing Type: Full‑time, in‑office–first with flexibilityRole summaryAs Digital Growth Marketing Lead, you will be the IC owner for Neysa’s digital growth engine, from discoverability and journeys to measurement and optimization.This is not a “channels and dashboards” role. Your real work is to understand how our ICP buys, then design and run digital journeys that move them from “AI curious” to “Neysa‑serious” to “profitable customer”, across search, social, website, CRM, agents and product surfaces.The role reports into the Director of Marketing and is the natural succession path to Head of Digital Growth as we scale. You’ll orchestrate agencies, AI tools and systems rather than build a large in‑house team.What you will own1. Digital growth strategy and journeysDefine how digital contributes to Neysa’s revenue engine: who we target, how they find us, and what journeys they should experience from awareness to serious evaluation.Translate market and user insight into clear ICP definitions (enterprises with in‑house data science, AI‑first SaaS, global AI providers with India traffic) and segment‑specific paths.Decide where not to play, channels, geos and motions that are noise at our stage and focus resources on the highest‑leverage bets.2. Systems, stack and measurementStitch together Neysa’s marketing stack, website hub, HubSpot (migration from Zoho), HighPerformr and other tools, into flexible, experiment‑friendly flows, not rigid campaigns.Design journey logic for discovery, education, evaluation and expansion for both net‑new and existing customers, including clear criteria for who goes to Sales vs Community.Build measurement that actually serves decisions: discoverability, depth of engagement, ICP fit and profitable revenue, rather than vanity MQL or CAC dashboards.3. Demand, discovery and trustImprove discoverability of Neysa and our problem space with minimal spend via SEO, AI search optimization, content hubs and pinpointed SEM.Plan and run focused experiments across Google Ads, LinkedIn and niche surfaces like Substack, Reddit and Medium, then double down based on efficiency and strategic fit.Co‑create trust‑building assets with Product Marketing: explainers, benchmarks, blueprints and selection frameworks that de‑risk decisions for AI/ML teams and CXOs.4. Community‑first motionsPartner with the Community, Social and Content Marketing team to make digital both a funnel into and out of India’s AI builder community: events, AMAs, hackathons, AI Community Hub, social channels and learning programs.Use digital signals to identify and nurture early adopters, AI practitioners and enterprise champions who become advocates, referrers and speakers.Help design HubSpot‑like inbound mechanics that fit our world: utilities, frameworks and templates that make Neysa the default reference for “how to build AI in India the right way”.5. GTM partnership and internal influenceJoin key customer conversations with Sales to hear unfiltered user insight, shape narratives and test messaging in the wild.Work with Product Marketing on positioning and with Field/Events Marketing to ensure digital amplifies offline plays before, during and after events.Feed back market and user insight into product, service and GTM decisions so we stay ahead of hyperscalers and proxy competitors.How we’ll measure successYou will not be measured on lead volume alone. What matters:Discoverability: how easily the right ICPs find and recognize Neysa with minimal spend.Trust and intent: repeat engagement, depth of content consumption, progression into high‑quality conversations.Pipeline quality: share of inbound that fits Neysa’s ICP and unit economics, not just deal count.Efficient growth: pipeline‑to‑spend and revenue‑to‑spend efficiency in line with our gross margin and IRR focus. System strength: robustness and adaptability of journeys and martech to support new motions without constant re‑wiring.What you bringMust‑haves6–10 years in B2B digital growth / performance / demand gen roles, ideally across SaaS, cloud or infra‑adjacent products.Evidence that you have learned a complex new domain from scratch and turned that insight into digital journeys and revenue outcomes.Deep, hands‑on experience across SEO, SEM, paid social, website CRO, marketing automation and basic attribution.Strong experimentation muscle: you know how to set up tests, read noisy signals and call when to scale, persist or kill. Experience orchestrating agencies and partners and a bias for using AI and automation to replace “hands and legs” work.High comfort with ambiguity and fast‑moving markets; you can think from first principles without waiting for perfect data.Clear, concise communication; comfortable in customer meetings and with senior leadership.Good‑to‑havesExposure to AI / ML, cloud infra, GPU/compute, or developer‑facing products.Experience using or building technical communities as a growth channel.Prior stint as a senior IC with influence (dotted‑line leadership, mentoring, or informal team lead) with ambition to own a function in 12–24 months.How we workBrains in, hands and legs out: We hire for thinking, orchestration and ownership, then use agencies and AI for execution scale.Lean, senior‑heavy team: Even at large ARR, we expect Marketing to stay small, sharp and close to the problem.Mumbai‑first, flexible in practice: We want core GTM talent in Mumbai to shorten learning curves and keep feedback loops tight.Why this role mattersIf we get digital growth right, Neysa becomes the default choice for serious AI builders in India, the way AWS and HubSpot became default in their categories.This role is the IC nucleus of that engine today, with a clear path to Head of Digital Growth as we scale GTM, community and product. normalizedText: LocationChennai, Tamil Nadu Full job description About Our Client: A fast-growing tech startup headquartered in Chennai, our client designs innovative solutions at the crossroads of AI, automation, and enterprise productivity. They are on a mission to empower modern businesses by weaving intelligent systems into scalable engineering. Responsibilities: Lead the Technology Vision: Define and drive the long-term technology roadmap with a focus on innovation, scalability, and measurable business impact. Leverage AI/ML Across the Stack: Identify and implement strategic AI/ML opportunitiesfrom automating complex workflows to enhancing content and enabling data-driven decision-making. Build a World-Class Engineering Team: Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing engineering organization, with a strong culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning. Develop Future Leaders: Support the growth of engineering managers, fostering leadership skills and maintaining a strong internal talent pipeline. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Design, Customer Success, and Business teams to ensure aligned priorities, shared goals, and seamless execution. Deliver with Excellence: Oversee the timely, high-quality delivery of projects and products, ensuring strong technical standards and operational reliability. Optimize Technology Investments: Manage engineering budgets, vendor relationships, and cloud infrastructure to balance performance, cost, and agility. Desired Profile: 15 + years of experience in engineering roles, including 5+ years in engineering leadership positions. Proven track record in leading cross-functional agile teams, delivering B2B SaaS products. Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, modern development ecosystems, and infrastructure-as-code. Demonstrated success in evaluating, implementing, or integrating AI/ML capabilities in product or service environments. Strong grasp of product thinking, ability to co-own outcomes with product management.

Non-negotiable for this role.Strong understanding of B2B marketing strategies and lead generation techniques.Experience in leveraging data analytics to inform marketing strategies and measure performance. ROI-focused with a strong grasp of metrics and performance tracking.Tech-savvy and genuinely comfortable with new-age tools: AI writing tools (Claude, ChatGPT), digital content platforms, analytics dashboards, CMS, and marketing automation. normalizedText: Purpose:The Marketing Technology Technical Lead (aka Global Lead Engineer) is responsible for defining, governing, and evolving the organization's Marketing Technology (MarTech) architecture and technical ecosystem, ensuring scalability, security, operational excellence, and alignment with business objectives across multiple markets.The role serves as the technical authority for Adobe Campaign Classic, Google Marketing Platform, and related marketing and customer engagement technologies within Mashreq Retail Banking Group; and provides architectural leadership across customer data, campaign orchestration, analytics, integrations, and activation capabilities. Working closely with Marketing, Data, Analytics, Technology, Security, Compliance, and external partners.The Marketing Technology Technical Lead translates business requirements into scalable technical solutions, establishes engineering standards and governance, and leads the successful delivery of MarTech initiatives. The role combines strategic architecture ownership with hands-on technical expertise, including solution design, integration oversight, code review, troubleshooting, and development support where required.The position is accountable for ensuring that the MarTech landscape remains future-ready, globally scalable, operationally resilient, and capable of supporting the organization's customer engagement, personalization, and digital transformation ambitions.Key Result Areas:1. MarTech Architecture & Technology Strategy: Establish and maintain a scalable, secure, and future-proof MarTech architecture aligned with business and customer engagement objectives.Key Responsibilities:- Define and maintain the MarTech target architecture, technology roadmap, and integration strategy.- Drive architecture decisions, platform evolution, and technical standards across the MarTech ecosystem.- Evaluate emerging technologies, platform capabilities, and build-vs.-buy options.- Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, and data governance standards.- Develop reference architectures, solution blueprints, and architectural best practices.1. normalizedText: About The TeamDoorDash's Customer Experience & Integrity (CXI) team owns the customer support experience for one of the largest last-mile logistics platforms in the world. Within CXI, the Partner Success team manages our global network of BPO partners — 10K+ agents across 20+ sites and 7 vendors — and is accountable for the day-to-day quality, productivity, and reliability of the support those teams deliver to our customers and Dashers.About The RoleDoorDash is looking for a Senior Manager, Customer Experience Partner Success to be the DoorDash owner of multiple BPO partners, including our largest and most complex accounts (multiple sites, 4K+ agents). You will be the single point of accountability for those partners' performance against our full Customer Experience matrix, and you will shape the strategy and operating model.This is a role for someone who has run a partner portfolio before. You will report to DoorDash's Director, Partner Success. We are open to remote candidates.You're excited about this opportunity because you will…Own the relationship for multiple BPO partners, including our largest and most complex accounts, against DoorDash's full Customer Experience performance matrix.Design and own the performance-management strategy and operating model for your portfolio end-to-end, producing the Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews that roll into cross-functional leadership reviews.Independently structure and lead end-to-end strategy for complex, ambiguous performance challenges — proactively diagnosing existing and net-new issues, designing the remediation, and driving execution with minimal guidance.Partner with Training, Quality, and Content teams to design and reinforce compliance strategy for new launches, processes, and policies across your partners' floors.Lead cross-functional initiatives with Training, Workforce Management, Product, and Engineering, among others, to unblock partner performance and influence functional strategy beyond your own portfolio.Mentor and develop Managers across the Partner Success team, sharing playbooks and raising the bar on how we manage partner performance.This role requires up to 35% travel (international and domestic).We're excited about you because…You have a full-time degree from an IIT or IIM.You have 8+ years of operations experience, including experience managing a large, complex partner or vendor portfolio.You are comfortable in a fast-paced, constantly changing, team-oriented environment and able to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.You have an owner mentality — focused on quality, output-driven, proactive, and always pushing yourself and others to do better.You are analytical and data-driven, with the ability to distill large, ambiguous data sets into actionable insights and strategy — root-cause analysis is your specialty.You know how to present complex information clearly and concisely, with strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills that hold up to a senior leadership and cross-functional audience.You are well-organized and detail-oriented, with impeccable follow-up and follow-through.You have a track record of mentoring or informally leading other managers, and you're seen as the person peers turn to for guidance on the toughest partner performance problems.About DoorDashAt DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.Our Commitment to Diversity and InclusionWe're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in certain locations.The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Job Description Job Title: Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Social Justice & Empowerment Location: Mulund, Mumbai Employment Type: Full-Time Salary: Up to ₹1,50,000 per month (Based on experience) Experience Required: 12–15+ years in NGO/Development Sector, Social Justice, Community Development, or related fields About the Role We are seeking an experienced, visionary, and impact-driven Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Social Justice & Empowerment to lead and strengthen our programs focused on social justice, inclusion, community empowerment, disability inclusion, women empowerment, education, livelihood, and sustainable development. The COO will oversee day-to-day operations, drive strategic growth, manage cross-functional teams, build partnerships, and lead fundraising initiatives to ensure the long-term sustainability and impact of the organization. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership Develop and execute organizational strategies aligned with the vision and mission. Drive operational excellence across all social impact programs. Identify opportunities for expansion, innovation, and long-term sustainability. Support the leadership team in policy development and organizational planning. Program & Operations Management Lead the planning, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of all social justice and empowerment initiatives. Ensure timely execution of projects with measurable impact. Develop operational systems, SOPs, and quality standards. Monitor program budgets, timelines, and performance indicators. Fundraising & Resource Mobilization Develop and execute fundraising strategies to support organizational growth. Build and maintain relationships with CSR partners, corporate donors, foundations, HNIs, trusts, and philanthropic organizations. Identify and pursue grant opportunities from national and international funding agencies. Prepare compelling proposals, concept notes, presentations, and donor reports. Lead fundraising campaigns, donor engagement initiatives, and strategic partnerships. Ensure compliance with donor requirements and funding guidelines. CSR & Partnership Development Develop strategic partnerships with corporates, government agencies, NGOs, academic institutions, and international organizations. Represent the organization in CSR meetings, conferences, networking forums, and stakeholder engagements. Build collaborations that enhance the organization's reach and impact. Government & Stakeholder Engagement Liaise with central and state government departments. Leverage government schemes and policies to strengthen program outcomes. Coordinate with regulatory bodies and ecosystem partners. Advocate for inclusive policies and social justice initiatives. Financial & Compliance Management Oversee annual budgets and financial planning. Ensure efficient utilization of organizational resources. Monitor statutory, legal, CSR, and donor compliance requirements. Review financial reports and operational performance. Team Leadership Lead, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary teams. Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance work culture. Drive capacity building and professional development initiatives. Conduct performance reviews and succession planning. Monitoring, Evaluation & Reporting Develop monitoring frameworks and impact measurement systems. Present organizational progress to the Board of Directors, donors, and senior leadership. Ensure timely submission of project, financial, and donor reports. Qualifications Master's Degree in Social Work (MSW), Development Studies, Public Policy, Rural Development, Social Sciences, or related field. MBA or Master's in Management is preferred. Certification in CSR, Fundraising, Project Management, or NGO Management is an added advantage. Experience & Skills 12–15+ years of leadership experience in NGOs, Foundations, CSR, or Social Impact Organizations. Proven experience in managing large-scale social justice and empowerment programs. Strong experience in fundraising, CSR partnerships, grant management, and donor relations. Excellent understanding of CSR regulations, government schemes, and development sector frameworks. Experience managing multi-location teams and cross-functional operations. Strong financial planning and budget management skills. Exceptional stakeholder management and networking abilities. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and leadership skills. High level of integrity, strategic thinking, and decision-making ability. Preferred Experience Social Justice & Advocacy Disability Inclusion & Accessibility Women Empowerment Education & Skill Development Livelihood & Community Development Healthcare & Public Health Rural & Urban Development CSR Project Management Fundraising & Resource Mobilization Government Liaison & Policy Advocacy Job Type: Full-time Pay: Up to ₹4,000,000.00 per year Application Question(s): Total Years of Experience CCTC ECTC Notice Period Comfortable for Pan-India Travelling? Work Location: In person

Who We AreWPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.The opportunityWPP Enterprise Solutions is building technology leadership across the globe to power its focus on technical transformation. The Global Talent Hub is our centre of engineering and architecture excellence, providing the technical capability and capacity that underpins global delivery.The CTO for the Global Talent Hub is a senior technical leader who owns the "How" and the "How well" of delivery — the technical authority behind WPP Enterprise Solutions' engineering and architecture teams based in the hub. While commercial strategy, go-to-market, and client relationships are predominantly won and shaped in our global markets, this role ensures those ambitions are delivered to a consistently high technical standard.You will provide architectural and technical leadership across the hub's engineering and architecture teams, run internal technical governance, drive the adoption and measurement of AI tooling, and build a high-performing cross-functional organization. You will work hand-in-hand with global locations and Operating Companies (OpCos) to understand what they need — including the required level of technical specification — and translate that into clear, actionable direction for hub teams. Working alongside the SVP of Engineering, who leads hands-on delivery execution, you will focus on architecture, design integrity, technical standards, and continuously evolving how the teams workWhat you’ll be doingArchitecture & Design Authority:Act as the senior authority on architecture and design across the hub, ensuring solutions are well-structured, scalable, and consistent with best practice across all global deliveries.Technical Governance:Establish and chair internal technical governance — architecture review, design and delivery standards, security, quality, and technical risk management — setting and enforcing the standards teams work to.Global Collaboration & Requirements Translation:Partner with global locations and OpCos to understand delivery requirements and the expected level of technical specification, translating these into structured inputs, standards, and guidance for hub teams.Innovation & Ways of Working:Bring an innovation mindset to how the teams operate — identifying where ways of working need to evolve and introducing new processes, tooling, and practices to raise productivity, quality, and consistency.AI Tooling Adoption & Measurement:Own the adoption of AI-enabled engineering tools across the hub, defining how their use, impact, productivity, and quality gains are measured and continuously improved.Building a High-Performing Team:Build, scale, and develop a high-performing cross-functional engineering and architecture organisation — driving capability building, talent development, and career progression, in partnership with the SVP of Engineering.Platform & Partner Enablement:Maintain strong technical alignment with key platform partners (Adobe, Salesforce, Shopify, Google, AWS, etc.), keeping teams certified, current with product roadmaps, and at the forefront of platform capabilities.Cross-OpCo Delivery Coordination:Coordinate across OpCos within WPP to ensure hub teams deliver unified, high-quality technical solutions that meet the needs of global engagements.What we want from youProven track record of senior technical leadership, ideally within the E-Commerce and MarTech sectors.Strong background in architecture and design across enterprise-scale solutions.Extensive experience leading large engineering and architecture teams within a delivery-focused offshore/nearshore service-hub environment.An innovation mindset, with a track record of evolving team ways of working — introducing new processes, practices, and tooling to improve performance.Solid working knowledge of enterprise MarTech and Commerce technologies.Strong expertise across enterprise ecosystems — Adobe (AEM, Commerce), Salesforce (Commerce, Marketing), Shopify, and cloud platforms such as AWS and GCP.Demonstrable experience operating within sophisticated global delivery models (onshore, nearshore, offshore) supporting large enterprise accounts.Experience defining and running technical governance — standards, architecture review, quality, and technical risk management.A track record of driving the adoption and measurement of AI tooling within engineering teams.Experience working with key platform partners (Adobe, Salesforce, Shopify, Google, AWS) to maintain certifications, tier status, and roadmap alignment.Prior experience within a major technology consultancy, systems integrator, or digital agency is highly preferred.Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to align hub teams with global technical and delivery leaders and set clear technical direction.What we can offer youAlongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.We lead with Heart, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.We empower your Brains for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.And we champion Courage, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.AT VML Enterprise SolutionsOur Enterprise Solutions division houses strategic consultants, creative and technical architects and skilled developers and operators that together help some of the world’s leading organisations to deliver outstanding digital experiences across all major routes to market worldwide: marketplaces, online retailers, D2C, B2B and social platforms. With over 4,200 experts in 55 operational centres across 34 countries, our capabilities span the entire buying journey from customer acquisition, through engagement, to conversion and loyalty, driving multi-channel growth for world-leading brands.We work with some of the most exciting brands such as The Coca-Cola Company, EY, Bosch, Unilever, Ford, DFS, Mercedes-Benz, Johnson & Johnson, Nestlé, Sainsbury’s, Selfridges, Shell and Tiffany & Co. We’ve built over 500 platforms for brands and retailers and generate in excess of $29bn annually for our clients and work with over 50 strategic partners including Adobe, SAP, Salesforce, HCL, Shopify, Sitecore, BigCommerce, commerce tools and Acquia. Our reputation is based on our people, and we believe we have some of the best in the business.As our business grows internationally, we’re looking for new people to join us on our journey to inspire and take a key role in shaping some of the best commerce solutions, services, and websites in the world. Working as a team, no problem is insurmountable; we share in our client’s successes and believe that anyone can show creative bravery no matter what their role is in the team.About WPPWPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.The opportunityWPP Enterprise Solutions is building technology leadership across the globe to power its focus on technical transformation. The Global Talent Hub is our centre of engineering and architecture excellence, providing the technical capability and capacity that underpins global delivery.The CTO for the Global Talent Hub is a senior technical leader who owns the "How" and the "How well" of delivery — the technical authority behind WPP Enterprise Solutions' engineering and architecture teams based in the hub. While commercial strategy, go-to-market, and client relationships are predominantly won and shaped in our global markets, this role ensures those ambitions are delivered to a consistently high technical standard.You will provide architectural and technical leadership across the hub's engineering and architecture teams, run internal technical governance, drive the adoption and measurement of AI tooling, and build a high-performing cross-functional organization. The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.About the Role:To serve as the Head of the Digital Suraksha Network (DSN), a not‑for‑profit foundation established by CoinDCX to build national‑scale digital‑trust and cyber‑safety infrastructure for India’s digital‑financial ecosystem.The Head will lead the foundation’s strategy, governance, operations, and stakeholder ecosystem, ensuring credible, independent, and scalable impact on fraud reduction, consumer awareness, and law‑enforcement coordination.What You’ll Do: Strategic Leadership & Vision: Define and drive the 3–5 year mission, vision, and strategic roadmap for the Digital Suraksha Foundation, anchored in fraud detection, consumer awareness, and cyber‑safety for Indian digital‑finance users. Translate CoinDCX’s commitment into a credible, multi‑year institutional roadmap for DSN, including platform‑agnostic helplines, Open Fraud Intelligence APIs, and public / LEA ‑awareness campaigns. Act as the primary bridge between the Foundation Advisory Board and the internal leadership team, ensuring alignment with CoinDCX’s broader mission and values while maintaining the foundation’s independent, public‑interest character. Governance & Institutional Stewardship: Lead the foundation’s governance, working closely with the Board to set policies, approve budgets, and oversee risk, compliance, and internal controls. Establish and chair internal governance bodies (steering committee, risk‑&‑compliance committee, and programme‑review panels) and ensure transparency, audit‑readiness, and NPO‑compliance (FCRA, income‑tax, CSR, etc.), where applicable. Represent the foundation in engagements with regulators (MeitY, I4C, CERT‑In, RBI, NPCI), state police cyber‑cells, and industry bodies, articulating DSN as a neutral, public‑good platform Programme & Operations Oversight: Oversee the end‑to‑end design and execution of core DSN capabilities: 24×7 platform‑agnostic helpline (e.g., WhatsApp‑based verification of links, platforms, and offers). Open Fraud Intelligence API to enable real‑time fraud‑detection across institutions. Consumer‑awareness and digital‑literacy campaigns (multi‑languages, mass media, and digital channels). Ensure robust internal operations covering tech, data protection, customer support, case‑tracking, and reporting dashboards, with clear SOPs and service‑level standards. Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships: Build and manage a formal partner network of banks, payment platforms, telcos, fintechs, crypto exchanges, and consumer‑protection bodies as part of the foundation’s public‑interest mandate. Lead fundraising and resource‑mobilisation beyond the initial corpus (e.g., CSR, institutional grants, partnerships) to ensure long‑term sustainability of the foundation. Serve as the primary spokesperson for DSN in media, conferences, and policy forums; collaborate with CoinDCX’s communications and public‑policy teams while maintaining the foundation’s independent voice. Policy, Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure the foundation’s architecture and data‑handling practices comply with IT Act, DPDP rules, and relevant financial‑sector cybersecurity standards, working with internal and external legal counsel. Advise the Board and CoinDCX leadership on systemic risks in digital fraud, phishing, and social‑engineering, and recommend evidence‑based interventions. Develop and institutionalise protocols for interaction with law‑enforcement and cyber‑crime cells, including data‑sharing frameworks that respect privacy and due‑process. People, Culture & Performance: Build and lead a high‑performance, cross‑functional team (tech, product, data, operations, policy, communications, and helpline/CS) with clear career pathways and performance metrics. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and public‑interest ethics consistent with the foundation’s not‑for‑profit, digital‑trust mandate. Prepare and present regular impact and performance reports to the Board, highlighting KPIs such as fraud reduction, case‑resolution time, awareness reach, and institutional adoption. You’ll Excel in This Role If You: Minimum Requirements: Master’s degree in Law, Public Policy, Management, Computer Science, or related field; PhD or advanced certification in cybersecurity / information security is a plus. 15+ years of experience, including at least 8–10 years in senior leadership roles in cybersecurity, digital‑trust, fintech, or not‑for‑profit organisations. Demonstrated experience in leading a not‑for‑profit or mission‑driven organisation, including governance, fundraising, and cross‑sector stakeholder management. Preferred Experience: Hands‑on experience in building or leading national‑scale cyber‑safety, fraud‑detection, or consumer‑protection platforms (e.g., helplines, intelligence APIs, or incident‑coordination networks). Familiarity with Indian cyber‑laws, CERT‑In advisories, UPI and payment‑system risk‑frameworks, and DPDP‑related compliance. Strong track record of working with regulators, police cyber‑cells, and large‑tech or financial‑sector organisations from a neutral, public‑good perspective. You’ll Know You’re Winning When: Strategic Trust: You are viewed by the founders and leadership as a strategic advisor who unblocks P0 initiatives, resulting in a high Trust Index for the organisation due to the governance systems you’ve put in place. Regulatory Resilience: You’ve built a legal system that anticipates and absorbs regulatory shifts with zero disruption to the product roadmap. Execution Velocity: Contract lifecycles and legal clearances are no longer a bottleneck for P0 initiatives. Institutional Trust: CoinDCX is recognized by regulators and industry bodies as the benchmark for legal and governance standards in India. Operational Autonomy: Your team operates as a self-sustaining unit, resolving complex disputes and clearings with minimal founder intervention. Hiring Process:Here’s what your journey with us looks like:Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving Assignment / Simulation Round – A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit Where We Work:We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Bangalore office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.Perks That Empower You:We believe great people deserve great experiences.Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities Ready to Build What’s Next?If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together. job description About Biz4Group At Biz4Group, we provide high-end IT services and AI solutions to a sophisticated US-based clientele. We are looking for an Operations Associate who understands that a world-class service delivery team requires a world-class operational environment. You will optimize our workplace using AI and automation to ensure it supports the high-velocity, 24/7 nature of the global IT service industry. This role is ideal for a tech-savvy professional eager to implement AI-driven efficiencies in workplace management and resource planning. You will own the strategy for B2B lead gen and B2C app growth, focusing on high-intent US audiences. Key Responsibilities: Execute end-to-end paid strategies across LinkedIn, Google Ads (Search/UAC), and Meta. The successful candidate will be strategicleader with a proven track record in managing global support teams, optimizing support processes, drivingchange and fostering strong relationships with both internal and third-party resources. Customer Advocacy: Act as a strong advocate for customers, translating feedback into actionableinsights for product and service enhancements. Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, andProfessional Services teams to ensure a cohesive customer journey and drive successful productadoption and retention. Reporting & Analytics: Establish robust reporting mechanisms and analyze support data to identifytrends, measure performance, and inform strategic decisions. Governance & Compliance: Ensure that the support operations in India adhere to all relevantcorporate policies and regional compliance requirements. Proven experience collaborating with and managing relationships with organizations based in theUnited States.
