normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typePermanentFull-time LocationPune, Maharashtra Full job description Description The Transformation Analysis & Strategy Lead is a is a transformation management role accountable for identifying and shaping critical strategic change initiatives across the organisation, to support successful and embed delivery outcomes. This role partners with the Group Transformation Director and in turn into Group Executive, C‑suite and operational leaders to balance priorities, shape the best solutions, and deliver clear financial outcomes (margin expansion, efficiency and capability uplift). This role will lead a small high‑performing team of analysts and change professionals. Key to this role is ensuring Davies adopts a data‑driven, scalable, and best‑practice approaches to operational and strategic delivery. The role sits within the Transformation Office, reporting to the Group Transformation Director, and is a key contributor to the strategic growth agenda, alongside Group initiatives and projects. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Enterprise Change Partner into leadership to define, shape, and deliver strategic initiatives across the enterprise. Act as a core member of the Transformation management team, contributing to high-level planning and decision making. Build and maintain strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including executive leaders, investors, and third‑party vendors. Provide strategic insight grounded in data analytics, financial modelling, and market understanding, particularly within the insurance sector. Data, Insights & Business Case Development Champion a data-science-informed approach, enabling data-led decision making across the enterprise. Build compelling, investment-ready business cases with clear benefit profiles and tracked, realisable value. Develop high-quality executive-level materials, including board papers, investment decks, and performance updates. Build and review financial models (CapEx, OpEx, exceptional items) to support strategic decision-making. Team Leadership & Capability Development Lead, nurture, and grow a small team of business analysts and change professionals, fostering a culture of excellence. Coach and mentor junior and senior team members, ensuring high-quality delivery and strong career development pathways. Step in to assume team responsibilities if required, supporting business needs during periods of change or transition. Delivery Excellence & Continuous Improvement Oversee multiple complex initiatives simultaneously, ensuring alignment with organisational strategy and target outcomes. Promote continuous improvement across the Transformation Office and Davies Enterprise-wide, embedding Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, and other process improvement methodologies. Guide the function through delivery maturity, helping teams adopt stronger practices, structures, and ways of working. Drive effective matrix working, ensuring clarity, collaboration, and accountability across organisational boundaries. Governance, Risk & Vendor Management Manage and oversee third-party vendors, ensuring value for money, performance accountability, and aligned delivery. Ensure all initiatives are governed effectively, with appropriate cadence, reporting, risks, and mitigation structures. Provide challenge and upward management to executive leaders to secure timely decisions and delivery-critical inputs. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Essential 10-15yrs experience data science and/or consulting management role under strategy, transformation, or change. High‑energy, self‑directed change agent who takes end‑to‑end ownership of investment and project delivery to drive measurable value creation. Strong understanding of data science concepts and their application in enterprise decision making. Deep knowledge of process improvement methodologies, including Lean, Six Sigma, and Agile. Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority work pacakages simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and executive storytelling. Expertise in building business cases, financial models, and investor-level strategic materials. Desirable Consulting background, with experience delivering within complex, matrixed organisations. Experience within the financial services sector, ideally with significant exposure to insurance. Experience working within a private equity–backed environment. Familiarity with large-scale digital, operational, or technology-enabled transformation. Behaviours & Attributes Big picture thinker with strong commercial acumen. Highly polished communicator with strong executive presence. Collaborative, influential, and effective at managing up and across. High energy, resilient, adaptable, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. Passionate about developing people and elevating organisational capability. Sets clear success metrics up front (ROI, payback, KPI baselines); reports before/after impact. Operates with minimal oversight; escalates only on risks/decisions that unblock value. Shortens time‑to‑value via iterative delivery and rapid benefit capture. Challenges legacy processes; brings data to drive decision and prove benefits realisation. About Davies We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses. We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation & risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation & change management. Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK & the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20-fold, investing heavily in research & development, innovation & automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

Scale India from ~80 to ~160 engineers by 2026 with predictable delivery, high quality, and strong bench strength. Lead India’s contribution to AI build across GT and the business, including data pipelines, ML engineering enablement, and applied AI use cases. Ensure delivery meets enterprise standards, security expectations, and measurable business outcomes. Engineering Quality, Speed, and Accountability Enforce engineering standards, delivery discipline, and quality bars across India teams. Own staffing decisions for squads, delivery commitments, and engineering performance. Actively remove delivery friction, skills gaps, and underperformance. Talent, Leadership & Site Ownership Serve as India site leader for Digital & Technology. Build a strong leadership layer (Directors, Senior Managers, Chapter Leads). Own talent attraction, retention, engagement, and succession for India engineering. Partner with HR on early-career pipelines, lateral hiring, and leadership development. Enterprise Partnership Partner closely with VP Product, VP Digital Factory, VP Data & AI, Enterprise Architecture, Tech Ops, and CISO. Represent India delivery transparently with US and global leaders—clear commitments, clear risks, no surprises. Your Interfaces & Scope Primary Partners: Product, Digital Factory, Data & AI, Enterprise Architecture, Tech Ops, CISO, D&T Value Office Operating Model: Product owns what and why Digital Factory owns global engineering model and tooling This role owns India execution, talent, and delivery outcomes Capabilities Owned AI & Applied Engineering Delivery Test Engineering & Quality Assurance Automation & RPA Development Software Engineering (Full Stack Development, API and Integration development) Engineering Leadership & Talent Management (India) Squad Staffing & Delivery Accountability India Hub Operations (delivery-facing only) Success Measures (12–18 Months) India scale: 160 engineers with stable leadership and low regretted attrition Delivery: 2–3 Finance products live with adoption and business ownership AI impact: Measurable GT and business AI capabilities delivered from India Velocity & quality: Improved cycle time, fewer escaped defects, predictable delivery Talent: Strong leadership bench; India viewed as a destination hub, not a cost center Your Profile 15+ years leading large‑scale digital or software engineering teams Proven experience scaling technology hubs in India Strong delivery background across enterprise platforms and digital products Senior‑level stakeholder management with global teams Deep people leadership and talent‑building experience Finance product or enterprise systems experience AI / data‑enabled product delivery exposure Experience operating in a product‑led engineering model Multi‑region enterprise delivery environments #IncludingYou Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are cornerstones of ADM’s efforts to continue innovating, driving growth, and delivering outstanding performance. We respect and value the unique backgrounds and experiences that each person can bring to ADM because we know that diversity of perspectives makes us better, together. Life at UiPathThe people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.Could that be you?Your MissionAs Head of Marketing for India, you will own the full demand generation engine for UiPath's largest and most complex market in Asia Pacific and Japan. You will report to UiPath’s APJ Marketing Head and lead a team that includes a direct report owning India campaign execution, working in close partnership with India's Regional Vice Presidents and their sales teams across key industry segments. This is a player-manager role: you will set India’s marketing strategy and you will also be hands-on in building and running the programs that close the pipeline gap. The single most important measure of success is whether marketing-sourced pipeline converts to closed-won revenue at or above target conversion rates.This Is What You'll Do At UiPathOwn India's pipeline numberHold and report against India's annual marketing-sourced pipeline and MQA (marketing-qualified account) targets inside UiPath's account-level, intent-data-driven measurement framework, broken out by industry segment and RVP-owned territory across financial services, public sector, IT/ITeS and global systems integrators, and business process outsourcing.Close known gaps in MQA-to-opportunity conversion by owning the cross-functional diagnostic (account fit, BDR follow-up speed, MQA gate quality) and the fix, in partnership with BDR and sales leadership.Run weekly pipeline governance with RVPs and BDR leads, reporting MQA-to-opportunity conversion, pipeline coverage by quarter, and pipeline gap by segment — closing real, named pipeline gaps is a core accountability of this role.Lead India's account-based and segment marketingExecute 1:1 and 1:few account-based marketing programs against named top accounts across all RVP-owned segments, including enterprise banking and financial services accounts and large IT/ITeS and global systems integrator accounts.Own the India global systems integrator (GSI) co-marketing opportunity — several major India-based GSIs are currently underrepresented in the global GSI marketing plan. Build the India-led program and position it as a reusable model for other APJ markets.Use intent-data platforms (e.g., 6sense) to prioritize account targeting by buying stage and sequence BDR follow-up promptly after MQA qualification.Build and manage the India teamManage the India Marketing Campaigns Manager as a direct report, owning their onboarding, campaign execution quality, and career development.Represent India in the APJ marketing leadership team alongside other APJ geography marketing leads, contributing to APJ-wide campaign design (e.g., the flagship regional roadshow and APJ-wide ABM strategy) while owning India-specific execution.Run events and executive engagement that convertPlan and execute India's flagship event calendar, including CXO roundtables, industry conclaves, and major regional event activations, against a defined India events budget.Own India's contribution to UiPath's global campaign portfolio, localizing global assets rather than building from scratch where possible.Manage budget and report with precisionOwn the India field marketing budget, allocating spend across ABM, events, paid digital, and content against the highest-converting segments and campaigns.Report marketing-sourced pipeline, MQA volume, and MQA-to-opportunity conversion with full accuracy; figures must reconcile to CRM and intent-data source-of-truth systemsThis is what you'll bring to the team8–10+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including 3+ years in a senior individual-contributor or first-line people-leadership field marketing role with direct accountability for pipeline targets.Demonstrated ownership of a demand generation number in an enterprise technology or SaaS environment — not just campaign execution, but accountability for pipeline-to-revenue conversion.Working fluency in account-based marketing and intent-data platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, or equivalent) and CRM-based pipeline reporting (e.g., Salesforce or equivalent).Deep, current understanding of India's enterprise buying landscape across financial services, public sector, IT/ITeS, and business process outsourcing — including how global systems integrator and channel partners influence enterprise deal cycles.Proven ability to manage upward and sideways in a matrixed organization: building credibility with Regional VPs and sales leadership who do not report to you, and coordinating with centralized digital, campaigns, and global teams who do not report to you either.Strong command of pipeline math: MQA-to-opportunity conversion, pipeline coverage ratios, gross-to-net revenue (including churn backfill), and the ability to explain a pipeline gap in numbers, not adjectives.Nice to HaveExperience marketing automation, AI, or agentic/intelligent automation platforms specifically.Established personal network among India global systems integrators, channel partners, and enterprise contacts in financial services and public sector.Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. normalizedText: About PayoneerFounded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.Role SummaryAs a Global Marketing Program Manager, you will own and scale global marketing programs and operational systems that turn business priorities into structured, repeatable, and measurable execution across markets. This role focuses on building the program infrastructure, governance, workflows, and cross-functional rhythms needed to deliver strategic projects at scale. You will operate as a strong cross-functional program lead—working closely with Product Marketing, Growth, Creative, Sales, RevOps, and Regional teams—to manage project roadmaps, improve delivery predictability, scale localization and translation workflows, and embed AI-enabled ways of working across marketing operations.Hybrid / Full-timeWhat You’ll DoBuild & Run Global Marketing Programs Own the planning, coordination, and delivery of global marketing programs and strategic projects aligned to business, GTM, and revenue priorities. Translate priorities into clear program plans with defined scope, milestones, dependencies, owners, risks, and success metrics. Manage project roadmaps, timelines, and delivery rituals to ensure teams are aligned and execution stays on track.Drive Operational Excellence & Governance Establish repeatable program workflows, briefing templates, stage gates, RACI models, and operating cadences that improve clarity, accountability, and speed to market. Support intake, prioritization, capacity planning, and resource coordination across Creative, Growth, Product Marketing, Sales, and Regional teams. Track delivery health, identify risks and dependencies early, and communicate progress, blockers, and decisions clearly to stakeholders.Embed AI-Enabled Ways of Working Support the adoption of AI-enabled workflows across marketing operations, including briefing, content adaptation, translation, reporting, and project management. Create reusable templates, prompts, process guidance, and governance practices that help teams scale output while maintaining quality and compliance. Track operational impact such as speed to market, cost efficiency, quality improvements, and adoption of AI-supported processes.Cross-Functional Collaboration Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Sales, RevOps, Creative, and Regional stakeholders to deliver programs on time and with clear ownership. Facilitate planning sessions, milestone reviews, launch readiness checks, and postproject retrospectives. Build strong relationships with global and regional teams, helping drive adoption of shared processes, tools, and ways of working.Who You Are 5–7 years of experience in program management, marketing operations, project management, or integrated marketing roles, ideally within B2B, fintech, or technology companies. Strong experience managing cross-functional programs or projects with multiple stakeholders, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables. Operationally strong, structured, and detail-oriented, with the ability to turn ambiguity into clear plans and execution rhythms. Comfortable working with global and regional teams and supporting localization, translation, or multi-market delivery processes. Curious and confident using AI-enabled tools to improve workflow efficiency, content adaptation, translation, reporting, or operational scale.What Could Set You Apart Experience building or improving marketing operations, localization, translation, or content production workflows. Experience managing AI adoption, automation initiatives, or tool rollouts across teams. Strong understanding of program governance, prioritization frameworks, SLAs, capacity planning, and delivery reporting. Clear, confident communicator who can influence across functions and drive alignment without direct authority.The Payoneer Ways of WorkingAct as our customer’s partner on the insideLearning what they need and creating what will help them go further.Do it. Own it.Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.Continuously improveAlways striving for a higher standard than our last.Build Each Other UpHelping each other grow, as professionals and people.If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis. Highspot is revolutionizing how millions of individuals work worldwide. You will play a key role in building and sustaining customer and partner relationships while driving the adoption of Highspot within the customer’s organization and ensuring that customers get the full benefits of using our platform. Lead the strategic communications agenda, ensuring a consistent, compelling, and premium brand narrative across all internal and external touchpoints, and developing and executing integrated communication strategies to strengthen The Leela's position as India's leading luxury hospitality brand.

normalizedText: About The Leela The story of The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts began when its founder Late Capt. CP Krishnan Nair opened The Leela Mumbai in 1986. For over three decades, The Leela has been on a journey to delight guests by providing unparalleled luxury in captivating environs ensconced in the lap of nature, wrapped in the graciousness of Indian hospitality. Headquartered in Mumbai, The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts is owned by a Brookfield Asset Management- sponsored private real estate fund and operates thirteen award-winning properties in major cities and leisure destinations across India. These include the flagship hotel in the capital city of New Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, Udaipur, Jaipur, Gurugram, East Delhi, Mumbai, Gandhinagar, Kovalam, and Ashtamudi. The brand is also delighted to announce the upcoming opening of its latest property in Hyderabad. The Leela has a strong pipeline of future projects. The brand celebrates each hotel through its unique location, art, culture, and cuisine with thoughtful services, celebratory rituals, and immersive experiences. The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts was voted the World’s Best Hotel Brand twice in a row by Travel + Leisure, USA, World’s Best Awards Survey, 2020 and 2021. In 2024, the brand has once again featured in the top 3 World’s Best Hotel Brands, after the recognition in 2023. An epitome of true Indian luxury hospitality, The Leela is committed to providing guests with unforgettable stays in settings that capture the essence of India. The brand has a marketing alliance with US- based Preferred Hotels & Resorts and is a member of the Global Hotel Alliance. Why join The Leela? • Award-Winning Brand: Join a brand that has been recognized as one of the World’s Best Hotel Brands for two consecutive years. • Commitment to Excellence: Be part of a team that is dedicated to providing the highest standards of service and hospitality. • Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that encourages creativity and innovation, ensuring that we stay at the forefront of luxury hospitality. • Career Growth: Benefit from our strong pipeline of future projects and opportunities for career advancement within The Leela and our global alliances. • Cultural Experiences: Engage with the rich cultural tapestry of India, bringing unique and authentic experiences to our discerning guests. Position Overview Reporting to: Senior Vice President and Head of Marketing and Brand Location: The Leela Corporate Office Responsibilities: The Director – Brand Communications will lead the strategic communications agenda for The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts, ensuring a consistent, compelling, and premium brand narrative across all internal and external touchpoints. The role is responsible for developing and executing integrated communication strategies that strengthen The Leela's position as India's leading luxury hospitality brand. Working closely with senior leadership, hotel teams, public relations agencies, marketing, digital, and commercial functions, the incumbent will oversee corporate communications, media relations, executive communications, crisis management, brand storytelling, awards, thought leadership, and reputation management. The ideal candidate is an experienced communications professional with a strong understanding of luxury brands, hospitality, lifestyle, and corporate communications, capable of influencing stakeholders and shaping brand perception across domestic and international markets. Key Responsibilities: Corporate Brand Communications • Develop and execute The Leela's integrated corporate and brand communications strategy aligned with business objectives. • Ensure consistency of brand messaging across all corporate, hotel, digital, media, and stakeholder communications. • Build and strengthen The Leela's brand positioning through impactful storytelling and strategic communication initiatives. • Develop annual communication calendars aligned with business priorities, hotel openings, campaigns, partnerships, and corporate milestones. Public and Media Relations • Lead national and international media relations to strengthen brand visibility and reputation. • Build and maintain relationships with leading business, travel, hospitality, luxury, lifestyle, and trade media. • Manage PR agencies and evaluate communication effectiveness through measurable outcomes. • Develop press releases, media kits, fact sheets, speeches, and key messaging documents. • Identify opportunities for proactive media engagement and brand visibility. Brand Storytelling and Content Strategy • Develop compelling narratives that showcase The Leela's heritage, luxury positioning, service philosophy, sustainability initiatives, culinary excellence, wellness offerings, and guest experiences• Oversee development of high-quality communication content across print, digital, video, and social platforms. • Ensure consistency in tone of voice, editorial quality, and brand standards across all communications. Executive Communications: • Partner with the CEO, senior leadership team, and Executive Committee to develop strategic communication materials. • Draft leadership speeches, keynote presentations, interviews, opinion articles, and executive messaging. • Support communication for investor engagements, industry forums, awards, and corporate events. Reputation and Crisis Communication • Develop and maintain crisis communication protocols and response frameworks. • Lead communication during business-sensitive situations, ensuring timely, transparent, and brand-appropriate messaging. • Monitor media sentiment and proactively manage reputation risks. • Advise leadership on communication strategies during critical business situations. Awards, Recognition and Thought Leadership • Lead submissions for national and international hospitality, luxury, travel, sustainability, and employer branding awards. • Identify speaking opportunities, conferences, and industry platforms for executive leadership. • Position The Leela and its leadership as thought leaders within the hospitality and luxury sectors. Internal Communications • Develop communication strategies that strengthen employee engagement and reinforce organizational culture. • Partner with Human Resources to communicate key initiatives, leadership messages, employer branding campaigns, and employee recognition programmes. • Ensure alignment between internal and external brand messaging. Brand Partnerships and Strategic Campaigns • Support strategic partnerships and brand collaborations through integrated communication plans. • Develop communication strategies for hotel openings, renovations, product launches, culinary festivals, wellness initiatives, and experiential campaigns. • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Digital, Revenue Management, Sales, and Operations to maximize campaign impact. Agency and Stakeholder Management • Manage PR agencies, communication consultants, creative partners, photographers, content creators, and production agencies. • Develop communication budgets and ensure optimum utilization of resources. • Build strong relationships with tourism boards, hospitality associations, luxury publications, influencers, and strategic partners. • Track communication effectiveness through media coverage, share of voice, brand sentiment, PR value, campaign reach, and stakeholder engagement. • Prepare periodic communication reports and dashboards for senior leadership. • Continuously evaluate emerging communication trends and recommend innovative approaches. Qualifications & Experience • Bachelor’s degree in mass communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Marketing, English Literature, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field. • Master’s degree in mass communication, Public Relations, Marketing, Corporate Communications, Journalism, or MBA from a reputed institution is preferred. • Professional certifications in Corporate Communications, Public Relations, Brand Management, Digital Communications, Crisis Communications, or Strategic Communications will be an added advantage. • 10–15 years of progressive experience in Brand Communications, Corporate Communications, Public Relations, or Integrated Marketing Communications. • Minimum 5 years in a leadership role managing corporate communication strategies for luxury hospitality, luxury retail, travel, lifestyle, aviation, premium consumer brands, or corporate organizations. • Proven experience managing executive communications, media relations, reputation management, and integrated communication campaigns. jdEvidence.value: Act as the senior GSMA representative in India, cultivating high-level relationships, providing strategic direction, and leading advocacy efforts.

normalizedText: Department: APAC RegionTeam: AdvocacyLocation: India (New Delhi Office)Position type: Permanent, Full-TimeWhat The Hiring Manager SaysThis role is about more than just operational leadership; it is about embodying authority and professional excellence to command the attention of the Indian mobile industry. You will serve as a distinguished leader within the digital ecosystem, providing high-level strategic direction to maximise the GSMA's impact across the landscape. By navigating the highest levels of government and industry with absolute integrity, you will ensure the complex dynamics of the mobile industry’s role in the development of one of the world’s largest Digital Nations are integrated into our strategy and plan.About The TeamThe APAC team is a dynamic and cross-functional group dedicated to unlocking the power of connectivity across the region. As part of this team, we work to unify the mobile ecosystem, drive innovation, and advocate for positive policy environments while allowing for the diverse nature of the APAC region. You will be joining a team that values collaboration and regional alignment, working closely with all of APAC’s leadership to coordinate resources and secure the voice of India across regional programs.About The RoleAs the Head of India, you will act as the senior GSMA representative in country, cultivating trusted, high-level relationships with government officials, regulators, industry captains, and ecosystem partners. You will navigate complex political and commercial landscapes with integrity to advance the industry's position, ensuring the GSMA’s voice is heard and respected in critical policy debates.Beyond external advocacy, you will be responsible for operational and cultural leadership. You will guide the health and culture of the Delhi office, fostering an inclusive environment that positions GSMA as a preferred corporate workplace while overseeing the local execution of advocacy efforts to maximise member value.Strategically, you will provide timely, expert advice to the Head of APAC and global leadership by monitoring the intersection of market trends, geopolitical shifts, and policy developments. You will ensure the Indian market's perspective is accurately reflected in global objectives. Additionally, you will influence and mentor subordinates and cross-functional teams without reliance on direct structural authority, coaching peers on the nuances of the Indian market to optimise their impact.About YouTo succeed in this role, you must possess extensive experience in the mobile, ICT, or technology sector, with a proven track record as a respected leader in the digital ecosystem. You will bring an established network of relevant senior government, regulatory, and industry stakeholders, enabling you to engage credibly from day one and open doors at the highest levels. You will need a deep awareness of the interworking dynamics of geopolitics, industrial policy, and commercial imperatives, applying this knowledge to strategic decision-making.We are looking for a leader with elite communication capabilities, capable of adjusting your style to effectively engage and influence the top levels of government and industry. You must demonstrate the ability to build consensus, influence outcomes, and leverage trusted relationships across senior public-sector, regulatory, operator, and wider ecosystem communities, while mentoring stakeholders across a matrixed environment without direct reporting lines.Your personal qualities are just as important as your professional background. You should convey an immediate sense of gravitas and professional maturity that draws attention and commands respect. You must operate without compromising integrity, navigating sensitive environments with discretion and honour. Finally, you will be a strategic thinker with an adaptable leadership style that fosters collaboration, supported by a well-established and actively maintained network of senior government and industry relationships within the market.About Your SkillsTo succeed in this high-stakes environment, you will rely heavily on Diplomacy and Stakeholder Management to navigate the complex political landscape and cultivate trusted relationships with government officials and industry captains. Because this position requires guiding peers and global management without direct reporting lines, you must demonstrate exceptional Influence to build consensus and mentor stakeholders effectively. Your Leadership will be critical not only in representing the GSMA externally with gravitas but also in fostering a positive office culture and operational excellence. Finally, deep Commercial Awareness is vital to understanding the interworking dynamics of geopolitics and industrial policy, ensuring strategic decisions reflect both local market realities and global commercial imperativesContract typeRegularWorker typeEmployeeWhat We OfferWorking at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.In addition to architect-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning & development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others.To learn more about the GSMA, visit our career site, our LinkedIn page and our Twitter page.Being You at the GSMAWe care deeply about diversity, equity and inclusivity and aspire to be the best at it. Your well-being and work/life balance is important, so flexi-time and remote working is available to all staff. We're keen to ensure everyone is equal, represented and connected so we particularly encourage applications from all demographics. The sucess of the GSMA year on year will continue to be contributed by people from all walks of life.GSMA ValuesOur values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation.Passionately drivenWe approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world-changing impact.Insightful leadersWe continually develop and engage our expertise, insight and creativity so that we’re always ready to respond to the changing landscape with authority, agility and nuance.Stronger togetherWe lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. And if we aren’t at our best and the pressure is on – we feel free to be ourselves but still remain curious, lean into the tough stuff and we are always respectful to others and accountable for the part we play. jdEvidence.value: Deliver and grow the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP), specifically leading product management for its unstructured data domain, from strategic vision to end-to-end delivery and adoption.

normalizedText: About This RoleAbout this roleWe are seeking a Vice President of Product to help deliver and grow the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP).In this role, you will collaborate with product managers across EDP to develop the product vision and define the execution strategy. You will partner with engineering and program management teams to drive the delivery of these capabilities and help define, develop, and deliver the capabilities for our Unstructured Data domain. You will engage platform users to understand their business needs, use cases, requirements, and priorities; define a product offering that meets those needs; work with UX designers and the broader EDP team to create a positive user experience; support platform adoption; and objectively measure its successResponsibilitiesStrategic Vision: Establish and articulate a clear strategic roadmap for the capabilities you oversee, aligned to the business outcomes of the key team members and to EDP’s product and technical architecture. Product Management: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation to delivery, ensuring the timely and successful release of features and enhancements. Participate in agile ceremonies, manage the product backlog, and support testing activities to ensure quality and alignment with user needs. Engagement: Collaborate closely with internal and external partners - including adopters, engineering teams, and business analysts - to gather requirements and to scope and prioritize the build work. Market Intelligence: Stay abreast of industry trends, market offerings, and customer feedback to inform product decisions and maintain our competitive edge. User Experience: Champion a user-centric, low-friction user experience for adopters and their customers, focusing on EDP’s usability, intuitiveness, and overall user satisfaction. Adoption and Evangelism: Help to promote EDP’s adoption across the organization. Provide training, documentation, and support as needed. Act as a vocal advocate for EDP both internally and externally. Performance Monitoring: Establish key performance indicators and metrics to track the business value delivered by EDP’s components. Iterate based on insights and feedback. Product Team Development: Help to mentor and grow the next generation of BlackRock product managers, and mature the team’s operating model and working practices QualificationsBachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent; advanced degree preferred. Minimum of 8 years of experience, with at least 5 years in a product management role, experience developing cloud-based data platforms or Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) products preferred. Experience in at least one of these product areas: acquiring and transforming unstructured/multimodal data, preparing data for machine learning, and integrating data with AI developer platform products. Must be credible engaging with technical audiences. Experience working in a globally distributed product management and engineering teams. Consistent record of successfully leading product development within complex enterprise environments. Experience leading the definition and development of commercial products and go-to-market strategies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to acquire and translate data-driven insights into actionable product strategies. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to actively engage an influence both technical and business partners at all levels of the organization. Experience working with global cross-functional teams in a scaled agile development environment. Experience using industry standard product management tools and technologies, e.g. Aha, Miro, Visio, Microsoft ADO, PowerPoint.Our BenefitsTo help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.Our hybrid work modelBlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.Guidance on AI use for candidatesAt BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.About BlackRockAt BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law. normalizedText: Job highlights15+ years in EPC/LSTK estimation for Mineral & Metals, engineering degree, expertise in multidisciplinary cost estimationLead estimation for large EPC projects, review tender documents, coordinate RFQs and bid strategies, ensure timely competitive proposalsJob match scoreEarly ApplicantKeyskillsLocationWork ExperienceJob descriptionHead- EstimationsBangalore, Minerals & MetalsJOB DESCRIPTIONAbout ZetwerkZetwerk is the largest global manufacturing network for custom manufacturing that helps transform digital designs into physical manifestations.Zetwerk offers manufacturing solutions across a diverse range of products, from simple items like steel pipes to complex products like aircraft engine components, from industrial use-cases like metal bridges, oil rigs, aircraft/auto components to consumer use-cases like apparel, home appliances, audio-visual electronics, for small businesses and Fortune 500 companies alike. About ElevenLabsElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main PlatformsElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.How we workHigh-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.What we offerInnovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.About The RoleWe're looking for a senior B2B Marketing Generalist to build and scale demand generation across multiple channels. This is a hands-on role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI.Your work will shape how the Indian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make the top choice for every enterprise evaluating voice AI, whether for conversational agents, or creative applications.What You’ll DoBuild integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across priority industries, from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement.Build and execute programs across ABM, content, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound, choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function.Partner closely with sales, product marketing, growth, design, and global marketing teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns.Own pipeline generation and campaign performance, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works.Requirements5 to 7 years of experience at a high-growth technology company - built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and know what moved the needle.Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly.Relentless commitment to excellence - holds a high bar for quality, clarity, and impactIs curious about AI, follows the technology ecosystem closely, and has exceptional judgment on what makes marketing stand out.Growth PotentialRoleWe believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:Lead B2B demand generation for the region and channels as ElevenLabs continues to scale globally.Own a major marketing function, such as enterprise marketing, events, or product marketing.Grow into a broader marketing leadership role, helping define the GTM strategy for new products and markets.LocationThis role is remote-first and can be executed from anywhere in India. normalizedText: About the Company: Alysian is a high-performing, boutique advisory firm specializing in delivering tailored strategic and technological solutions for leading private equity firms and their portfolio companies. With decades of combined cross-sector expertise, Alysian excels in bridging commercial vision to reality with technology execution — enabling rapid value creation at enterprise scale. We operate with a uniquely agile delivery model, combining deep domain expertise in digital strategy, transformation, and technology innovation. Our entrepreneurial culture and speed-to-impact approach have earned us repeated impact recognition from leading PE firms. At Alysian, we build longterm partnerships grounded in trust, performance, and a relentless drive for client success.Core values:Data Driven – Strategic advisory based on a depth of relevant data.Speed & Precision – Agile delivery with tangible results.Impact-Driven – Measurable outcomes aligned to strategy.Expertise & Trusted Advisor – Deep domain knowledge with integrity.Entrepreneurial – Proactive problem-solving and ownership mentality.Role ContextAlysian is building a premier Tech M&A Advisory practice focused on delivering technology-enabled value creation for Private Equity clients and their portfolio companies across UK, Europe and the US. The practice supports clients across the full M&A lifecycle, positioning Alysian as a trusted partner from deal execution through post-close value realisation.We are seeking hands-on, impact-driven individuals who will play a critical role in value creation initiatives, including IT due diligence with a value creation lens, technology strategy, carve-outs, and transformation delivery. The role requires a blend of technical expertise, commercial acumen, and strong client-facing capability. Experience in Private Equity or PE-backed environments is highly desirable.Key ResponsibilitiesDepending on experience, the role will cover at least two of the following areas:IT Due Diligence & Deal Advisory: Lead or support technology due diligence focused on value creation upside rather than risk alone; assess target technology environments, cybersecurity posture, and IT organisation maturity; support SPA and TSA structuring including liabilities, transitional risks, and standalone costs; translate findings into executive-ready reports, investment insights, and value creation plans.Carve-Out & Separation Execution: Define IT separation strategies and ensure Day 1 readiness; design and manage TSA services, governance, and exit plans; lead the IT workstream within Separation Management Offices; manage vendor transitions, SLAs, hypercare, and TSA exit to BAU.Transformation Assurance & Program Recovery: Shape transformation business cases and support vendor selection; design governance and PMO structures; assess or recover at-risk programs and ensure benefits realisation; oversee cutover, deployment readiness, change, and hypercare activities.IT Cost Optimisation & Procurement: Lead IT spend diagnostics and benchmarking; drive vendor negotiations, RFx processes, and contract optimisation; establish Vendor Management Office capabilities and procurement operating models.Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with finance, legal, operations, and deal teams to align technology strategy with M&A objectives; provide clear senior-level communication to stakeholders and investors; lead complex technology programs ensuring delivery against scope, time, and budget.Candidate ProfileMinimum 6 years of consulting or advisory experience, including at least 2 years at a top tier consulting firm. Experience advising Private Equity, working in PE-backed companies, or PE-focused roles is desirable but not mandatory.Strong hands-on experience in technology-enabled M&A, transformation, or systems delivery, ideally with early career exposure in system integration followed by strategy consulting. Demonstrated depth in at least one area: applications transformation (ERP/CRM such as SAP, Salesforce, Dynamics), IT infrastructure and cloud, or data, analytics, and AI.MBA from a leading business school and/or a degree from a top international university with relevant postgraduate or professional certifications desirable.Proven track record delivering complex M&A and transformation programs, strong project and vendor management skills, excellent executive communication, and strong analytical, problem-solving, and negotiation capabilities.BenefitsWhy Join Alysian Consulting? Our vision is to become the leading independent boutique tech advisory firm, transforming value creation in private equity through technology and data. We partner with top-tier PE firms (mega-funds in UK, Europe & the US) to drive sustainable growth for portfolio companies and communities.At Alysian, you’ll work at the intersection of technology, strategy, and investment—where every project has a measurable impact on business performance. We partner with top-tier private equity firms, giving you access to high-profile transformations, boardroom conversations, and some of the most exciting portfolio companies in the market.We offer: Frontline PE exposure, from day oneClient-facing work with US/UK/EU Mega and Large Cap deal teams and PortCo CXOs; you lead modules that move EBITDA, not just make slides.Outcome ownership in small strike teamsLeadership access, clear mandates, and the autonomy to design and ship cost-out / value-creation plays in weeks.Remote-first with limited travelWork from anywhere in India with sustainable US/UK/EU overlap; optional office use; travel about 2–3 weeks/year.Builder’s seat in a scaling CoEJoin the founding wave—shape operating models, codify playbooks, and help build the platform the firm scales on.Meritocracy with real velocityProgress based on outcomes; accelerated responsibility and pod leadership for top performers. normalizedText: Role overviewSpydra is looking for an experienced technology leader to drive the successful execution of complex AI, data, blockchain, automation, and enterprise-platform initiatives.This position sits at the intersection of business, product, engineering, architecture, and customer delivery. The person will convert business priorities into executable technology programs, establish clear delivery plans, address risks before they affect commitments, and ensure that solutions move reliably from design to production.The role requires more than project tracking. The successful candidate will be expected to understand the technology being delivered, question assumptions, challenge designs where necessary, resolve cross-functional bottlenecks, and make practical decisions that protect customer outcomes.The opportunityYou will lead a portfolio of strategic technology initiatives and ensure that each program has:Clearly defined business outcomesRealistic scope and delivery plansStrong technical foundationsAccountable owners and delivery teamsTransparent risk and dependency managementProduction-ready environmentsMeasurable customer and business impactYou will work closely with senior leadership, customers, product managers, architects, engineering teams, cloud and infrastructure teams, and external partners.Key areas of responsibilityTechnology program leadershipLead technology initiatives from discovery and planning through implementation, rollout, and production stabilization.Build integrated delivery plans covering product, engineering, data, infrastructure, security, testing, and deployment activities.Set milestones, delivery checkpoints, acceptance criteria, and readiness conditions for each initiative.Ensure teams remain focused on business-critical outcomes rather than activity-based progress.Review delivery status using tangible evidence such as working demonstrations, test results, deployment outputs, and production metrics.Identify delays early and implement recovery plans before commitments are affected.Adjust sequencing, resources, scope, or implementation approaches when required.Technical oversightReview proposed architectures and engineering approaches for feasibility, scalability, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.Engage deeply with engineering teams to understand technical constraints and implementation risks.Challenge designs that create unnecessary complexity, delivery uncertainty, or long-term operational issues.Facilitate decisions where multiple technical approaches are available.Ensure that architecture choices are appropriate for the business requirement and delivery timeline.Confirm that solutions meet functional and non-functional expectations before progressing through major delivery gates.Promote practical engineering choices while maintaining essential quality and security standards.AI, data, and platform deliveryOversee initiatives involving generative AI, machine learning, data platforms, enterprise integrations, workflow automation, and blockchain-based applications.Ensure AI systems are appropriately evaluated for output quality, reliability, security, privacy, bias, and operational performance.Review approaches involving model integration, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, vector databases, data pipelines, and model-serving infrastructure.Ensure that appropriate testing, observability, monitoring, human-review, and fallback mechanisms are incorporated into AI-enabled products.Work with platform teams to establish production-readiness and governance requirements.Support teams in moving AI and data solutions from proof of concept to scalable enterprise deployment.Delivery governance and interventionEstablish a delivery cadence that encourages timely decisions, clear ownership, and rapid issue resolution.Maintain visibility over risks, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, and unresolved actions.Assign clear owners and deadlines for critical issues.Investigate the underlying causes of delivery problems rather than relying only on status reporting.Step in directly when teams are blocked or commitments are at risk.Bring together the right stakeholders to resolve technical, business, commercial, or operational dependencies.Recommend corrective action where progress, quality, or accountability is insufficient.Escalate matters with clear options, implications, and recommended decisions.Business and engineering alignmentTranslate business requirements into structured technology plans that engineering teams can execute.Clarify expected user behaviour, business rules, operational processes, and measurable success criteria.Resolve ambiguity before it results in development rework.Help business stakeholders understand technical constraints, dependencies, and implementation consequences.Present clear choices when trade-offs are required across scope, timeline, cost, quality, and risk.Ensure that delivered solutions address the intended customer or business problem.Maintain alignment between customer expectations, product priorities, and engineering capacity.Partner and vendor managementCoordinate onboarding of implementation partners, technology providers, consultants, and specialist vendors.Define technical access requirements, integration dependencies, delivery milestones, and productivity expectations.Track whether partners are contributing effectively within agreed timelines.Resolve delays involving access, infrastructure, environments, documentation, integration, or technical dependencies.Require improvement plans where partner performance is below expectations.Work with commercial and leadership teams where contractual or delivery interventions are required.Confirm partner and environment readiness before critical implementation stages.Environment and release readinessEnsure development, testing, staging, and production environments are available in line with delivery plans.Establish readiness checklists for deployment, integration, security, performance, monitoring, and support.Coordinate resolution of infrastructure and environment-related dependencies.Ensure release decisions are supported by appropriate testing and operational evidence.Work with DevOps, cloud, security, and support teams to improve deployment predictability.Reduce avoidable delays caused by incomplete environments or unresolved production dependencies.Decision-making expectationsThe person in this role will be expected to:Take timely decisions within agreed commercial, technical, and governance boundaries.Recommend changes to delivery plans, scope, staffing, sequencing, or implementation approaches.Approve carefully controlled interim solutions where they are necessary to protect delivery.Require corrective action from internal teams and external partners.Prevent initiatives from progressing when critical security, reliability, or deployment conditions have not been met.Document important decisions and communicate their impact to relevant stakeholders.Involve senior leadership when decisions exceed agreed authority or materially affect customer and business commitments.Candidate profileYou are likely to succeed in this role if you combine technical understanding with strong execution discipline.You should be comfortable discussing architecture and engineering decisions with technical teams while also communicating delivery implications to business leaders and customers.The role requires someone who is willing to take ownership, ask difficult questions, resolve conflict constructively, and remain focused on measurable outcomes.Required experienceApproximately 12–16 years or more of experience in technology delivery, engineering leadership, architecture, enterprise platforms, or digital transformation.Demonstrated experience leading complex programs involving multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders.Strong record of delivering enterprise technology solutions into production.Experience working directly with engineering, architecture, product, infrastructure, security, and business teams.Experience managing distributed teams, implementation partners, or technology vendors.Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms, automation, cloud-native systems, or enterprise SaaS products.Understanding of the complete delivery lifecycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.Relevant certifications in architecture, cloud platforms, program management, data engineering, cybersecurity, or artificial intelligence would be useful but are not essential.Technical capabilitiesThe ideal candidate should have a sound understanding of several of the following areas:Generative AI and large language modelsMachine-learning systems and model deploymentRetrieval-augmented generation and vector databasesAI agents and workflow automationData ingestion, ETL, streaming, and warehousingAPIs and enterprise-system integrationsCloud architecture and containerized environmentsMLOps, DevOps, and release automationApplication and infrastructure observabilitySecurity, privacy, access control, and data protectionDistributed systems and blockchain platformsScalability, performance, resilience, and availabilityProduction monitoring and incident managementHands-on development experience is valuable, but the primary requirement is the ability to assess technical approaches, identify delivery implications, and guide teams toward practical solutions. normalizedText: Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?At Aleph , we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.India is one of the most dynamic and fastest-growing digital advertising markets in the world. As Country Head, you will own it. This is a senior leadership role with full commercial accountability, revenue, profitability, team, and partnership, and the mandate to grow Aleph's presence in one of our most strategically important markets.We are looking for an accomplished business leader who combines commercial sharpness with industry credibility and the ability to inspire a high-performing team. You will shape Aleph's market positioning, deepen relationships with the country's most important advertisers and agency partners, and translate global priorities into local results.What You'll DoCommercial & P&LPrimary accountability for country net revenue vs. quota and standalone EBITDA.Set and execute territory and account strategy; Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.About Employee Service At SalesforceSalesforce Employee Service powers next-generation internal support and service management. Our platform enables organizations to deliver seamless IT and HR experiences to their workforce by:Automating internal service processes and streamlining cross-departmental workflows.Leveraging AI to intelligently mine knowledge, resolve employee inquiries instantly, and power autonomous, agent-driven interactions.Delivering exceptional employee experiences with intelligent case routing, predictive insights, and real-time collaboration tools that boost enterprise productivity.About The RoleWe’re seeking a visionary Director of Product Management to lead our next-generation AI initiatives and drive the strategy of AI-first, collaboration-first, and platform-centric innovations across our Employee Service portfolio (spanning IT Service Management and HR Service Delivery). This role is critical to building enterprise-grade internal service solutions that empower employees, IT helpdesks, and HR teams at scale.You will lead the charge in transitioning our employee service paradigm from reactive ticketing to proactive, autonomous workflows. You will build and scale enterprise-grade Agentic AI systems, determining how autonomous agents collaborate with human employees, integrating state-of-the-art LLMs, and defining the future of AI-first work.As the owner of the AI roadmap, you will translate the latest industry trends—spanning Generative AI and Predictive Machine Learning—into scalable product features. Working cross-functionally with engineering, data science, UX, sales, and marketing, you will ensure our AI solutions remain cutting-edge, secure, and highly impactful for transforming how enterprises support their workforce.What You’ll DoDefine Product Strategy: Own the product vision and strategy for AI-driven capabilities within Employee Service (IT and HR domains), ensuring alignment with broader business goals.Agentic AI Leadership: Lead the conceptualization and delivery of Agentic AI workflows, enabling autonomous, task-oriented AI agents to resolve internal IT tickets and HR requests.Architectural Strategy: Drive product and architectural decisions around LLM integration, RAG pipelines, and agent orchestration frameworks. You will own the trade-offs between model performance, latency, cost, and context window optimization.AI Trust, Safety & Evals: Design robust evaluation frameworks for AI agents to measure accuracy, mitigate hallucinations, manage prompt injection risks, and maintain enterprise-grade data privacy.AI-First UX: Define the UX paradigms for human-in-the-loop (HITL) interactions, ensuring seamless handoffs between autonomous agents and employees/IT Teams.Customer Discovery & Integration: Engage directly with enterprise customers to understand complex pain points, specifically focusing on how they discover, adopt, and integrate AI applications into their internal IT, HR, and custom enterprise ecosystems (e.g., via API-based integrations and secure server environments).Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate deeply with engineering, data science, and UX teams to build scalable, intuitive, and high-performance AI solutions, driving prioritization and trade-offs.Go-to-Market Alignment: Partner with sales, marketing, and enablement teams to define GTM strategies, positioning, and messaging to ensure successful product launches and market adoption.Executive Communication: Regularly present product updates, AI strategies, and measurable results to C-suite leadership and external partners, ensuring continuous alignment.Data-Driven Iteration: Leverage data-driven insights to continuously improve product offerings, tracking employee adoption, operational cost savings, and market share expansion.What We’re Looking ForExperience: 14+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, with a demonstrated track record of taking an Agentic product from 0-to-1 and scaling it in a production environment.AI/ML Expertise: Hands-on familiarity with LLM orchestration (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), embedding models, vector databases, and designing autonomous agent loops (planning, tool use, reflection). You deeply understand the trade-offs between different foundation models and fine-tuning vs. RAG approaches. Strong working knowledge of predictive ML models and data pipelines.Technical Fluency: Experience with AI evaluation techniques (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge) and continuous model improvement cycles based on human feedback. Ability to engage deeply with engineering and data science teams on architectural tradeoffs, model selection, and performance metrics.Strategic Execution: Proven track record of developing and executing comprehensive, multi-quarter product roadmaps that drive measurable business impact.Communication Skills: Exceptional executive presence with the ability to navigate stakeholder alignment and articulate complex AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.Preferred Domain Knowledge: A proven ability to build scalable AI/LLM products is essential. Familiarity with Salesforce AI capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, Data Cloud) and prior experience in IT Service Management (ITSM), HR Service Delivery, or Employee Workflows are highly preferred but not mandatory. Why Join Us?Work on cutting-edge AI-powered solutions that transform internal support experiences for enterprises.Collaborate with a world-class team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.Shape the future of intelligent employee service management and drive meaningful impact by solving real organizational challenges at scale.Be part of a culture of innovation, collaboration, personal growth and continuous learning.Unleash Your PotentialWhen you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.AccommodationsIf you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. Head of Customer SupportHebbal, BangaloreThe RoleWe are hiring a Head of Customer Support to build our support function from the ground up. This is a founding-member role: there is no existing playbook, team, or tooling — you will define all of it. Our customers are technical and operationally sophisticated — fleet operators, MSMEs, energy storage providers, banks, insurers, and financial services firms — and our product sits deep in mission-critical infrastructure. Support here is not ticket triage; it's a trust function for customers whose battery uptime directly affects their revenue.What You'll Do Design and build the support function from scratch — processes, tooling, SLAs, escalation paths, and knowledge base — for a technical B2B product. Hire, train, and lead the founding support team as the company scales beyond private preview. Own resolution of technical issues involving battery data, integrations, and platform behavior — working directly with engineering on complex or systemic issues. Build relationships with power users across fleet operators, MSMEs, and financial institutions, understanding their operational context well enough to anticipate issues before they're raised. Define and track the metrics that matter — response time, resolution time, CSAT, and escalation rate — and report them to leadership. Create a feedback loop between customers and product/engineering, ensuring recurring issues turn into roadmap input, not repeated tickets. Select and implement support tooling (helpdesk, knowledge base, in-app support) with a frugal, pragmatic, open-source-friendly approach. Develop self-serve resources — documentation, FAQs, onboarding guides — to reduce repetitive load as the customer base grows.What We're Looking For Founding/0→1 experience: has built a support function from scratch at a B2B SaaS company, not just operated within an existing one. B2B SaaS background: proven experience supporting technical, enterprise, or SMB business customers — not consumer support. Technical comfort: able to understand and troubleshoot issues involving data integrations, APIs, dashboards, and platform behaviour; comfortable working directly with engineering. Operational rigour: has defined SLAs, escalation matrices, and support metrics from a blank slate, and can build tooling/process without a big budget. Customer-facing maturity: credible speaking with operationally sophisticated customers — fleet managers, MSME owners, and staff at banks or financial institutions — who expect precise, no-nonsense answers. People leadership: ready to hire and manage a small team as it grows, while still being hands-on with customers in the early days. Bonus: prior exposure to EV, fleet, IoT, or hardware-adjacent products where support requires understanding physical-world context, not just software behaviour.Skills: b2b,battery,escalation Show more Show less Head of Customer SupportHebbal, BangaloreThe RoleWe are hiring a Head of Customer Support to build our support function from the ground up.
